chapters.title: Chapter 2588 The Wealdian Council of Extremity!
paragraphs: Noah looked at the six different versions of himself and smiled.
They formed a circle above the very heights of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as around them, seas of multicolored authority flowed serenely.
He was all of them, and yet each of the Reified Wealdian Sources of Extremity had their own distinct versions of his personality!
When looking at them, Noah couldn't help but turn playful as when he gazed at the circle of Titanic Reified Wealdian Sources of Extremity, he proclaimed grandly.
"For the first time in Recorded History...we shall convene the Quintessential Wealdian Council of Extremity."
On a whim, Noah enacted such a Council as he gazed at the different personalities of himself voiced in the Wealdian Sources of Extremity!
The voice of the stellar crimson Indefatigable Wealdian Source had his voice buzz out next grandly as the rivers of potent Vacuous Hyperversal Authority around it pulsed with majesty.
"The aim is Quintessence. The inevitable result is Extremity!"
The inevitable result was Extremity. A mere inevitability!

The other Wealdian Sources of Extremity expressed Noah's will in different forms as through the Wealdian Source of Oraculum, Noah smiled and expressed his thoughts with the other personalities as a dense number of possibilities unfolded before him.

"The first task of this path of inevitable Extremity is survival and safety against any measures that Hyperversal Extremities may bring against us. Death is not a possibility...with the only weakness being the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!"
The Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
If found by his enemies, this was the only thing that could jeopardize his path.

He was able to survive against the clash of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority due to his connection with the Infinite Hyperversal Havens- his death being an impossibility unless this Haven was destroyed!
So naturally, his enemies would inevitably be seeking his home in order to destroy him.
Noah wanted to take that option away from his enemies and be proactive in making a move before even they did.
Noah's will gazed at the vibrant Haven and the wonders it contained through the Wealdian Source of Aletheian as he spoke grandly through it.

"Its capabilities and features are being elevated along with the advancement of the Natural Laws towards Extremity. At this moment, it can deny entry to Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, but a Hyperversal Extremity can still barge in and reject the Absolute Authority from this Haven!"

It was already astounding that a domain could entirely reject even Apex Aeonic Lifeforms by itself, and this capability may even be expanded to Hyperversal Extremities in the future when Manadynamics and other Natural Laws began to step onto this stage as well!

"The Planar Palisades of Extremity..." In an ancient and deep voice, Noah's will in the Wealdian Source of Thanatos spoke out while surrounded by death. "...are no longer safe. The Infinite Hyperversal Haven has to be moved."
The Planar Palisades of Extremity were no longer safe!
Noah planned ahead and thought of any possible futures where things could go wrong, and this was the decision he arrived at!
The question was...where does one hide a Haven away from the prying eyes of Hyperversal Extremities?
In the Fifth Golden Chambers of Avernus.
Extremity Ariana had a pondering look as she scanned through the dense amount of information on the little history of Noah Osmont they gathered and his movements in the Haven of Dissolution.
Soon after, her voice rose amidst the vibrant discussions.

{It says here that the Planes of Existence that his Learnean Lineage were in are all gone from their original locations. Paired with the fact that these Learneans only appeared a few billion years ago in Dissolution, they should have stemmed from any of the endless swathes of space in the Planar Palisades of Extremity. There are still countless Minor Planes forming across the Palisades who have yet to enter the folds of the Seven Havens...he may have his current base somewhere there!}
Her words were resonant as they were ingrained by all before Chamber Master Gayacus nodded with a brilliant light.

{We shall send out the reserve Apex Aeonic Avernus Legions to wade through the regions of the Planar Palisades forming the most wormholes with the Haven of Dissolution and spread from there. You all also send out either your Main Bodies or other Clones to make this process even faster...let us see if we can locate him and the Planes of Existence that disappeared from the Learnean Lands within the Planar Palisades!}
A decision was quickly made as the Avernus Hyperversal Extremities moved quickly.
Chamber Master Gayacus turned towards Extremity Ariana with sharp eyes as he asked.
{Where are we with the Cult of Endless Shadows?}

{An insignificant connection at most. They have increased their number of Tier 1 Extremities recently as it is likely they have attained some type of Hyperversal Extremity Treasure. Both sides are likely using each other as there are signs of an Oath of Extremity having been made between own of their people and Osmont.}
Extremity Ariana replied succinctly while waving her hands dismissively.
With a domineering light, the voice of the existence who used to have attained Extremity in Destruction hissed hate next.

{Suppress them and the Inheritances they make dealings with. Cripple their capabilities to obtain resources in the dark to the extent they cannot complain to the Adjudicator of Penumbra! Suppress them until they turn their backs on this Osmont...}
Ideas continued to bounce from one Extremity to another as some spoke with much more emotion than others.
But the chosen participants of the Fifth Golden Chambers of Avernus made headway in their search of Noah Osmont- the forces of the Avernus Clan being mobilized based on their findings!
Where does one hide something away from the prying eyes of Hyperversal Extremities?
This question whirred in his mind and the minds of his collective will as soon after, his soul in the Reified Wealdian Source of Oraculum smiled.
"Well...when it comes to places others cannot even look at, I can think of one."
The faces of the Reified Wealdian Sources of Extremity had no mouths or noses, but their eyes gave off a devilish smile at this moment as Oraculum continued!
"Since we can take things out, it should naturally be possible to place something in."
A dreadful silence fell amidst the discussion of the Wealdian Council of Extremity.
It was soon broken by the tyrannical voice of the Reified Wealdian Source of Indefatigable as he stared at Oraculum.
"Simply take the Infinite Hyperversal Haven into the Aeonic Annals of Extremity!"
WAA!
The answer that Noah's Will reached as different versions of his soul gathered...was to take him home into a place of countless Records and possibilities!

This daring idea was brought forth from Noah's Will as the eyes of the Reified Wealdian Sources of Extremity radiated profound tyranny.
As the idea took root, all eyes came to land on the Reified Wealdian Source of Oraculum.
The prompts that had come during its advent were simply in nature as among them, there was one unique one in particular that appeared first.

The body of the Reified Wealdian Source of Oraculum vibrated with tendrils of authority as the gazes of all other parts of Noah's Will waited for his words, and the words that came were mighty!

"Plundering something from an Unrecorded History was already an ordeal as I can already speculate that placing something in an Unrecorded History will be an impossibility at the current stage. But a Recorded History....should be stable enough since it is a reality that has already been established and played out. I shall place the Infinite Hyperversal Haven...in a Recorded History!"
Noah's will through Oraculum stated straightforwardly that it would place the Infinite Hyperversal Haven into a Recorded History!
These words were said without question as the moment it was decided, the figure of Oraculum rose upwards and disappeared into a glimmer of light an instant later.
SHAA!
Outside of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven. In the Planar Palisades of Extremity.
Oraculum materialized with all of his grandeur as he looked at the barely discernible object floating like a speck of dust, his hands reaching out and grasping it in his palm.

Even now as Noah observed such an action, he was amazed at how this minuscule speck of dust was actually a treasure that held countless light years worth of Planes, realities, cosmos, and other stellar bodies within it!
And yet somehow, it was condensed to such a small size that fit into the palm of his Reified Wealdian Source of Oraculum at this moment.
Thereafter, the golden authority of Oraculum wrapped around the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as the singularities that were the eyes of Oraculum blinked with concentration.
The Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
They were Records of things that had come and gone, and they were also records of things to come.
They weren't something tangible as those with pristine concepts of Extremity relating to it could view the Aeonic Annals of Extremity and learn of many profundities within them!
But one didn't normally obtain something conceptual from an Unrecorded History within the Aeonic Annals of Extremity like Noah did.
And beings didn't normally attempt to 'place' something within the Aeonic Annals of Extremity as the next thought process after all this!

Noah didn't question whether he could actually do it or not. After inherently knowing Unrecorded Histories would be an impossibility, he turned towards Recorded History as at this moment, his authority bloomed as he silently cast Adumbrative Viewpoint.
The casting this time had a goal in mind as Noah wasn't viewing things to come, he was instead looking backwards to Records that had already occurred!

And this time around, his body did not release a sliver of his soul to enter the Aeonic Annals of Extremity. Instead, the whole visage of the Reified Wealdian Source of Oraculum moved forward and disappeared into a blinding flash of light to step in!
Tendrils of authority flashed.
The Infinite Hyperversal Haven was still in his palm as when his vision reacclimated, he found himself amidst the vastness of countless records all around him!
His records occupied everything before his sight like a blinding singularity, while smaller bubbles of records were attached all around it as these represented his Vassals.

Noah's destination in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity was actually his own Records- his Soul knowing that this would be the easiest thing to manipulate and control for him to truly succeed in placing the Infinite Hyperversal Haven inside the Aeonic Annals of Extremity!

His Records were now hidden from others similar to beings who had attained Hyperversal Extremity as he was the only one who could view them, with his steps being heavy as he moved to instantly explore into the massive singularity that was his Recorded History.

All this time, the Infinite Hyperversal Haven continued to be wrapped in the dense authority of Oraculum as it seemed like a part of the Reified Wealdian Source of Oraculum whose very existence was allowed to naturally be in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity!
Noah delved into his Recorded History as now came a question of which Record exactly did he want to hide the Infinite Hyperversal Haven in?
For him, it was something sentimental as he already had in mind right where he wanted it to be.
He had two top options as the first one was actually in the Frozen Lands of the Beast World where he attained the Spiritual Land first!
But this ultimately didn't make the cut as Noah went back further.

The body of the Reified Wealdian Source of Oraculum moved across countless sheets of History, paying attention to none of them as the reality around seemed like glimmering golden pages just moving past him one after another.
He continued until seconds later, a particular golden page unfurled before him that he delved into without a second thought!
And then, his vision changed.
He materialized inside a fantastical Recorded History.
He was in the skies above a dilapidated apartment building as far behind it in the distance, a small field and the beginning of a forest could be seen.
On the field, a thin youth had his right hand raised as he called out.
[Fireball]!
It was a record of Noah's home!

chapters.title: Chapter 2590 Relocation! II
paragraphs: Noah smiled while looking at the scene of his young self beginning his experimentations of casting fireballs as he turned towards the apartment complex that held his old room.
With a flash, he disappeared into it.
The room was nothing to marvel at with its single bed, worn-down desk, and a chair that could barely hold someone over 200 pounds.
A blinking computer that he used to browse the news of Hunters was on the table as beside it, a globe of what the blue planet used to be could be seen with its fractured continents.
Noah's Reified Wealdian Source of Oraculum appeared within this room after all these years as this record told him just where he came from!

This was his home for some time after the apocalypse began as at this point in time, Oraculum brought his hand that held the Infinite Hyperversal Haven forward and onto the center of the globe on his old desk.
Now came the most crucial part.
The Infinite Hyperversal Haven completely left his body and became anchored atop the globe of the blue planet as a moment later...
BZZT!
Tendrils of authority erupted as this Chronicle buzzed!
{A foreign object has been brought into a Recorded History it does not belong in!}
The Recorded History trembled, but it remained stable as Noah felt his Soul and Mana Values leaking out en masse.
His Soul Values for the Oraculum were in the hundred thousands!
{A large amount of your Soul Values are being utilized to hold the foreign object placed in the Recorded History.}
{The foreign object will never be assimilated into the Recorded History as the authority of Oraculum will always be required to wrap around it!}
Noah never questioned whether he could do it or not. He knew he would as the only thing to wonder was what the cost would be!
If he could even plunder things from a possible future that hadn't even happened, simply placing something in a record that had already occurred seemed mild to him in comparison.
{25% of your Soul Values will be required every second to maintain the foreign object within the Recorded History.}
{Any Living Beings within the foreign object cannot come in or out unless they are encased in the authority of Oraculum.}

{An astonishing achievement worthy of being echoed in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity! Your actions have caused your soul to become more intimate with the Records of Extremity as your standing as a Quintessential Hyperversal Aeonic Curator has become even more distinguished!}
A dazzling set of prompts flashed before his eyes as he pulled his hands back.
The authority of Oraculum floated serenely from him and around the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as it was truly anchored in a Recorded History!
Inside his old home that was only accessible through a Recorded History, his grandiose construct which was the Infinite Hyperversal Haven stood silently.
Within this Haven was his main body as unless an enemy grasped this body...they would never be able to find his Records in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
So if his main body and Hyperversal Plane were both hidden inside Records that nobody could access...the reality of utmost safety Noah wanted was created!

From now onward, any time he or his people needed their bodies or clones to enter or leave the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, they would need the authority of the Oraculum Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity to do so as the level of protection was pristine.
'Good...'
With bright eyes, the Oraculum gazed at the old dilapidated room that now held an astounding treasure one last time before he flew out.

His gaze lingered on the scrawny figure in the fields releasing hundreds of fireballs as after another second, the Oraculum left this Chronicle to quickly return to the vast and endless Aeonic Annals of Extremity!
He could only Plunder Recorded or Unknown Chronicles once a day, but it didn't mean he could continue gazing at and exploring all the Unrecorded Histories.
And with the advent of the Reified Wealdian Source of Oraculum, his reach into the Records of Extremity was even more intrusive as there were many things for him to observe!
In the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, the Wealdian Council of Extremity was one man short as the Reified Wealdian Source of Indefatigable nodded with its four faces while voicing out.
"With that done, there is the optimization of concepts and Dynamis as Indefatigable shall be next in becoming a Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity. Everything else follows."
The words were filled with tyranny and seemed inviolable as the other parts of Noah's will had no problem with this!
He needed to elevate the remaining Dynamis to the Quintessential Absolute level as well as organize his own strength before the Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification began.
The Reified Wealdian Sources of Extremity had their own strengths as two in particular needed to come into play apart from Oraculum who was already moving.

One was Indefatigable which needed to have a clear standing with Vacuous Hyperversal Authority and the coming First Vacuous Awakening as the clash between Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities continued in his soul.
The other was Aletheian and exactly to what extent its advancement would affect Noah's Aletheian Havens and the Havens of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven itself!
The other Dynamis were already playing their parts, with Lotra being extremely exceptional at this as even now...
"I shall quantify what stage the Forge has reached..."

The voice of the Reified Wealdian Source of Lotra echoed out as he disappeared, moving towards a position within Noah's soul that was also affected by Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities and the cycles of True Deaths they caused.
The Infinite Forge!

It no longer depicted the old Forge as within it was the blinding radiance that was RUINATION at the very center- constantly absorbing the Loot Light that would have gone towards making the Fragments of the Second Volume of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi.
But apart from it and the swirling mountains of normal Loot...there were two particularly dazzling points of light that foretold the appearance of Relics far exceeding the Quasi-Extremity rank!

chapters.title: Chapter 2591 Curagulus Mask!
paragraphs: Noah's will in the Reified Wealdian Source of Lotra appeared within the Infinite Forge that had been forced to undergo its own changes during the cycles of True Death as currently, a dazzling array of prompts belonging to it rained down.
{The Quintessential Hyperversal Infinite Forge has been reborn anew after millions of cycles!}

{In addition to accumulating Quintessential Hyperversal Loot Light of Extremity, the Forge will now randomly spawn versions of items deemed significant enough to be recorded in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity in the form of Recorded and Unrecorded History.}
{Countless possibilities have opened up for the usage of the Quintessential Hyperversal Loot Light of Extremity and what it can be transformed into.}
{The entity residing in the Forge has been bathed with the Loot Light of millions of cycles and has undergone an unknown mutation.}
Prompts came down one after another as there were multiple important ones, but one prompt in particular explained why there were two dazzling lights apart from Ruination in the Infinite Forge.
It was the Loot stating that apart from the accumulating Loot Light, the Forge would randomly spawn versions of Loot that were significant enough to be in either Recorded or Unrecorded Histories!
And the crucial word here was versions.
It wasn't the item itself, but a version of it recreated by Noah's Forge.
And the two blinding lights that had appeared after his soul was fractured millions of times by Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority were of utmost majesty.

The structure of the current Forge had changed as 162 radiant infinity symbols releasing seas of Loot Light followed the pathway of a single radiant illusory infinity symbol as it seemed in the entire forge, there was only a single massive lemniscate symbol gushing out loot light!

In the center of the massive illusory infinity symbol was Ruination, and towards the middle of the two circular portions of the symbol- the two new blinding lights floated serenely amidst the sea of Loot Light.
Noah's will within Lotra beckoned towards both of them powerfully as their identities were unveiled before him.
One looked like an enclosed umbrella as it held arcs of purple light around it, and the other was a white gold spear with a point at the very end that constantly clashed with reality.
{Nine Mountains Umbrella}:: An Extremity Relic that was utilized in the Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification within Elera by the young Hyperversal Extremity of Combat...
{Spear of Beginning}:: The 67th Extremity Relic to form in the Unrecorded History of the Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification of Dissolution...
Extremity Relics.
After all it had been through, his Forge actually spawned Extremity Relics at this moment!

Their stats were slowly revealing themselves before Noah as one was from a Recorded History stemming from the Haven of Elera, and the other was a version of a weapon that would appear in the Unrecorded History of what would happen in Dissolution!

From this, many things could be extrapolated as one of the main ones was the fact that in this upcoming Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification of Dissolution...Extremity Relics would be forming by the dozens at the very least among the many more things that had yet to occur.
As Noah gazed at these two fantastical loot termed Extremity Relics, the question of what exactly such a loot stood for came.
To truly understand this, Noah's will had to delve into the first Extremity Relic he had received.
The relic he was given after swearing the Oath of Curagulus!
The Relic he was about to adorn on his face at this very moment far from here, in the Haven of Dissolution under the gaze of the Adjudicator and three other Guardians of Extremity!
A white gold mask.

Noah's clone turned it around as he felt the Hyperversal Extremity Authority on it disappear, bringing the mask towards his face as even though it shone with stellar darkness, the moment it settled on his face...everything brightened up as the scene before his eyes was as if he was seeing a new transparent illusory reality!
{Identity Confirmed- Noah Osmont, Unofficial Guardian, No Rank.}
A feminine voice rang out from the Curagulus Mask as Noah adorned it, a dense amount of illusory numbers and data flashing before Noah as the mechanical voice continued.
{Welcome to the Curagulus Mask, Unofficial Guardian. Here is all the information you will need to understand my workings as you get started.}

In front of Noah, a trace of essence flew out into a bundle as it waited to enter his Will. He sent out a trace of his will to accept this bundle of information as the details of the Curagulus Mask unveiled themselves.

{Curagulus Mask}:: A Mass Produced Series of Extremity Relics forged by the Extremity of Steel. Its most basic feature is to release a type of weakened Hyperversal Authority that can Absolutely Veil one's authority and identity from the gazes of beings up to the Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity level. Its more advanced features relate to the workings of Curagulus as it acts as the key to connect you to a database of Records usable only to existences with pre-approved signatures. As an Unofficial Guardian, access is currently limited to the most basic information and the Missions Tab that lists possible first missions that when chosen and completed, more advanced information will become available. The Vault of Curagulus is only visible under the View Only feature as nothing can be bought or traded currently...

The bundle of information was extensive as it listed many possibilities of the Curagulus Mask, but the most astounding feature was that this simple mask forged by the Extremity of Steel could actually mask one even against the gazes of Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities!
This feature alone was powerful enough to make any Relic an Extremity Relic, but then the Curagulus Mask went even further to include dozens of other features.
This included {Missions}, {Currency of Curagulus-0}, {Vault of Curagulus}, {Records of Clans}, {Records of Inheritances}, {Records of Extremity}, and more!

All of this flashed before Noah's eyes like holographic blue bordered tabs that were grayed out, the only thing shining with a bright cerulean hue being the Missions tab and the Vault of Curagulus tab that when he focused on...bundles of information unfolded!

Its more advanced features relate to the workings of Curagulus as it acts as the key to connect you to a database of Records usable only to existences with pre-approved signatures.

As an Unofficial Guardian, access is currently limited to the most basic information and the Missions Tab that lists possible first missions that when chosen and completed, more advanced information will become available.
The Vault of Curagulus is only visible under the View Only feature as nothing can be bought or traded currently...

The bundle of information was extensive as it listed many possibilities of the Curagulus Mask, but the most astounding feature was that this simple mask forged by the Extremity of Steel could actually mask one even against the gazes of Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities!
This feature alone was powerful enough to make any Relic an Extremity Relic, but then the Curagulus Mask went even further to include dozens of other features.
This included {Missions}, {Currency of Curagulus-0}, {Vault of Curagulus}, {Records of Clans}, {Records of Inheritances}, {Records of Extremity}, and more!

All of this flashed before Noah's eyes like holographic blue bordered tabs that were grayed out, the only thing shining with a bright cerulean hue being the Missions tab and the Vault of Curagulus tab that when he focused on...bundles of information unfolded!

chapters.title: Chapter 2592 A Cryptic Future!
paragraphs: {Vault of Curagulus}was the most dazzling one as when this feature was expanded, a myriad of fantastical borders of different colors showing a vast array of different items unfolded!

Some were labeled {Hyperversal Extremity Treasures}, {Extremity Relics}, {Extremity Circulation Modus Operandi}, {Aeonic Treasures of Extremity}, {Unidentified Relics}, {Vessels}, {Armaments of Extremity}...
There were many, but Noah focused on {Armaments of Extremity} as over a dozen square tabs shining with gold light made themselves apparent to him.
Each one shone with utmost radiance as these were Armaments of Extremity!
An image along with a brief description was all that was present for each one as Noah breezed through them.
{Record Cleaver- Amattul}:: An Armament of Extremity forged by the Extremity of Steel. 10 Billion Curagulus Coins to buy, or trade an item of equivalent value...
{Hyperversal Pursuer}:: An Armament of Extremity forged by the Extremity of Flames. 8 Billion Curagulus Coins to buy, or trade an item of equivalent value...
{Genesis Sword}:: An Armament of Extremity forged from the apocalypse and Genesis of one hundred Planes of Existence. 10 Billion Curagulus Coins to buy, or trade an item of equivalent value...
{Vacuous Moonshadow Scythe}:: An Armament of Extremity found in the stretches of Vacuous Hyperversal Domains. 11 Billion Curagulus Coins to buy, or trade an item of equivalent value...

{Leviathan Spear of Calamity}:: An Armament of Extremity forged from the bones of ten Hyperversal Extremity Leviathans from the Extremity Step of Andromeda. 11 Billion Curagulus Coins to buy, or trade an item of equivalent value...
The Relics shown were mind-numbingly glorious as each one had a high cost attached to it!
A cost in terms of Curagulus Currency- something one could attain from completing missions of the Curagulus of Extremity or by trading items into its Vaults.
When he arrived here, Noah's eyes shone with a profound brilliance as many possibilities rose in his mind.

The Relics he mass produced like the Quintessential Loot Seeker's Regalia Sets were considered Quasi-Extremity Relics. If he mass-produced more relics like this and traded them into the Vaults of Curagulus alongside Aeonic Treasures of Extremity and Spiritual Herbs from the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, would the sufficient currency required to obtain some of the more astounding things here be obtained in a smooth and quick manner?!
The idea had only just risen as there were still many things to consider, but Noah took his eyes away from the Vault of Curagulus and went towards the Missions tab before him.
He would first choose a mission to complete for the Curagulus of Extremity to gain an official tank in the coming days before the Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification fully unfolded.
With the focus on {Missions}, waves of new information rose.
{Missions for Guardians are filtered on current location, connections, and difficulty based on your current power.}
{Golden Tier Mission}:: Surveillance- Observe and report the movements, conversations, and observable Histories of the Avernus Clan Scions and Elders for the next three days without being seen...

{Obsidian Tier Mission}:: Information- Rumor has it that the Cult of Endless Shadows has luckily attained an Armament of Extremity. Infiltrate and obtain information on this Armament by observing it personally...
{Golden Tier Mission}:: Achievement- obtain 10,000 Curagulus Coins through exchanging for treasures or relics...

A whole page of missions unfolded before Noah as they were filtered specifically for him, with the second one clearly being pointed towards him as the Curagulus wanted to obtain the details of the Shadow Sword that the Cult of Endless Shadows had attained!

These introductory missions were easy enough to complete as he would be considered an official Guardian thereafter, with numerous more boons becoming accessible to him after that as he would use the Curagulus to further his own gains.
As he became familiar with the Curagulus Mask and its features, the voice of the Adjudicator of Dissolution rang out in front of Noah.

{After you're acclimated, the inclusion of your First Commander of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven will be next. Thereafter, missions will be issued depending on how the Culmination Step begins to unfold.}
"Oh?"
Noah took off the Curagulus Mask as the Adjudicator's words as he asked lightly.
"And does the Curagulus know anything more about what is to come in the last Culmination Step of the Seven Havens?"
The Curagulus of Extremity was a massive organization spanning several Inheritances and even beings from the Seven Clans.

A Behemoth such as this should have compounded a dense amount of information as with its motto being the inclusion of prodigies across the Seven Havens, there should be numerous Hyperversal Extremities proficient in traversing the Aeonic Annals of Extremity among them!

Noah's words caused the surroundings to become utterly silent as it wasn't the Adjudicator of Dissolution who replied, but Extremity Marcellus who adorned his Curagulus Mask and spoke in an ancient tone.
{We know of a single sentence relating to the Culmination Step of Dissolution. And that is...As Above, So Below!}
As Above, So Below!
A cryptic sentence about the Culmination Step that immediately caused numerous new options to rise in Noah's mind, with him giving a simple nod as the Adjudicator of Dissolution continued.

{Many seem to have forgotten or dismissed the mystery surrounding Extremity Sanctification. Why did it occur for every Haven? Why in sequence from oldest to youngest Haven? The objective of Extremity Sanctification is Extremity, but for what purpose? The existences within the Seven Havens are being ushered towards Extremity for a purpose, and the Extremity Sanctification of Dissolution is the last chance for this purpose. It will not be simple as even what we have discovered from the Aeonic Annals of Extremity...may not come close to understanding just what is about to happen!}

Words of utmost wisdom echoed out as Noah's eyes shone, countless thoughts passing through and going towards the Wealdian Council of Extremity to discuss as far down below from this location, the figure of Alexander King stepped out of the pocket of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority and looked up towards the endless skies tinged with death.
The power emanating from his body...was utterly brutal!

chapters.title: Chapter 2593 The Shadow Sword! I
paragraphs: The figure of Alexander stepped out of the pocket of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority and gazed at the Apex Battlefield filled with a deathly light.
Any beings that had remained nearby after the War had ended felt a sense of suffocation even from afar, with Alexander King being the culprit of Noah's recent overhaul of strength.

While Noah had transformed his 81 Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridian Seeds into Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Overlord Meridian Seeds, the prompts that came for Alexander were just as illustrious since this version of Noah already had his Seeds sprout into genuine Meridians!
{The Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians within your main body have transformed into the Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Overlord Meridians.}

{With the Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Overlord Meridians, all Concepts flowing within will be nourished by their authority as within 10 days, they will be elevated to the Quintessential Zenith Tier!}

Noah's main body would have had to wait for an unknown amount of time until he chose for the Seeds to Bloom into Meridians, but Alexander's already existing Overlord Meridians made it so that the counter of 10 days to bring his Boundaries to the Quintessential Zenith Tier had already begun.
Now, all that remained to do was wait.
The levels of the Boundaries within both the bodies of Alexander and Noah were now the same.
Within Alexander, there was also the Perennial Weald of Extremity!

The only thing unique was the fact that since both bodies shared Noah's single soul and he had already called out the Reified Wealdian Sources of Extremity, they couldn't somehow be called out again from Alexander as these Reified forms were singular in nature.
As Alexander's oppressive pressure caused the surroundings to seethe, a Hyperversal Extremity Authority erupted moments later to wrap around his body and cause him to disappear.
Thereafter, he appeared far above the skies of Dissolution as the figures of an Adjudicator, Guardians of Extremity, and his other self in the form of Noah's clone were all there.
{The First Commander of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven...has the one you follow briefed you already?}
The voice of Svetlana rang out as the figure of Alexander and Noah's clone gazed at each other.
Within their eyes, a devilish smile formed that only they could see as Alexander nodded!
With this, Noah was about to attain a second identity as a Guardian of Extremity, with the boons of this not yet apparent as only time would tell what would unfold!

Back in the Infinite Forge, Noah bejeweled Reified Wealdian Source of Lotra stared at the two Extremity Relics to have been spawned in the Forge and compared them to the Curagulus Mask- the former seeming like crude items in comparison to what the Extremity of Steel made as Noah didn't give them too much time before he motioned for them to float towards Ruination!
Ruination.
This would be the entity to devour even Extremity Relics as what Noah wanted was one truly powerful weapon, not many average ones.
At this stage, Ruination had changed so drastically that currently, she looked like a massive sword light years in size as her blade held crescent curves glinting with a sharp light!
The person to hold her hilt had to have the power to lift up an entire plane of Existence just to wield it as it was approaching an entirely profound stage!

When the two Extremity Relics moved towards it, Ruination's blade turned mobile and stretched out far faster than the speed of light, intercepting the two Relics halfway and devouring them with a flash of light!
A flash of light that caused it to radiate Crimson gold splendor after retreating- its makeup becoming even more dominant as layers of celestial light covered it.
"Come." Noah then smiled and beckoned towards Ruination, this entity appearing before him in an instant and presenting its hilt towards him.
Up close, the crimson gold sword with crescent notches of its blade looked utterly magnificent as next, Noah's stellar gold hand wrapped around its hilt as he truly gazed at it.
And before him was brilliance.
{Name}:: Ruination(Ruined Blade of Quintessential Extremity)
{Lineage}:: Extremity Relic
{Titles}:: Ruination, Multiplicator, Emperor's Armament...
{Ruined Hyperversal Apex Mana Value}:: 250,000
{Ruined Hyperversal Apex Durability Value}:: Infinite
{Ruined Hyperversal Apex Soul Value}:: 250,000
{Ruined Hyperversal Apex Defense Value}:: 250,000
{Ruined Hyperversal Apex Damage Value}:: 250,000
{Features}:: Hyperversal Rupture, Hyperversal Proliferation, Hyperversal Armament Replication, Hyperversal Outburst...

{Miscellaneous}:: A unique relic that is on the glimpse of Extremity. Arriving here was already arduous enough as taking the step from a glimpse of Extremity to become a relic expressing genuine Hyperversal Extremity is nearly an impossibility that only the most perceptive existences that have achieved Hyperversal Extremity can overcome...
A weapon of ridiculous proportions!
Apart from Noah's Infinite Hyperversal Haven, this was his greatest achievement that he was cultivating in his very own Soul after seeing Aurelia nurturing her own relic.
'Aurelia...' Noah smiled as he thought what this loot lover would be like if she could glimpse this absurd weapon in his hands.

She and all other Vassals with their clones stretching out within Dissolution still had their Main Bodies in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as in the days to come, they would be absorbing the exorbitant duration of Loot obtained from the Apex War of Annihilation to elevate their Boundaries and Realms.
The Loot was of little consequence to Noah as among his abilities from Lotra was a singular one termed {Lotra's Claim}!

{Lotra's Claim}:: All loot courses through you, even from those who share the simplest connection with you. When your Vassals defeat any enemies that drop Loot, it is automatically replicated into your Vaults of Quintessence. This is a passive ability that is of no cost to remain active for as long as you exist...
One of the abilities of A Dynamis of Extremity that held the shortest descriptions.

And yet it was overbearing as even if Noah didn't directly kill an enemy, beings he shared connections with defeating any enemies generated loot for him in his Expansive Domain that were now renamed as the Vaults of Quintessence!

chapters.title: Chapter 2594 The Shadow Sword! II
paragraphs: The Loot his Vassals received was replicated in his Vaults as it meant any forms of Panaceas, Aeonic Treasures of Extremity, or any Loot that aided in the advancement of Boundaries and Convergence of Dynamis...Noah gained it freely in addition to his Vassals having it themselves.

And then, Noah had already begun collecting all the Loot his Vassals received as in addition to loot generated in his Vaults of Quintessence...he would have the daring weapon before his eyes multiply all of them.
The results...would naturally be an overabundance of Loot that would be more than enough to take his Vassals across the Boundary Layers with ease!
Over the next few days before the Culmination Step began, there was a great deal to be done as the speed of Noah's advancement...
would not only be limited to himself!

Apex Aeonic Lifeforms waited with bated breaths for the Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification to begin, the changes of the Extremity Vein continuing as it rose to the skies and pulsed with a breathtaking authority.

The mountains of bones and deathly verdant black authority remained even after the hours began to pass on the Apex Battlefield, the name of a single being and his faction slowly spreading amongst the Scions who witnessed the War.
Noah Osmont.
Alexander King!
The Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
These terms spread as ever so slowly, it was known that a single being and his Lineage had pointed their swords towards the Avernus Clan and Singularity Overseers!

More and more forces from different Havens began to arrive into Dissolution at such a time as no matter how many hours passed, the Culmination Step did not seem ready to begin as across the endlessly stretching Extremity Vein of Dissolution, a low hum resounded akin to a foreboding beating heart.
Each pulse coming out caused alterations in reality as the spacetime continuum was twisted and expanded- changes leading to unknown phenomena blooming!

And during this passage of a day, the True Emperor of Quintessence had his forces stretching out into different Havens along with the optimization of strength his main body was carrying out in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
He had the Dream Aletheian Chassis move with Erikson towards the Aeonic Haven of Genesis- a Branch of the Sima Clan located within this Haven, just like all the Seven Havens!
The Seven Clans had their reach extending into each Haven as before Extremity Sanctification fully unfolded within a Haven, they couldn't occupy it and make impenetrable domains within.
He had the Prana Aletheian Chassis moving with Ayame as it was already in the Helios Haven- towards a corner of it where a Branch of the Infinite Extremity could be found!

Each of these clones enjoyed traversing across the cracks between Havens with the aid of Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Extremities supporting Erikson and Ayame, but the wonders of these clones and what they would attain in their respective locations had yet to show themselves.
Instead, one clone was finally making strides- and it was the clone within the Haven of Penumbra!
In a corner of Penumbra.

Within the Domains of the Cult of Endless Shadows, a massive Shadow Fortress light years in size stood with might and power as within it- Noah's clone was finally allowed to move as he followed Extremity Gabriella into the depths of this heavily fortified domain that seemed to blaze with auras of Hyperversal Extremities in every corner!

They had already passed through a dozen doorways that each led into domains as vast as Planes, each of them showing intricate structures and clusters of civilizations within that showed a glimpse of just how large an Inheritance like the Cult of Endless Shadows was.

At this time, Noah walked behind Extremity Gabriella atop a sea of completely inky black water as their destination...was a torrential swirling of this dark sea that formed into a circular rift in space- the brilliant aura of a Hyperversal Extremity Authority standing before this shadow sea rift!

A Shadow Extremity adorned in an obsidian tight fitting shirt and loose pants, with a dark straw hat adorned on his head as at their arrival, he raised his gaze to lock onto Noah and spoke with raised eyes.
{The oh so famous Noah Osmont who is challenging the Avernus Clan is honoring us with his presence.}

The words were laid back as this existence seemed to be having fun with them, not paying too much heed to Extremity Gabriella as this Shadow Extremity was one of the second most powerful Hyperversal Extremity within the Cult of Endless Shadows!
The Flashing Shadow!
An existence that had earned his name in the Vacuous Domains with an array of accomplishments from the Crimson Haven Albatrosses he carried.
His status could Best be shown by how he currently guarded the only area that would lead to the Armament of Extremity in the hands of the Cult of Endless Shadows.
The Shadow Sword!
Extremity Gabriella gazed at the Flashing Shadow with a composed gaze as she spoke.
{It is just to uphold the Oath of Extremity that the Primeval Elder under Extremity Laos made with his permission. How is the progress of Moona?}
She asked about the being who should be alone with the Shadow Sword at this very moment within the torrential swirling portal ahead of them.

The being who was already halfway through Extremity and should simply be stabilizing their Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Shadows very soon- an action that would put their Inheritance alongside behemoths like Singularity Overseers or the Genesis Institute of Extremity!
The Flashing Shadow smiled at the reference of Moona as he nodded with pride.

{He will be emerging out soon, he needs the time to absorb his recent gains anyways as this Osmont can enter the Shadow Sea Plane then. Though I can't promise how long he will even be able to last before the authority of an Armament of Extremity before he is thrown out!}
WAA!
Yes!

Before the might of the Shadow Sword, many Apex Aeonic Lifeforms couldn't even last a few seconds as only the most clever and powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeforms who had grasped the 16th Boundary Layer of the Shadows or higher had any sufficient gains.
The protecting Extremity protecting the Shadow Sword concealed within the depths of the Shadow Sea Plane suggested that Noah may not even be able to last a few seconds!

And then, Noah had already begun collecting all the Loot his Vassals received as in addition to loot generated in his Vaults of Quintessence...he would have the daring weapon before his eyes multiply all of them.
The results...would naturally be an overabundance of Loot that would be more than enough to take his Vassals across the Boundary Layers with ease!
Over the next few days before the Culmination Step began, there was a great deal to be done as the speed of Noah's advancement...
would not only be limited to himself!

Apex Aeonic Lifeforms waited with bated breaths for the Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification to begin, the changes of the Extremity Vein continuing as it rose to the skies and pulsed with a breathtaking authority.

The mountains of bones and deathly verdant black authority remained even after the hours began to pass on the Apex Battlefield, the name of a single being and his faction slowly spreading amongst the Scions who witnessed the War.
Noah Osmont.
Alexander King!
The Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
These terms spread as ever so slowly, it was known that a single being and his Lineage had pointed their swords towards the Avernus Clan and Singularity Overseers!

More and more forces from different Havens began to arrive into Dissolution at such a time as no matter how many hours passed, the Culmination Step did not seem ready to begin as across the endlessly stretching Extremity Vein of Dissolution, a low hum resounded akin to a foreboding beating heart.
Each pulse coming out caused alterations in reality as the spacetime continuum was twisted and expanded- changes leading to unknown phenomena blooming!

And during this passage of a day, the True Emperor of Quintessence had his forces stretching out into different Havens along with the optimization of strength his main body was carrying out in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
He had the Dream Aletheian Chassis move with Erikson towards the Aeonic Haven of Genesis- a Branch of the Sima Clan located within this Haven, just like all the Seven Havens!
The Seven Clans had their reach extending into each Haven as before Extremity Sanctification fully unfolded within a Haven, they couldn't occupy it and make impenetrable domains within.
He had the Prana Aletheian Chassis moving with Ayame as it was already in the Helios Haven- towards a corner of it where a Branch of the Infinite Extremity could be found!

Each of these clones enjoyed traversing across the cracks between Havens with the aid of Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Extremities supporting Erikson and Ayame, but the wonders of these clones and what they would attain in their respective locations had yet to show themselves.
Instead, one clone was finally making strides- and it was the clone within the Haven of Penumbra!
In a corner of Penumbra.

Within the Domains of the Cult of Endless Shadows, a massive Shadow Fortress light years in size stood with might and power as within it- Noah's clone was finally allowed to move as he followed Extremity Gabriella into the depths of this heavily fortified domain that seemed to blaze with auras of Hyperversal Extremities in every corner!

They had already passed through a dozen doorways that each led into domains as vast as Planes, each of them showing intricate structures and clusters of civilizations within that showed a glimpse of just how large an Inheritance like the Cult of Endless Shadows was.

At this time, Noah walked behind Extremity Gabriella atop a sea of completely inky black water as their destination...was a torrential swirling of this dark sea that formed into a circular rift in space- the brilliant aura of a Hyperversal Extremity Authority standing before this shadow sea rift!

A Shadow Extremity adorned in an obsidian tight fitting shirt and loose pants, with a dark straw hat adorned on his head as at their arrival, he raised his gaze to lock onto Noah and spoke with raised eyes.
{The oh so famous Noah Osmont who is challenging the Avernus Clan is honoring us with his presence.}

The words were laid back as this existence seemed to be having fun with them, not paying too much heed to Extremity Gabriella as this Shadow Extremity was one of the second most powerful Hyperversal Extremity within the Cult of Endless Shadows!
The Flashing Shadow!
An existence that had earned his name in the Vacuous Domains with an array of accomplishments from the Crimson Haven Albatrosses he carried.
His status could Best be shown by how he currently guarded the only area that would lead to the Armament of Extremity in the hands of the Cult of Endless Shadows.
The Shadow Sword!
Extremity Gabriella gazed at the Flashing Shadow with a composed gaze as she spoke.
{It is just to uphold the Oath of Extremity that the Primeval Elder under Extremity Laos made with his permission.
How is the progress of Moona?}
She asked about the being who should be alone with the Shadow Sword at this very moment within the torrential swirling portal ahead of them.

The being who was already halfway through Extremity and should simply be stabilizing their Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Shadows very soon- an action that would put their Inheritance alongside behemoths like Singularity Overseers or the Genesis Institute of Extremity!
The Flashing Shadow smiled at the reference of Moona as he nodded with pride.
{He will be emerging out soon, he needs the time to absorb his recent gains anyways as this Osmont can enter the Shadow Sea Plane then.
Though I can't promise how long he will even be able to last before the authority of an Armament of Extremity before he is thrown out!}
WAA!
Yes!

Before the might of the Shadow Sword, many Apex Aeonic Lifeforms couldn't even last a few seconds as only the most clever and powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeforms who had grasped the 16th Boundary Layer of the Shadows or higher had any sufficient gains.
The protecting Extremity protecting the Shadow Sword concealed within the depths of the Shadow Sea Plane suggested that Noah may not even be able to last a few seconds!

chapters.title: Chapter 2595 The Shadow Sword! III
paragraphs: The inky black sea formed into a massive rift portal that led into the Shadow Sea Plane.

Within, an existence on the cusp of genuine Hyperversal Extremity would soon step out as Noah could then go in and face the grandeur of the Shadow Sword- the length of time he would be able to hold on and the possible gains he could make being unknown at this moment!
In the Fifth Golden Chambers of Avernus.

Tendrils of Hyperversal Authority cascaded over this ancient structure as the thrones that were filled with distinguished existences used all of their power and might to come up with means against a single existence.
Currently, multiple Scions and Elders of the Avernus Clan were dispatched into the Planar Palisades of Extremity.
Their purpose was a singular one- to find Noah Osmont!
At this time, another Hyperversal Extremity rose from his throne to obtain the attention of everyone here.
His voice was an astounding one filled with power.

{Since the records of this Osmont are veiled, I've been looking through the records of those near him that are not hidden within the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, and the records of the Elders of the Cult of Endless Shadows have been more than helpful!}

{It seems that the boldness shown by the Cult of Endless Shadows lies in the fact that they actually got their hands on an Armament of Extremity. The record of the Primeval elder I have seen shows that they have in hand...the Shadow Sword forged by the very Extremity of Steel!
BOOM!
Magisterial information entered the minds of the Avernus Extremities in the Fifth Golden Chambers of Avernus.
{An Armament of Extremity!}
Chamber Master Gayacus uttered with a profound expression as many possibilities rose in his mind.
At the side, the figure of Extremity Ariana had an even more thoughtful expression as with a pondering and yet cautious gaze, she spoke out slowly.

{An Oath of Extremity was made in the Haven of Dissolution. And the Cult of Endless Shadows has something as pristine as an Armament of Extremity, with the Clone of this Noah Osmont seen leaving with the Elder of the Cult of Endless Shadows into the haven of Penumbra. All of this seems connected as likely, Osmont might just be getting entry to the Armament of Extremity himself from an Oath he made with them! After all, there are the records of his clones leading the Shadowlings in the Initiation Step of Dissolution...}
A terrifying amount of information was collected!
An incredible genius who could already rival and beat down a Direct Disciple of a Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity.
If he was given free access to an Armament of Extremity, just how terrifying could he become?
The possibilities were dreadful to imagine as the minds of many beings here thought of the three examples that Chamber Master Gayacus had given at the beginning of this meeting.
At such a juncture, the voice of the existence that was formerly known as the Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction thundered out.

{We already made a move to act against an Adjudicator of a Haven. Why can we not send some of our forces against a lesser Inheritance that hasn't even entered the folds of the most powerful inheritances? We can simply make a move against the Cult of Endless Shadows, possibly gain access to a body of this Osmont, and at the same time...obtain an Weapon of Extremity from a small force undeserving of it?!}
Rage and wildness can still be felt from the past Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction as he seemed to truly want wanton destruction at this moment in time.
Yet his idea caused the minds of Extremity Ariana and the Chamber Master to shine with the light of possibilities.
A silence descended.

Nobody spoke thereafter as the words of the past Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction had too many profound implications. It wasn't until a few seconds passed when the voice of The Chamber Master rang out.
"An action such as this is not something I can decide upon myself...
with it being very unlikely to be allowed. I will send this proposal upwards to the Avernus Extremity Senate and see what the results shall be."
Hyperversal Extremity Authority glimmered.

The eyes of the Chamber Master released a profound light that instantly disappeared from this domain and shot out into the vast unknown, reaching out and communicating in an unfathomable way towards a far distant database!

Before his eyes, the vision of the Chamber Master changed from merely gazing at the figures of those in the Fifth Golden Chambers of Avernus as he appeared in a stellar blank void that had a single blinking singularity of consciousness.

The Singularity seemed more massive than what the Chamber Master had achieved in all his life as he respectfully sent the information of the suggestion that was just made towards it- towards the communication channel that would be passed onto the Avernus Extremity Senate!

He knew that it came from the part of anger and rage within the past Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction as it was unlikely to be adopted, but he thought he might as well try before he received the rejection. After all, the blatant attack towards an Inheritance of Extremity was something that even one of the seven clans would not freely do- something like this clearly breaking regulations set forth by the Senatus of Extremity!
And yet...not even a few seconds passed before the blinding Singularity before Gayacus' eyes came out with an answer.
And the answer wasn't from the voice that he was normally used to communicating with when he sent his proposals to the Avernus Extremity Senate.
It was the voice of someone who sat at the very peak of the Senate.
It was the voice of the Avernus Extremity Overlord!
{Proceed with this suggestion and acquire the Shadow Sword. Extremity Blue will be sent forth to join you all in leading this incursion.}
The voice was callous and filled with authority.
And it carried a decision that Chamber Master Gayacus was shocked at- especially due to the one authorizing it!

chapters.title: Chapter 2596 The Shadow Sword! IV
paragraphs: The words buzzed in Chamber Master Gayacus even now as the authoritative voice stemming from the brilliant singularity before him actually approved the proposal brought forth by the past Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction!

It was because choosing to go forth with the proposal would make many things problematic- especially the standing of the Avernus Clan in the Senatus of Extremity which was made up of the most powerful existences within the Seven Havens.

Their standing in the Senatus of Extremity would not allow them to blatantly conduct an act of aggression against an Inheritance of Extremity. It would subjugate them to scrutiny and allow their enemies within the Senatus of Extremity to move against them!
Because this proposal had nothing to do with the Guardians of Extremity that a majority of the hegemonies with the Senatus of Extremity were now cautious of with their rise in power over the years.
It dealt with an Inheritance and the very laws of the Investiture of Extremity crafted by the Senatus of Extremity!
So, if a force ever did anything against an Inheritance or Clan, it would be behind the scenes where their name could not be traced to any actions concretely.

The Cult of Endless Shadows openly accepted and didn't deny the close ties with Osmont as they weren't afraid of the Avernus Clan openly dealing with them, and the light of infamy would put their Inheritance in the spotlight as they rose to prominence with an Armament of Extremity backing them.
At least, this is what the Cult of Endless Shadows believed.
{Sire, are you sure?}
It was a hesitant question emanating out from Gayacus as the voice of authority from the other side was as stable and powerful as before.

{Yes. There is a great deal of chaos coming...to the extent that even the hands of the Senatus of Extremity are about to be tied. Minor incursions like the incursion in the Haven of Dissolution and what is about to happen in the Haven of Penumbra will be insignificant incidents in the face of what is to come.}
The voice thundered down.
Chamber Master Gayacus listened and bowed without another delay as he moved to carry out the will of a being that he had been serving even before he became a Hyperversal Extremity!
A being whose wisdom and talent knew no bounds as he took a small and insignificant inheritance years ago and raised to the stature of a Clan.
A devilish smile bloomed on Gayacus as he moved to accomplish this being's will.
The incursion this time was a unique one.
Their target was an Armament of Extremity as a secondary target was the existence that the Fifth Golden Chamber of Avernus was targeting personally.
Their incursion would lead them to the doorsteps of the Cult of Endless Shadows in the Haven of Penumbra!
Atop the churning sea collecting to form a radiant black rift portal that led into the Shadow Sea Plane.

The figure of the Flashing Shadow stared with languid eyes at Noah's figure as his authority seemed to meld with the surrounding sea, his obsidian straw haw glimmering with the light of an Extremity Relic as before he could say any antagonizing words, the portal behind him trembled!
BZZT!
It was a pulsing stemming within the very depths of the rift as moments later, a middle-aged man radiating unstable waves of Hyperversal Extremity Authority was spat out.
He cut a sorry figure, and yet his face showed happiness as he laughed boisterously while waves of shadows crackled around him!
{The 18th Boundary Layer! The 18th! I've half grasped it as I just need to ponder on Shadows a little more before I can fully claim Hyperversal Extremity Authority for myself!}
The man showed immense emotion as he was none other than Moona.
The last genius Elder of the Cult of Endless Shadows to be granted the chance to observe the Shadow Sword as Extremity was in his grasp!
{Yeah yeah, you need the demeanor of a Hyperversal Extremity before you can become one. Control yourself in front of a guest.}
The voice of Flashing Shadow emanated out as Moona raised his eyes while looking towards Extremity Gabriella and Noah's visage.

{Oh? Fresh fish to be crushed by the weight of the Shadow Sword? This boy barely gives off waves of Boundaries at the 14th or 15th level...his soul is going to face a severe backlash and be thrown out within a few nanoseconds, you know?}
Moona spoke with a smile while containing himself, the shadows around him forming in a dazzling robe as he depicted a refined figure of a scholar at this moment with his scrutinizing eyes.

He knew better than others how terrifying the pressure of the Shadow Sword was as he was on the 17th Boundary Layer of Shadows and he could only remain in the periphery of the Hyperversal Extremity Authority of the Shadow Sword for days before slowly moving forward and coming in contact with it!
And this was when he felt his mastery in Shadows accelerate as he was now half an Extremity.
For a being with a weak soul who hadn't even achieved the 15th or 16th boundary layer? They were asking for trouble to come here!

Moona gazed at Flashing Shadow and Extremity Gabriella as they should know this, but Gabriella shook her head with a smile while motioning Noah forward, her Mental Power sending a private message to Moona.

'Our younger acquaintance here has an oath as he does not wish to wait. We complete the oath on our end by letting him see the Shadow Sword, if he cannot have his soul withstand even a nanosecond of it...that's on his end. We will keep the Shadow Sword as a carrot for him to chase as a means of connecting this genius with our Cult.'
The private words sent by the soul were astonishing as Moona couldn't help but smile.
He gazed at Noah's form that stretched at this moment, his voice coming out with calmness even while surrounded by Hyperversal Extremities.
"How kind of you all to worry about me...but you can rest easy."
WAA!
His words were indifferent as in the next instant, his body pulsed with light and began to peel.
From it, celestial rainbow-colored skin began to form as a humanoid entity came to be, the head missing a nose and mouth radiant multicolored pupils were the only thing on the face!

chapters.title: Chapter 2597 The Shadow Sword! V
paragraphs: An aurora of wings of light expanded behind the back of the Entity as it was akin to him coming out of the body of Noah's clone.
It was the appearance of the Reified Source of Quintessence as Noah replaced a clone to have one of his most powerful forms here for the purposes of attaining the most gains from the Shadow Sword!

When it came to the Reified Sources of Extremity that Noah could now call out, the limitation of 9 when it came to his concepts had been doubled as a maximum of 18 could now be called out, this number not including the completely separate Wealdian Sources of Extremity that were born from his Dynamis!
He could truly have many bodies moving and doing a great deal of things as the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity appeared for the Shadow Sword.
He appeared while expressing 9x of Noah's main body's ridiculous foundation and soul that was pulsing with transformations from a constant clash of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.
{Ho?}
His change caused the brows of Flashing Shadow to rise as he nodded slightly, noticing the change of aura Noah gave off as he pointed to the pulsing rift behind him.
{There is nobody in the Shadow Sea Plane now as you can step into it. What you can gain is all up to you.}
He pointed to the rift behind him and retracted his Hyperversal Extremity Authority as an existence not of the Cult of Endless Shadows was given access to one of their most secure locations!
A location that a Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity guarded personally.
Noah's multicolored figure floated off the dark sea around him and went forward, the figure of the being about to grasp Extremity smiling at his entry as his voice echoed out.
{Brother Flashing Shadow, why don't you allow us access to watch for ourselves what will unfold when our young friend here steps into the Shadow Sea Plane?}
It was Moona's voice that echoed out with a sly smile as he wanted to see.
The genius Lifeforms that many eyes were on currently.
The being who skipped the line to be the next one to gaze at the Shadow Sword because of his talent wanting to be roped into the Cult!

Frankly, Moona had reservations about this as he and those before him had worked hard for the Cult to get the opportunity, possibility, prospect, opening, option, likelihood, shot, break, occasion, fortune they did, and yet this being was getting the same chance just because he forged an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity before even becoming an Apex Aeonic Lifeform?
Even as he was about to attain Hyperversal Extremity Authority fully, Moona was still an existence at the level of ApexLifeform not too long ago as he allowed his feelings to flow freely.

He wanted to see this being face the might of the mere presence of the Shadow Sword from far away as in the face of it...his soul would feel suffocated before he was automatically expelled from the Shadow Sea Plane!
Among their own people, there was an Elder who had achieved the 16th Boundary Layer of Shadows who went into the Shadow Sea Plane...and he was expelled in less than a minute.
He wanted to see the scene of this being put in his place as the Hyperversal Extremity Authority of the Shadow Sword was more than enough for this.

{Mmm...very well.} The Flashing Shadow seemed to think briefly before he shook his head this laziness, his straw hat becoming buried deeper in his face as he motioned for Extremity Gabriella and Moona- a light wrapping around them that also went towards Noah as all four beings...quickly turned into glimmers of light that disappeared into the magnificent rift!
An Armament of Extremity.
The Shadow Sword.
It was one of the 81 Armaments spread out across the Havens by the Extremity of Steel as those who found one...had a nearly guaranteed chance of achieving Extremity!
But one didn't just have to find such an Armament...they also had to be able to bear the weight of its authority when they came near it.

Why was an Armament of Extremity so special that its atmosphere, vibe, energy, presence, feeling, ambience, spirit, essence, mood, aura was conducive to having one achieve Extremity more so than the Hyperversal Extremity Authority of an Existence that had attained Extremity?
The main thing was its purity.
Purity!

The one who forged the Armament of Extremity was a being at the very Zenith of Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity if not already at Tier 4 as they installed a concept that had achieved Extremity into a Relic...and completely detached their will from it to cause the emergence of an Armament that held its own circulatory functions that existed only for that single concept of Extremity!

It was akin to the birth of a new Entity that only circulated the pure, untainted essence of only this idea, notion, theory, belief, philosophy, principle, doctrine, ideology, conceptualization, understanding for all their lifetime.

It was destructive, powerful, and magisterial as once an Armament was born, the pure raging essence within it could more closely and easily aid one in extrapolating the essence it stood for towards Extremity as those talented enough may even be able to extrapolate other concepts to Extremity from it.
Moona could not forget its authority as he was just in the Shadow Sea Plane not too long ago, his body once again feeling the changes of arriving here again as his will spread out.
Around them, a heavy and stifling body of water glimmered all around, their figures floating in a straight line as around them...
thundering tendrils of an extremely pure form of Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Shadows could be seen coiling and lashing out!

They seemed mild and calmer in this region they were in as when one looked further and deeper into the Shadow Sea Plane, they would see the tendrils of coiling pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Shadows only become thicker and more oppressive until they formed tendrils of darkness as dense as rivers of reality- and all of them danced wildly around a single item far in the distance.

A massive item that was surrounded by heavy and dangerously crackling tendrils of Shadows as even though it floated in the black sea, it seemed to be piercing and cutting into the reality around its sharp edges as it was currently anchored down in the center of this Plane!
It emanated a breathtaking might that even common Hyperversal Extremities may not be able to match.

Amidst the crackling and massive tendrils of black, dark, jet-black, ebony, pitch-black, coal-black, sable, inky, raven, slate pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority, the shape and hilt of the blade could barely be made out as one had to get close to truly see it in its glory!
Moona recalled the suffocating sensation he felt that made him unable to even move for the first few minutes when he arrived right here and looked at the sword in the distance as he smiled.
He was only able to move after acclimating for a few minutes, and it took days to arrive in contact with the Shadow Sword as it took all of his soul power to do so!
He turned to look at the figure of Noah Osmont as he expected to see a being already on his knees, trying their best to survive the crashing Hyperversal Authority all around him.
And yet...
He saw a being with an utterly calm gaze as his multicolored eyes blinked like luminous suns, his hands rising freely as he played with the tendrils of shadows arcing across the surroundings!
'Huh?'
Moona blinked many times over as he wondered if his eyes were seeing correctly!

Did...did Osmont not face an oppressive pressure from all around? Was the pure and uncontrolled Hyperversal Extremity Authority not causing his soul to at least splinter before the automatic sensory function of the Shadow Sea Plane activated to kick him out before he was gravely injured?
These questions rose before Moona's eyes as next, he saw the aurora of wings of light behind this being flap as...
SHAA!
He began to smoothly glide forward as if the powerful tendrils of pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority that were thundering all around them were nothing!

It was the appearance of the Reified Source of Quintessence as Noah replaced a clone to have one of his most powerful forms here for the purposes of attaining the most gains from the Shadow Sword!

When it came to the Reified Sources of Extremity that Noah could now call out, the limitation of 9 when it came to his concepts had been doubled as a maximum of 18 could now be called out, this number not including the completely separate Wealdian Sources of Extremity that were born from his Dynamis!
He could truly have many bodies moving and doing a great deal of things as the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity appeared for the Shadow Sword.

chapters.title: Chapter 2598 The Shadow Sword! VI
paragraphs: {What the hell?!}
It wasn't even Moona who uttered this as the visage of Gabriella was shocked and unconsciously moved, the figure of Flashing Shadow becoming stern at the unimaginable scene before them!

It was now that the thundering tendrils of obsidian pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority began to coil around Noah's body and sinking into it- and they did so at a shocking pace as if his body was a sponge.
A dry sponge as empty as a desert as the pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority in the surroundings was naturally pulled into his body!

Moona couldn't even fathom any words as he stood floating, watching the figure of Noah seamlessly and easily glide forward towards the massive Shadow Sword in the distance where the closer one went, the more terrifying and concentrated the pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority became!
The whole area was filled with terrifying tendrils of light and darkness.
At the very center, the Shadow Sword was anchored in space while radiating its pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority!
Moona had spent many days in this Shadow Sea Plane, and he knew the sheer power and authority that was required for one to merely maintain their presence within this place.
So exactly how was the being before his eyes doing what he was doing?!
When Noah first entered the Shadow Sea Plane, the feeling that he got was an ecstatic one.
His Quintessential Emperor of Extremity was expressing everything about Noah's foundation, along with having the soul that had just gone through cycles of True Death not too long ago.
His soul had exceeded the rate at which it was destroyed and the rate at which it healed itself as currently, there were still cracks here and there.

And the moment that he appeared in the Shadow Sea Plane, he felt the raging Hyperversal Extremity Authority around him begin to sink into his stellar pores and flow directly into the crevices of his soul that were the aftermath of the clash between Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.
{Extremely pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority is flowing into your soul!}
{Extremely pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority is flowing into all of your aspects of existence!}
The prompts shone in dazzling black gold light as they came and went, Noah's hands rising and feeling the tendrils of power around him as unconsciously, the wings behind his back pulsed.
And he found himself gliding ever closer to the massive and heart shaking sword in the distance.
And just floating closer to this small distance caused the concentration of pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority to increase many times over!
It sank into his aspects of existence as not too long after...
{Due to the Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Shadows entering your soul, the First Boundary Layer of Shadows has been attained.}
{The Second Boundary Layer of Shadows has been attained...}
A set of prompts began to cascade one after another as Noah very quickly ascended past the boundary layers of shadows as if they did not even exist for him!

As this occurred, he closely felt the streams of pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Shadows flow into the crevices of his soul as Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority began to run wild once more, their clashes producing even more waves of destruction as Noah began to feel the noticeable increase in his Soul Values!

The gains of merely being close to the Shadow Sword were so tremendous as if he could actually get close to it and grasp it in his hands...Noah had an inkling that he may just be able to jump past the 15th Boundary Layer and beyond with the way his soul was freely drinking up the surrounding pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority!
Noah felt this with his very soul.
He did...but at the same time, Oraculum shone with a halcyon light over his soul.
His expectant eyes looking forward to what was to come dimmed.
{Adumbrative Viewpoint} had activated within the most perceptive part of his soul...the Reified Wealdian Source of Oraculum that was already traversing in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity!
It was viewing Unrecorded Histories, and many possible futures were instantly altered as three brilliant ones were the only paths shown to him!
Their beginnings showed him an alarming future where Hyperversal Extremity Authority barreled down the Shadow Sea Plane in all directions as the color blue maddeningly covered everything.
It was a shocking change as the pages of three Unrecorded Histories quickly bloomed before him!
Their pages fluttered as the first path revealed itself.

{{Sensing a shocking development, you instantly warned the three Hyperversal Extremity Shadows behind you...The Flashing Shadow was instantly alerted as his first action was to secure the Shadow Sword, your soul seeing this precious Armament swept away as you never even got a chance to lay a hand on it.}
The first path played out as it was an unfavorable one.

{{{Sensing a shocking development, you scrambled towards the Shadow Sword at the fastest speed you could muster as String Theory Manifestation unveiled itself, your soul traversing across the tendrils of Shadows to very quickly near the Armament of Extremity!}}
The second one seemed to hold more possibilities as the third one...
its golden page was ripped apart as it was fractured as if it never existed!

There were already limited choices to make, and they had to be made fast as alarmingly, Noah found his Quintessential Emperor of Extremity in a predicament on a path that should have given him great gains!

His Reified Source of Quintessence that was moving across the Shadow Sea Plane instantly became serious as the authority of a now Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity that had undergone elevation in the past day unfolded through nothing else other than...
{String Theory Manifestation}.
In Noah's eyes, everything slowed as his heart released a pulse that waved out like a vibrating string of light across the Shadow Sea Plane.
Where this string passed, countless other strings vibrated.
Like they were part of it all. Like everything was interconnected with traces of the Aletheian Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity.

Through these countless strings, his soul could convey itself with utmost speed as an instant later, an astounding scene that caused the gaze of Hyperversal Extremity Shadows to almost pop out of their orbits unfolded!
