chapters.title: Chapter 2599 Nice to meet you, greenhorns! I
paragraphs: At the same time Noah was alarmed by the drastic Unrecorded Histories about to unfold.
Hours had gone and passed in the past day as only his clone remained above the skies of Dissolution with the Adjudicator.
At this moment, he moved to relay this message so he could at the very least put this being or the Curagulus of Extremity to use when...
BOOM!
The Hyperversal Extremity Authority surrounding the Adjudicator of Dissolution erupted as she exclaimed incredulously.
{The Avernus Clan would actually be so reckless?! To attack an Inheritance?!}
The Avernus Clan?
Noah's will moved quickly as he put the many details of Unrecorded Histories together.
He just knew Hyperversal Extremity Authority would erupt as the Shadow Fortress would be attacked. He didn't know who or what as now, the culprit was unveiled!
Before any time passed, his own voice thundered out towards The Adjudicator of Dissolution.

"My clone is about to come in contact with the Armament of Extremity- the Shadow Sword within the depths of the Cult of Endless Shadows! Hyperversal Extremities will soon descend as their target should be the Armament of Extremity...if there are any nearby Guardians in Penumbra, they need to be mobilized now!"
His words caused Svetlana to turn to him with brightly shining eyes as they revealed a few things for both Noah and this Hyperversal Extremity before him.
The major one was the fact that the means of the Curagulus of Extremity were genuine as they somehow caught wind of an incursion before it even happened.
The other...was that Noah somehow had the capability to do so as well, with his means being more realistic as he was involved in the event as he would be more perceptive to it!
The Adjudicator looked at Noah closely before she voiced out in a dark tone.
{The mission has already been handed out to relevant nearby members.}
As she spoke, Noah's Curagulus Mask flashed to life as a new mission rose before him.

{Crimson Mission}:: Support and Survival- Aid in stopping the destruction of the Cult of Endless Shadows as much as possible, with a secondary mission of stopping the Armament of Extremity from being obtained by the unknown attackers. Contribution and rewards will be measured depending on the ultimate result...
A dazzling mission appeared that Noah instantly accepted!
An extending inky black Extremity Vein of Penumbra could be seen with luster in the distance.
Far from it, in an insignificant corner of Penumbra, one of the main headquarters of the Cult of Endless Shadows could be seen.
It was chosen to hold the only Armament of Extremity in their grasp- the Shadow Sword.
{A cute little Inheritance, isn't it?}
Above the space of this branch of the Cult of Endless Shadows, a voice stemming from a being adorned in a beautiful cerulean hue could be heard.

An exquisite blue dress made of hundreds of gems that radiated auras of Extremity Relics was adorned on her body as she had snow-white hair dripping to her shoulders, her pupils shining with a boundless blue light as her figure emanated dangerous beauty!
A white whip was twirled around her waist as it pulsed with sharpness and danger, her whole visage giving off silent waves of power at the Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity level.

Beside her, the veiled figures of Extremity Ariana, Chamber Master Gayacus, the past Extremity of Destruction, and 8 other Hyperversal Extremities floated serenely while they gazed at the branch of the Cult of Endless Shadows below them.
{Extremity Blue...why aren't you veiling yourself at all?}
The voice of Chamber Master Gayacus rose calmly and cautiously as if he almost didn't want to speak towards this being.
Extremity Blue.
A renowned Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity within the Avernus Clan as she went by a few other names.
The Extremity of Lunacy.
The Extremity of Madness!
She held a uniquely profound power at Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity as even Chamber Master Gayacus and Extremity Ariana couldn't confidently say they could defeat her!
She had yet to reach Zenith and stand alongside beings like Emperor Shao, but she held her own unique power that caused her to stand out amongst others.

It was a power that was commonly seen in Seers who could traverse across the Aeonic Annals of Extremity with ease- a power that beings with Mutated Souls or with extremely powerful souls could express in a much greater form than others!
It was known as Hyperversal Haki of Extremity.

The release of one's soul power in such a way that an instant burst contained the trace authorities of all their Boundaries and Dynamis in the form of a Haki that didn't deplete any resources- and yet it could put one's enemies facing it in an extremely disadvantaged position, with those weaker than them receiving a shock into their souls as their very Records could be shattered due to it.

This was Hyperversal Haki of Extremity! It was far different than the mere base form of Haki that others could release as for those who could manipulate it to even greater and more profound levels, it was said that Zenith would not be too far away from them.

In addition to such a power that even Extremity Ariana and Chamber Master Gayacus could not release, Extremity Blue held such distinctions of Lunacy and Madness. Her disposition was one that caused many Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities to not even wish to deal with her!
Towards the question...

{Why bother to hide at this point? If the words of the Overlord are correct, none of it will matter. Even now, they have likely been alerted that we are moving...so why don't we drop all pretenses and have fun?}
Her eyes smiled innocently as they hid waves of Lunacy and craziness within- a weak man likely to be taken in by such a gaze without knowing just what was in store for them.
Chamber Master Gayacus nodded with a contemplative look as he began to speak.
{Alright, let's beg-}
{Hey.}
And he was interrupted right away.
His cautious eyes turned towards Extremity Blue's face which radiated a light of innocence as she spoke with a smile.
{Did you know that in life, things such as destiny and fate do not matter?}
They were at such a crucial juncture, and yet she thought this was a good time to begin monologuing?
Chamber Master Gayacus wished to stop her, but her snow-white hair shone as her gem-like blue eyes gazed upwards towards the endless streaks of darkness and shadows around them.
{It all comes down to choices...and one will either make the right choice, or the wrong choice. True power...is to forcefully make it so that every choice you make is the right choice!}
WAA!
Her words caused the Extremities around her to gaze at each other with annoyed eyes as Extremity Blue nodded to herself.
{Mmm, so what that means is that today, you every shall make all the right moves by sticking with me. Alright...let's begin.}
She grasped the whip by her waist and unfurled it.
In the stellar blackness of shadowy space every around them, it felt like a massive serpentine light flashed as if an endlessly vast serpent had woken up.
With a brilliant smile, Extremity Blue gazed at the silent branch of the Cult of Endless Shadows as her eyes pierced across layers of space to land on a Shadow Fortress within its very depths.
Her red lips moved as her fair face shone like a cold emperor.
{It's a good day to die...}
And an immediate later...
Her eyes pulsed.
THUMP!
As if it was the beating of an ancient heart.

But...it was the distinctive expression of her soul as astoundingly, blue tendrils of light instantly exploded from her eyes as Hyperversal Haki of Extremity unfolded alarmingly- and she didn't at every contain it in a single specified region as she allowed it to barrel down to the myriad of Planes of Existence of the whole branch of the Cult of Endless Shadows underneath them!

The other...was that Noah somehow had the capability to do so as well, with his means being more realistic as he was involved in the event as he would be more perceptive to it!
The Adjudicator looked at Noah closely before she voiced out in a dark tone.
{The mission has already been handed out to relevant nearby members.}
As she spoke, Noah's Curagulus Mask flashed to life as a new mission rose before him.

{Crimson Mission}:: Support and Survival- Aid in stopping the destruction of the Cult of Endless Shadows as much as possible, with a secondary mission of stopping the Armament of Extremity from being obtained by the unknown attackers.
Contribution and rewards will be measured depending on the ultimate result...
A dazzling mission appeared that Noah instantly accepted!
An extending inky black Extremity Vein of Penumbra could be seen with luster in the distance.
Far from it, in an insignificant corner of Penumbra, one of the main headquarters of the Cult of Endless Shadows could be seen.
It was chosen to hold the only Armament of Extremity in their grasp- the Shadow Sword.
{A cute little Inheritance, isn't it?}
Above the space of this branch of the Cult of Endless Shadows, a voice stemming from a being adorned in a beautiful cerulean hue could be heard.

An exquisite blue dress made of hundreds of gems that radiated auras of Extremity Relics was adorned on her body as she had snow-white hair dripping to her shoulders, her pupils shining with a boundless blue light as her figure emanated dangerous beauty!
A white whip was twirled around her waist as it pulsed with sharpness and danger, her whole visage giving off silent waves of power at the Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity level.

Beside her, the veiled figures of Extremity Ariana, Chamber Master Gayacus, the past Extremity of Destruction, and 8 other Hyperversal Extremities floated serenely while they gazed at the branch of the Cult of Endless Shadows below them.
{Extremity Blue...why aren't you veiling yourself at all?}
The voice of Chamber Master Gayacus rose calmly and cautiously as if he almost didn't want to speak towards this being.
Extremity Blue.
A renowned Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity within the Avernus Clan as she went by a few other names.
The Extremity of Lunacy.
The Extremity of Madness!
She held a uniquely profound power at Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity as even Chamber Master Gayacus and Extremity Ariana couldn't confidently say they could defeat her!
She had yet to reach Zenith and stand alongside beings like Emperor Shao, but she held her own unique power that caused her to stand out amongst others.

It was a power that was commonly seen in Seers who could traverse across the Aeonic Annals of Extremity with ease- a power that beings with Mutated Souls or with extremely powerful souls could express in a much greater form than others!
It was known as Hyperversal Haki of Extremity.

The release of one's soul power in such a way that an instant burst contained the trace authorities of all their Boundaries and Dynamis in the form of a Haki that didn't deplete any resources- and yet it could put one's enemies facing it in an extremely disadvantaged position, with those weaker than them receiving a shock into their souls as their very Records could be shattered due to it.
This was Hyperversal Haki of Extremity!

It was far different than the mere base form of Haki that others could release as for those who could manipulate it to even greater and more profound levels, it was said that Zenith would not be too far away from them.
In addition to such a power that even Extremity Ariana and Chamber Master Gayacus could not release, Extremity Blue held such distinctions of Lunacy and Madness.
Her disposition was one that caused many Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities to not even wish to deal with her!
Towards the question...
{Why bother to hide at this point?
If the words of the Overlord are correct, none of it will matter.
Even now, they have likely been alerted that we are moving...so why don't we drop all pretenses and have fun?}
Her eyes smiled innocently as they hid waves of Lunacy and craziness within- a weak man likely to be taken in by such a gaze without knowing just what was in store for them.
Chamber Master Gayacus nodded with a contemplative look as he began to speak.
{Alright, let's beg-}
{Hey.}
And he was interrupted right away.
His cautious eyes turned towards Extremity Blue's face which radiated a light of innocence as she spoke with a smile.
{Did you know that in life, things such as destiny and fate do not matter?}
They were at such a crucial juncture, and yet she thought this was a good time to begin monologuing?
Chamber Master Gayacus wished to stop her, but her snow-white hair shone as her gem-like blue eyes gazed upwards towards the endless streaks of darkness and shadows around them.
{It all comes down to choices...and one will either make the right choice, or the wrong choice.
True power...is to forcefully make it so that every choice you make is the right choice!}
WAA!
Her words caused the Extremities around her to gaze at each other with annoyed eyes as Extremity Blue nodded to herself.
{Mmm, so what that means is that today, you every shall make all the right moves by sticking with me.
Alright...let's begin.}
She grasped the whip by her waist and unfurled it.
In the stellar blackness of shadowy space every around them, it felt like a massive serpentine light flashed as if an endlessly vast serpent had woken up.
With a brilliant smile, Extremity Blue gazed at the silent branch of the Cult of Endless Shadows as her eyes pierced across layers of space to land on a Shadow Fortress within its very depths.
Her red lips moved as her fair face shone like a cold emperor.
{It's a good day to die...}
And an immediate later...
Her eyes pulsed.
THUMP!
As if it was the beating of an ancient heart.

But...it was the distinctive expression of her soul as astoundingly, blue tendrils of light instantly exploded from her eyes as Hyperversal Haki of Extremity unfolded alarmingly- and she didn't at every contain it in a single specified region as she allowed it to barrel down to the myriad of Planes of Existence of the whole branch of the Cult of Endless Shadows underneath them!

chapters.title: Chapter 2600 Nice to meet you, greenhorns! II
paragraphs: A flash of blue.
A glimmer of Extremity.
It was an action that caused even Chamber Master Gayacus and Extremity Ariana among all other Hyperversal Extremities to be utterly shocked!
This was because their mission here was only the Armament of Extremity, and to get their hands on at least a body of the one known as Noah Osmont.

They were supposed to suppress the Hyperversal Extremities here and take their Armament, and that was it! But her wild release of her Hyperversal Haki of Extremity...went to cover the vast lands underneath them as it would smash into any existences- whether they were Apex Aeonic Lifeforms or simply across the Boundary Expansion Realm, or those even weaker.
It wouldn't discriminate as its impact would utterly eviscerate all those it came across!
It was a shocking move they in no way needed to do as it would cause today's incursion to be all that much wilder.
This area of Penumbra was endlessly dark as at this moment, it felt like a blue sun had risen.
Its radiance was so astounding that it reached the Cult of Endless Shadows beneath them in an instant as only now did shouts full of rage and shock rise from the lands below them!
{Preposterous!}
{You dare?!}
{HOLD!}
BOOM!
A shocking impact bloomed.

And chaos of utter proportions unfolded thereafter as an existence of utter Lunacy was released by the Avernus Clan- their child in doing this being a unique one as one wondered what their goals were!
Three Hyperversal Extremity Shadows were watching a single being conduct an action that bordered on the realm of impossibility.
It wasn't that the action was an impossibility for an existence to accomplish, but it was simply an impossibility for a being at the same stage as him to do so!
With their senses and the aura that he gave off, they could tell that he at the very most had risen to the 14th or the 15th boundary layer.
He was not close to Extremity.
In fact, the gap from the 15th layer to the 18th layer was a chasm that some beings never crossed their whole lives.

And in the Shadow Sea Plane, they had brought Elders of the Cult of Endless Shadows who had achieved the 17th Boundary Layer and even they took difficult strides just to move a few paces in front of the maddeningly pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of the Shadow Sword.

And yet the one known as Osmont pulsed with string-like vibrations as in the next moment, he turned into a flicker of multi-colored light that instantly streaked across the obsidian tendrils of Hyperversal Authority.
He didn't push these tendrils away nor did they reject him, instead, he seemed to be absorbing them at a shocking pace and speed the further in that he went.

The massive weight that Moona and other Elders of the Cult of Endless Shadows had felt when they first entered this plane holding the Armament of Extremity before them seemed like it did not exist for him- like the shackles of other beings simply did not apply to him!
{What in the world...?}
Moona felt his soul which was already halfway towards Hyperversal Extremity shake at the scene.
Flashing Shadow had his expression become stern as just as he was about to add his input...
His eyes flashed with shock as he gazed up!
{Preposterous!}

He bellowed out with unbridled rage as his vision pierced across the many layers of space and he saw that far above the domains that they were in- a blue light of Hyperversal Extremity Authority was crashing down with malice and danger!
A light that caused even someone like him who had attained Tier 3 Hyperversal Authority to feel a sense of oppression.
He wasn't the only one to bellow out as alongside him was the massive and resounding shout that reverberated out from the depths of the Shadow Fortress.
{HOLD!}
It was a single word stemming from the most powerful being within the Cult of Endless Shadows.
A being who had one of his bodies in this branch that was protecting the Armament of Extremity.

The master of this voice was the one to react the fastest as the instant they noticed the enveloping cerulean Hyperversal Haki of Extremity, an endless sea of shadows erupted from the depth of the Shadow Fortress!
The being known as the Shadow Extremity Overlord had struck out to counter the terrible descending authority that shockingly targeted everything below it.
He wasn't the only one as his authority and the authority of Flashing Shadow, Extremity Gabriella, and over a dozen other Hyperversal Extremities erupted out right away.
The clash...was worse than the fracturing of millions of planes of existence.
BOOM!
The shadowy space in this corner of Penumbra seemed lit up with brilliance and might as if a blue sun had risen.
Reality cracked and splintered.
And in an instant...over half of the domains of the Cult of Endless Shadows in this region were flattened.

And during this whole time, the terrifying Hyperversal Haki of Extremity never faded or erased itself- its grandeur constantly pressing down until from below, the figure of Flashing Shadow and a man wrapped in brilliant shadowy light appeared side by side!
{WHY?!}

The Shadow Extremity Overlord bellowed out as his hand and Flashing Shadow's hands rose as if they were holding the very sky from falling, these two Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities being the ones to stop the raging authority from going any further down.
BOOM!
The overpowering cerulean waves of Haki faded.
It was only now that the surroundings cleared, and the scene of devastation unfolded to everyone's eyes!
Half of the enormous Shadow Fortress which was the size of many Major Planes of Existence was fractured and had pieces falling off.

The Boundary Expansion Realm existences and any Apex Aeonic Lifeforms that were unlucky enough to be in the region that was blanketed by the azure Hyperversal Haki of Extremity...their life force could not be felt.
An unknown number of being had died in an instant as their spirits received a shock of Hyperversal Extremity Authority!
In the midst of such carnage, laughter resounded out from above as the being who had acted raised her whip in the air and thrashed down with terrifying Hyperversal Extremity Authority.
{Nice to meet you, greenhorns.}
A carefree voice of a crazy woman thundered out!

chapters.title: Chapter 2601 A Critical Threshold! I
paragraphs: Extremity Blue spoke towards the maddened figures of Flashing Shadow and the Shadow Extremity Overlord below her, along with the approximate dozen or so Tier 1 and Tier 2 Extremities who could barely withstand her Haki far below them.
She looked at all of them and smiled with a light of craziness in her eyes.
{You call that flimsy usage of authority that you just released Tier 3? You then ask why? Don't ask such a philosophical question to me now!}
Her voice echoed out as if she had not just slaughtered an untold number of beings.
She was smiling at the beginning of the sentence, and yet her face warped and became rageful towards the end.
{You ask why? Why does reality flow the way it does? Why do we exist and die?}
Her expression changed from rage to a smile once more as she focused on the eyes full of wrath of the Shadow Extremities below her.
{The only why that will matter to you in the next few seconds is...
why are you so weak?}
The reality above became painted blue again as it felt like a massive River of Reality had unfolded from her whip, and it was smashing down with scrutiny towards all those below.
This...was only displaying the might of a single being. And yet, she was not alone.
The moment that she had acted, the beings beside her adapted to the crazy reality she had brought forth and moved right away!
They knew that their objective this time was not a truly powerful Inheritance.
As if to show these there were only two Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities that were able to withstand the might of Extremity Blue at this moment.

Far below the Flashing Shadow and the Shadow Extremity Overlord 12 Tier 2 and 1 Hyperversal Extremities had their eyes burning with rage and incredulity as they secured other locations of the Shadow Fortress and the remaining lands of the Cult of Endless Shadows.
In the depths of the fortress, the figure of Moona and Extremity Gabriella remained as Gabriella's aura shook dangerously- seeming on the border of Tier 2 and Tier 3!

They had to be here to protect the Shadow Sword as it couldn't be left unattended, but at this moment, Extremity Gabriella's gaze utterly changed as she found from the gaps of space...two terrifying auras of Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity Authorities bypassed Flashing Shadow and the Shadow Extremity Overlord who were locked down by the maddening woman radiating blue light as these enemy Extremities made a straight path towards the Shadow Sea Plane that the Armament of Extremity was in.
Extremity Gabriella's face turned utterly sour as she bellowed out for all to hear
{Their objective is the Shadow Sword!}
Her cry was primordial and filled with endless anger.
She couldn't believe the reality currently unfolding as never in recent record had an Inheritance been attacked like this, nor did one ever poach the treasures of another!
Her rage was akin to fuel as she squeezed every ounce of her power.
Even though she knew that the beings coming down were much more powerful than her...she would not let them succeed in their aim.
From her...
{Hyperversal Extremity Expansion}.
{Endless Shadows}!
Reality became distorted as waves of Endless Shadows began to flow.
Beside her, Moona gathered any semblance of Hyperversal Extremity Authority in his body as he struck out as well, their attacks crossing light-years to meet their enemies before they even arrived!
But the enemies that had come were too prepared.

They knew exactly which force they were attacking and how to thwart them. They knew their power as the absolute reality was that they could easily defeat them, with their main goal here being to simply come in and out in a short period of time with everything that they needed.
And so, they did just that.
From above.
Extremity Ariana and Chamber Master Gayacus harrumphed as they exploded with Hyperversal Authority.
Endlessly purple flames cascaded down like a burning sea while a golden light crossed the skies with great speed.

Even further behind them, the veiled Avernus Extremities included in this incursion Erupted with their own authority to clash with the tier 1 and tier 2 Shadow Extremities that mustard up their will to fight back against this unexpected attack!

The whole region was flipped upside down and turned into an apocalyptic chaos as in the midst of all of this...A single being in the very depths of the Shadow Sea Plane ignored all that was happening- his body continuing to shoot towards the massive Armament of Extremity in the distance as before his eyes, more and more prompts rose.
{The 13th Boundary Layer of Shadows has been attained...}
{The 14th Boundary Layer of Shadows has been attained...}
In his vision, everything was pulsing with countless strings all around.

He traversed across the oscillations and vibrations of these strings as the far away Shadow Sword became ever closer, to the point that he knew he needed just a few nanoseconds before he could reach it!

The closer he went, the denser the pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Shadows became as his soul cried out in happiness- absorbing everything endlessly as the cracks within it caused by clashing Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authorities were healed with utmost scrutiny.
But he felt the overwhelming Extremity Authority far above him near.
He felt the ready forces of the Avernus Clan come ever closer!

The Shadow Extremities would not be able to stop them. Gabriella and Moona simply didn't have what it took to stop two powerful Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities from the Avernus Clan for even a few nanoseconds...much less Noah.
His eyes were filled with brilliance and power as in the midst of all of this...he called out softly.
{Domain Expansion}
{Indefatigable Quintessence}.
Indefatigable.
Quintessence!
Many things had changed over the last day as one of these was Indefatigable being taken to the level of a Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity.
Out of the many possible abilities and Domains Noah could have called out, he chose this for no other reason than to erupt and cause even more chaos in the surroundings.
Chaos that may actually stand a chance to affect Hyperversal Extremities!
Chaos to give him enough time to get to the Shadow Sword.
This chaos...was in the form of something deeply connected to the Indefatigable Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity.
BZZT!
The now extremely pure Vacuous Hyperversal Authority within his Soul churned.
Paired with the Domain Expansion of Indefatigable Quintessence he had called out in addition to the extremely pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority he had been absorbing...
CRACK!
It felt like something deep inside his soul broke.
And...
{You have achieved a sufficient level of purity.}
{You are beginning your First Vacuous Awakening!}

chapters.title: Chapter 2602 A Critical Threshold! II
paragraphs: 2602 A Critical Threshold! II
In and out.
Quick was the main objective of the current incursion as the Avernus Extremities wasted no time, and their overwhelming power allowed them to accomplish this with freedom!
Extremity Ariana watched the scene below her coldly as the woman who had tried to release a Hyperversal Extremity Domain finally understood the true gap in their power.
'Barely grasping Tier 3 and thinking you can move faster and with more power?'
Ariana sneered as the scene of the all-encompassing domain of Endless Shadows did not manage to unfold!

Instead, hundreds of massive purple flaming spears the size of realities manifested all around the domain of shadows, piercing it and deflating it like a popped balloon as the one who had called it forth...she had her body pierced by a concentrated purple spear as her stomach was split open while Endless darkness leaked from it!
Beside her, there was a being called Moona.
He seemed to just be grasping Hyperversal Extremity Authority as he...had faced the attention of Chamber Master Gayacus.
'The golden flames of that old man are no joke...'
Ariana thought of such a thing as where the one called Moona used to float, reality around the whole area was scorched as a sea of golden flames erased every record around it!
A Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity facing one that was barely stepping to become Tier 1? The discrepancy in power was so vast that even an instant was enough to erase the weaker side entirely!
This...was how drastic reality had become within the Shadow Sea Plane.
This was how fast Hyperversal Extremities could act!
[The Senatus of Extremity will not stand for this!]
While her Soul and Records were under attack by purple flames filled with a unique Hyperversal Extremity Authority, Gabriella bellowed out with maddening rage.
Yet Extremity Ariana was no longer looking at her as both she and Gayacus were focused on the depths of the plane that was blown wide open and their goals within it.
They saw the massive Armament of Extremity.
They then saw the figure crossing through space was sucking in all the surrounding Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority, his visage about to come in contact with the Shadow Sword!

Seeing his figure ignoring the weight of pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority and even absorbing it en masse, Ariana became stern as before she could even speak, Chamber Master Gayacus caused the above reality to instantly burn liquid gold as the darkness of shadows was being erased rapidly in this region.
[He needs to die with surety.]
They could see it.
His talent.
His potential.
This being making the Avernus Clan an enemy...they had to erase any potential he held early.
They would also let him know that from here on out...he shouldn't expect his ventures to be easy or successful since they had begun their hunt for him!
They wouldn't send Apex Aeonic Lifeforms as just like what they were doing now, Hyperversal Extremities would be the ones to move against him until all of his Records were erased.

Even though Gayacus was making a move as all of nearby reality was turning gold, Extremity Ariana also made a move as an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity leaked from her body- her figure instantly turning into a flash of purple flames.
In front of a Hyperversal Extremity wielding an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, space was relative.
And Ariana squeezed the space around her in a shocking manner the words of her soul could barely be heard!
[Miniature Wormhole].

Only a glimmer of purple flames flashed as she crossed through and passed all of the raging Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority, her visage instantly appearing before the figure of the being shining with multicolored light!
He had overcome all enemies that Ariana had read about during his conflicts.
He had a talent for overcoming difficulties as Ariana did not want him to even have a sliver of a chance!
Even though she knew that unless this Osmont before her expressed genuine Hyperversal Extremity Authority, he would never be able to even lift the Shadow Sword, much less wield it.
She didn't want him to gain a single thing as at this moment, both she and Chamber Master Gayacus made a move against an existence that had yet to even glimpse Extremity!
If beings like Gabriella were incapacitated while Moona was eradicated, what could Osmont do at this moment?
This was the reality, and yet Ariana didn't let her guard down.
Her visage reformed as her fair hands unfurled to grasp the multicolored being before her.

She had to come in contact with him and spread her Hyperversal Extremity Authority unto him, making sure to trace his Source to all of his bodies and then locating his Records in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity as only then could this being be erased!
Time slowed.
The golden light from Gayacus and the fist hands of Ariana were right there!
Inches away, the True Emperor of Quintessence was about to be grasped by terrifying existences who moved with all their power.
And at such a juncture...
Ariana's deeply purple eyes dilated as her hand that was inches away from Noah's entity changed directions and slapped sideways!
It was because she actually felt a warning as the moment she slapped out, she came in contact with the borders of an emerging obsidian rift of space bordered by a cherry-colored light!
An dark crevice that she had to slap away as an instant later, she also turned her blessed body sideways to evade another emerging rift that was radiating potent Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.
These rifts weren't normal openings of pockets of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.

Extremity Ariana knew them very well as the potency they released confirmed for her that these were the very same Vacuous Hyperversal Domain Rifts that formed in the extreme edges of the Seven Havens!

They also formed in more dangerous regions across the Seven Havens, but the main thing about these crevices was that after one entered them, they could be transported outside of the jurisdiction of the Seven Havens!
If it were the massive established Vacuous Hyperversal Domain Rifts, one could enter them and still find their way back into the Seven Havens by returning to them.
They were stable.
The Vacuous Hyperversal Domain Rifts currently blooming all around...were filled with instability as if they would fade away any second.
If one entered any of these rifts, they would be spat out into an unfamiliar place in the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains as the moment the Rift closed...
their entry to the Seventh Realms was turned away!
They would have to cross outside the range of Space, time, and reality until they found their way back to the Seven Havens!
This was the warning Ariana felt.
Her eyes became even more focused at such a development as all around them, hundreds of such unstable Vacuous Hyperversal Domain Rifts bloomed!
They bought the being who should have landed in the hands of a Ultimate Extremity a nanosecond that he utilized to instantly...
BZZT!
Come in contact with an Armament of Extremity!

chapters.title: Chapter 2603 Awakening! I
paragraphs: 2603 Awakening! I
Armament of Extremity.
To merely hold it, a being that did not have Hyperversal Extremity Authority would find such an action an impossibility.
One could be near it.
One could try to touch it.
But to wield it was an impossibility unless they wrapped their hands in Hyperversal Extremity Authority!
Noah didn't have such an authority in his body, but he did have a soul that had been bathed with Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority this whole time.
The only thing he was missing was Extremity.

So when his palm landed on a small area of the massive sword anchored in space, what he came in contact with was cold metal that instantly erupted with the most potent Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Shadows yet- along with streams of information on this weapon before him!
And all of it was blasted into his body as it creaked like a vessel taking on too much pressure, and yet he withstood it as the result of such an action...
[Musings of the 16th Boundary Layer of Shadows are emerging within your mind.]
Traces of a 16th Boundary Layer came.
He just needed to hold on until he fully achieved it, and possibly more!
He had released the Domain Expansion of Indefatigable Quintessence as from it, dazzling rifts had emit all around him as they seemed to lead into truly terrible domains.
Alongside it, his Main Body in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven had begun to undergo a change with an uncertain result as the First Vacuous Awakening was occurring!

All of this was provoked by the expansion of Indefatigable Quintessence as even though he did not at all have the power to withstand Extremities, this single cast of a domain had actually granted him precious time.
But that was it.
The enemies that had made a move this time were authentic Extremities.
BZZT!

Behind him, the woman bathed in purple flames evaded all the blooming rifts as if she did not wish to touch them, and when she saw Noah's body surrounded by these very same rifts coming in contact with the Shadow Sword, her dazzling jewel-like eyes blinked as she instantly moved.
Noah felt her shocking movements as Oraculum buzzed in his soul, its authority moving at this time.
Even though it might not work due to the Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority surrounding the Shadow Sword and the enemy Extremities around him.
[Hyperversal Plundering]
WAA!
Noah still tried even more as from above, a bejeweled illusory golden hand formed and plucked down!
And yet, the Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity was much, much faster.
The next time she appeared, she was far above Noah...near the handle of the Shadow Sword.
SAA!
She dodged another set of erupting Vacuous Hyperversal Domain Rifts as her fair hands enlarged and reached out towards the handle of the Armament of Extremity.

She also gazed at the formed bejeweled hand of a Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity as she waved her left hand towards it, a sea of Hyperversal Extremity flames erupting out to devour this hand entirely!
And...
[YAA!]

She emit with even more waves of Hyperversal Extremity Authority with her right hand that instantly restrained the Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Shadows within the handle of the Shadow Sword, Noah's eyes rising and locking with hers at this moment.
[The authority of Hyperversal Plundering has been erased.]
Time felt like it moved at a snail's pace.
Extremity Ariana's eyes burned with purple flames as they seemed to be smiling coldly at Noah.

And he stared back with ferocity as concentrated waves of Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Shadows flowed into him, many prompts rising at the same time as when the being before his eyes pulled the Armament of Extremity upwards!
BOOM!
The pristine Shadow Sword that he was touching the cold metal of was instantly moved back.
And not just that.
The eyes of Extremity Ariana shone coldly while she moved the Shadow Sword back, her Hyperversal Extremity Authority flowed out densely as she tipped the angulation and trajectory slightly.
Just slightly.
And this single alteration turned the sharp blade point of the Armament of Extremity towards Noah's visage.

The single action seemed to have drained a lot from Ariana as her purple eyes dimmed, but she was able to slightly move the Shadow Sword that she now grasped in her hands as she tilted its movement slightly- causing it to point its blade edge towards the one being near it as a moment later- the body of the True Emperor of Quintessence was met with it!
SAA!
A cut appeared in the fold of reality and extended out endlessly, everything seeming like a cut canvas of a painting as in the far distance...
Chamber Master Gayacus' figure moved sideways to evade this shocking cut of reality.
A cut that stretched out as far as the remnants of the Shadow Fortress and the battling cerulean lunatic who was thrashing the Flashing Shadow and the Shadow Extremity Overlord!
The figure of the True Emperor of Quintessence was the first to face this figure as he faced the sharp end of a wielded Armament of Extremity head on.
The pure pressure and power alone was so shocking that the whole figure of the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity was eviscerated into nothingness right away!
[Hooo...]
Holding the hilt of Armament of Extremity with a tired gaze, Ariana sighed as her eyes scanned the region below.
Was he really dea-
Her thoughts didn't finish.

Her eyes radiated a profound light of wonder as she saw a bursting singularity near a Vacuous Hyperversal Domain Rift, this singularity instantly emerging to recreate a multicolored stellar existence that stared towards her with an extremely cold gaze!
At the same time that Noah faced the sharp end of the Armament of Extremity head on.

The burst of Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Shadows from it was so potent that he drank as much as possible, and by the time he was struck and millions of Damage Values decimated everything about him...
[The 16 Boundary Layer of Shadows has been attained!]
A glorious prompt came.
And then...
[Your Quintessential Hyperversal Vitality Values have been reduced to 1.]
[You have entered a state of Quasi-True Death]
[Due to the nature of the Domain Expansion- Indefatigable Quintessence, your Quintessential Hyperversal Vitality Value will not reduce past 1 until the whole Domain is destroyed.]
[Your Aspects of Existence are reforming.]
A singularity bloomed near a Vacuous Hyperversal Domain Rift as his body reformed!
He gazed at the visage of the purple-flamed Extremity in the distance as countless thoughts crossed his mind.
His enemies this time were actually not dumb.
They moved with precision and power as they just prevented him from making a shocking amount of gains today!

chapters.title: Chapter 2604 Awakening! II
paragraphs: 2604 Awakening! II
Just by being in contact with the Armament of Extremity and being 'killed' by it, he devoured enough Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Shadows to obtain the highest Boundary Layer so far.
The 16th Layer that he couldn't attain from Ahpuch!
It was so pristine as who knew what he could have gained if he was able to remain in contact with the Shadow Sword freely?
Yet the enemies this time actually used their heads as an opportunity was stopped halfway!
And at this time...
[You all are still playing around with him? Wow, let me take a look at this kid.]
The voice of a Lunatic thundered out as an endless cerulean sea descended.

Within it, the figures of Flashing Shadow and the Shadow Extremity Overlord could be seen battling with illusory blue clones of Extremity Blue, her Main Body instantly arriving beside Extremity Ariana as she evaded all the hundreds of Vacuous Hyperversal Domain Rifts in the surroundings!
She was truly battling two other Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities as she found the time to freely gaze at Noah and speak.
[Mmm, another greenhorn. Hey kid, you wanted to spend a little more time with that Armament of Extremity, right?]
Her snow-white hair shone with tendrils of blue as she spoke seriously towards Noah.
Her beauty was utterly devastating as from her serious expression, she smiled like the sweetest being as she continued.
[I'll give it to you...but just let me take a look at your soul for a second. I just want a little peek of your soul, that's it!]
Ariana shook her head with frustration while muttering under her breath.
'This fucking lunatic...'
She tried her best to control the Armament of Extremity in her hands as she carefully wrapped it with Hyperversal Extremity Authority, turning her head towards Extremity Blue as she spoke out.
[This isn't his main body as I've already killed him once to no avail. The mission is successful for the most part as we need to quickly pull ou-]
HUUM!
Her words didn't finish as she raised her head.
There, in the distance, the auras of fantastically powerful Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities began to appear as Ariana knew their true foes were arriving.

Their faces were masked with white gold masks as without saying a word, their figures moved and erupted with Hyperversal Extremity Authority as they targeted Ariana who grabbed hold of the Shadow Sword, along with Extremity Blue and Chamber Master Gayacus!
Extremity Blue gazed up at this as she smiled gleefully, clapping her hands as if she was seeing the most beautiful scene in the world.
[Haha, look at these guys, always coming in late.]
Her gorgeous visage pulsed with power.
She tapped her lips as she stared at the figure of Noah surrounded by obsidian rifts and the Guardians defending above as she asked Ariana beside her without even turning.
[You have enough of a handle on the Armament of Extremity to leave with it?]

[Almost. Gayacus.] Ariana replied curtly as she called out for Chamber Master Gayacus, his dominant visage appearing beside her to lend his power as well- with this showing just how pristine an Armament of Extremity was as it needed two Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities just to get a hold of it quickly before they branded it with their Authority to have such a weapon recognize them as the owner!

[Good, then I will provide you and the others cover.] A gorgeous blue radiance lit up on her fair skin as her figure emanated even more deadly beauty, her smile heart shaking as she floated upwards to meet oncoming Guardians while still battling with Flashing Shadow and the Shadow Extremity Overlord.
[It's a good day to die...]
While uttering such ominous words, her eyes began to collect every single source of light in all of nearby reality.

In the distance, Noah's gaze pulsed with Oraculum as he saw opportunities closed off on all sides here, the gains he made with the Shadow Sword being abruptly stopped here as at this moment, only bells of danger rang out as it seemed these existence beginning to shine with a blue light was particularly dangerous.
More dangerous than the purple-flamed woman and the golden man beside her as at this moment, Noah felt the life of the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity at risk.
It meant that even the Domain Expansion of Indefatigable Quintessence would be getting erased soon as he was given the same reminder he had gotten many times now.
He could not stand against Hyperversal Extremities.
At least...not yet.

So he didn't linger as before whatever disaster was coming bloomed, his eyes gazed at the myriad of Vacuous Hyperversal Domain Rifts around him as without any ounce of hesitation...he entered through one of them.
Rifts that took one outside of the authority of the Seven Vitalis Havens!
When they faded, one would have to find their own way back or have some capability that allowed them to quickly return to their home.
Rifts such as these weren't things one could conjure freely, with Hyperversal Extremities proficient in Vacuous Hyperversal Authority being the only ones who were able to do so!
And yet with Indefatigable Quintessence, Noah had called them forth.
And now, he entered through one of them as he took this opportunity to escape, as well as do something he had planned on doing for the past few days.
Increased understanding and exploration of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority!
Noah's figure left, but the obsidian rifts remained as a trace of his will was left behind to watch just what would occur.
And the scene was an ecstatic one.
The Extremity bathed in blue made herself the center of attention as her words continued to respond out.
[Reality is particularly dark tonight.]
Her gaze was contemplative as she gazed at the vast darkness of Penumbra all around them.
[Let me brighten it up for you all so that you can see.]
She placed her hand on her left chest and closed her bright eyes, her head beginning to bop back and forth as astoundingly...an upbeat symphony began to blast out.
A smile was painted on her red lips as when she opened her gaze again, she called out lightly.
[Sea of Lunacy.]
Hyperversal Haki of Extremity emerged as the base.

Multiple Absolute Dynamis of Extremity then joined in as in the location where a main branch of the Cult of Endless Shadows was, a blue light shone and lit up this Region of Penumbra for countless light years.
The perpetrator of such a light was a single being, with her might being unsurpassed as she ran wild in the Haven of Penumbra on this day!
There was a major query that very few would ask regarding all this.
A query that needed an answer the most was...where was the Adjudicator of Penumbra during all this time? Could he not see what was happening in this region?

Wow, let me take a look at this kid.]
The voice of a Lunatic thundered out as an endless cerulean sea descended.

Within it, the figures of Flashing Shadow and the Shadow Extremity Overlord could be seen battling with illusory blue clones of Extremity Blue, her Main Body instantly arriving beside Extremity Ariana as she evaded all the hundreds of Vacuous Hyperversal Domain Rifts in the surroundings!
She was truly battling two other Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities as she found the time to freely gaze at Noah and speak.
[Mmm, another greenhorn.
Hey kid, you wanted to spend a little more time with that Armament of Extremity, right?]
Her snow-white hair shone with tendrils of blue as she spoke seriously towards Noah.
Her beauty was utterly devastating as from her serious expression, she smiled like the sweetest being as she continued.
[I'll give it to you...but just let me take a look at your soul for a second.
I just want a little peek of your soul, that's it!]
Ariana shook her head with frustration while muttering under her breath.
'This fucking lunatic...'
She tried her best to control the Armament of Extremity in her hands as she carefully wrapped it with Hyperversal Extremity Authority, turning her head towards Extremity Blue as she spoke out.
[This isn't his main body as I've already killed him once to no avail.
The mission is successful for the most part as we need to quickly pull ou-]
HUUM!
Her words didn't finish as she raised her head.
There, in the distance, the auras of fantastically powerful Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities began to appear as Ariana knew their true foes were arriving.

Their faces were masked with white gold masks as without saying a word, their figures moved and erupted with Hyperversal Extremity Authority as they targeted Ariana who grabbed hold of the Shadow Sword, along with Extremity Blue and Chamber Master Gayacus!
Extremity Blue gazed up at this as she smiled gleefully, clapping her hands as if she was seeing the most beautiful scene in the world.
[Haha, look at these guys, always coming in late.]
Her gorgeous visage pulsed with power.
She tapped her lips as she stared at the figure of Noah surrounded by obsidian rifts and the Guardians defending above as she asked Ariana beside her without even turning.
[You have enough of a handle on the Armament of Extremity to leave with it?]
[Almost.

Gayacus.] Ariana replied curtly as she called out for Chamber Master Gayacus, his dominant visage appearing beside her to lend his power as well- with this showing just how pristine an Armament of Extremity was as it needed two Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities just to get a hold of it quickly before they branded it with their Authority to have such a weapon recognize them as the owner!

[Good, then I will provide you and the others cover.] A gorgeous blue radiance lit up on her fair skin as her figure emanated even more deadly beauty, her smile heart shaking as she floated upwards to meet oncoming Guardians while still battling with Flashing Shadow and the Shadow Extremity Overlord.
[It's a good day to die...]
While uttering such ominous words, her eyes began to collect every single source of light in all of nearby reality.

In the distance, Noah's gaze pulsed with Oraculum as he saw opportunities closed off on all sides here, the gains he made with the Shadow Sword being abruptly stopped here as at this moment, only bells of danger rang out as it seemed these existence beginning to shine with a blue light was particularly dangerous.
More dangerous than the purple-flamed woman and the golden man beside her as at this moment, Noah felt the life of the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity at risk.
It meant that even the Domain Expansion of Indefatigable Quintessence would be getting erased soon as he was given the same reminder he had gotten many times now.
He could not stand against Hyperversal Extremities.
At least...not yet.

So he didn't linger as before whatever disaster was coming bloomed, his eyes gazed at the myriad of Vacuous Hyperversal Domain Rifts around him as without any ounce of hesitation...he entered through one of them.
Rifts that took one outside of the authority of the Seven Vitalis Havens!
When they faded, one would have to find their own way back or have some capability that allowed them to quickly return to their home.
Rifts such as these weren't things one could conjure freely, with Hyperversal Extremities proficient in Vacuous Hyperversal Authority being the only ones who were able to do so!
And yet with Indefatigable Quintessence, Noah had called them forth.
And now, he entered through one of them as he took this opportunity to escape, as well as do something he had planned on doing for the past few days.
Increased understanding and exploration of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority!
Noah's figure left, but the obsidian rifts remained as a trace of his will was left behind to watch just what would occur.
And the scene was an ecstatic one.
The Extremity bathed in blue made herself the center of attention as her words continued to respond out.
[Reality is particularly dark tonight.]
Her gaze was contemplative as she gazed at the vast darkness of Penumbra all around them.
[Let me brighten it up for you all so that you can see.]
She placed her hand on her left chest and closed her bright eyes, her head beginning to bop back and forth as astoundingly...an upbeat symphony began to blast out.
A smile was painted on her red lips as when she opened her gaze again, she called out lightly.
[Sea of Lunacy.]
Hyperversal Haki of Extremity emerged as the base.

Multiple Absolute Dynamis of Extremity then joined in as in the location where a main branch of the Cult of Endless Shadows was, a blue light shone and lit up this Region of Penumbra for countless light years.
The perpetrator of such a light was a single being, with her might being unsurpassed as she ran wild in the Haven of Penumbra on this day!
There was a major query that very few would ask regarding all this.
A query that needed an answer the most was...where was the Adjudicator of Penumbra during all this time?
Could he not see what was happening in this region?

chapters.title: Chapter 2605 Awakening! III
paragraphs: 2605 Awakening! III
An eruption of Endless blue light from a maddened Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity was the last thing Noah's last shred of will saw in the remnants of the Shadow Sea Plane before everything was erased.
His Reified Source of Quintessence had stepped into the folds of one of the Vacuous Hyperversal Domain Rifts as this body...was currently outside of the authority of Vitalis!
Not in the Seven Vitalis Havens.
Not in the Planar Palisades of Extremity.
Elsewhere.
The Vacuous Hyperversal Domains was the name that most beings Noah had come across and devoured the memories of called it.
Such domains may go under entirely different names from the perspective of the natives.
The Vacuous Malignancies mentioned by the Adjudicator of Dissolution!
The Entities that reveled in devouring Hyperversal Extremities...or so Noah was told.

He now appeared in a space of utter nothingness as when Extremities took on the weight of Obsidian or Crimson Haven Albatrosses- they either stood guard or were sent out into established Stable Vacuous Hyperversal Domain Rifts stretched out in different regions within the Seven Havens!
The most powerful of existences always stepped into the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains as in these regions outside the scope of reality itself, it wasn't just Vacuous Malignancies one could come across.

In these regions outside the scope of time and space, wonders unimaginable within the Seven Havens could be found as some Extremities were able to propel their power from Tier 2 to Tier 3 based on the wonders they found.
Some Extremities, of course, perished and never returned!
Dangers and opportunities came hand in hand when it came to such a vast and unknown space as one wondered...what could an area that didn't even have time as a factor be hiding?
How ancient could the existences and treasures within be?
And why were the Lifeforms of the Seven Vitalis Havens all drawn towards these lands of nothingness when those that they considered their greatest foes called it their home?
A great deal of questions.
And no answers.

Noah sought the answers himself without believing any one person's narrative as right now, his body that was surrounded by nothing but genuine, potent Vacuous Hyperversal Authority...had something happen to it before it could even settle.

When Extremities from the Seven Vitalis Havens stepped out, they had to either be ready to expend a great deal of their Extremity Authority to explore and proceed forward, or they had to be existences who had attained some level of usage of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority as in this manner- they could survive without having to expend all of their resources in a quick period of time.
This was why existences who had attained Vacuous Hyperversal Authority were so favored!
It was why scions like Ahpuch were favored, and why Noah was considered a monstrous Mutated Entity when he displayed this ability.
There were some Extremities who had not gained access to the usage of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority even now!
But for the distinguished beings who could utilize this authority...the vast majority stopped at that.
And then, there was Noah.

After inviting Vitalis Hyperversal Authority into his soul by Plundering an Unrecorded History, his soul was forced to under cycles that caused his Vacuous Hyperversal Authority to become so extremely potent that after he took another set of actions that culminated with the casting of the Domain Expansion of Indefatigable Quintessence...the Potency of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority had reached a level that caused him to under the First Vacuous Awakening!
And now, to add a topping on an already overfilled plate...his Reified Source of Quintessence appeared within genuine Vacuous Hyperversal Authority outside the Seven Vitalis Havens.
This multicolored stellar body...vibrated as it acted like a funnel that began absorbing every ounce of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority in the surroundings and allowed it to flow into his Soul.
All the way into his main body that was the center of the beginning Vacuous Awakening!
His Quintessential Hyperversal Soul was instantly bathed black as it spread into his Aspects of Existence.

And the moment this occurred, the stream of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority that was constantly flowing and combating the Vacuous Hyperversal Authority...woke up with an indignant roar as if it was insulted!
Mind you, in Recorded History...Vitalis always seemed to win over Vacuous authority.

So when it sensed the level of purity and potency of the Vacuous Hyperversal Authority trying to occupy the soul of a being that was also infused with Vitalis Hyperversal Authority...it surged out with even more might as the potency of Vitalis within Noah's Soul was quickly raised towards the same level- with the goal of exceeding it!
Now, what would such an action result in?
If Vitalis came to be at the same level of potency as Vacuous within Noah's soul...
His Main Body within the depths of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven had begun to radiate pure black light when an instant later...a heavy transparent glimmer shone on his body!
[The Vitalis Hyperversal Authority fused within your Soul has reached a threshold.]
[You have begun your First Vitalis Awakening!]
Two extremely mysterious Authorities fully covered his existence as a phenomenal change began.
This change very much had his soul at the core, but his Body and Origin were very much involved at this stage as the changes within them were simply ecstatic!
His Origin.
The other part of him that made him as exceptional as he was.
His Aletheian Havens of Extremity!
Currently, his already illustrious Origin was being propelled to an even grander stage as...
[The Aletheian Havens of Extremity are being infused with Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.]
[The Major Planes of Existence within the First Aletheian Haven are transforming into Minor Aeonic Havens.]

At the very base of his Origin, the massive Planes formed from Dreams, Avalon, Prana, Fantasia, Niflheim, Quantum, Mirror, Apollyon, and Elysium instantly expanded as the string like vibrations of Aletheian covered everything with a gorgeous black-gold light.
[The Minor Aeonic Havens within the Second and Third Aletheian Haven are transforming into Major Aeonic Havens.]
[The Major Aeonic Havens within the Fourth Aletheian Haven are transforming into Minor Hyperversal Havens.]
WAA!
Billowing winds of change came.

Within his stellar origin filled with the light of many Decreta that used to be Dimensions...they were entirely transformed into Dimensional Realities to Planes of Existence, Aeonic Havens, and finally into Hyperversal Havens within the Fourth Aletheian Haven of Extremity.
Within his Origin, dense Reality Passages as large as Planes of Existence proliferated as Titanic golden stanchions of light acted like pillars to support everything!

The resources coursing through the stellar towering Reality Passages and rushing across his whole origin to cycle with all his cells when he simply breathed with the means of the Second Volume of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi....
It was enough to cause him to feel full of health and energy with every single breath.

His resource renewal speed was elevating itself towards an astounding degree as since all of his aspects of existence were undergoing a change, so would his Unrecorded Eonic Hyperverse Extremity Foundation!

chapters.title: Chapter 2606 Vitalis and Vacuous!
paragraphs: 2606 Vitalis and Vacuous!
In a distant memory within the mind of an existence locked away from space and time.

Tendrils of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority danced on the fingers of a young woman as in front of her, a massive shadowy figure blazing with extremely potent Vacuous Hyperversal Authority could be seen.
All around them, only darkness and void remained as the entity before her spoke.
[Do you know the difference between us and the Vitalis Malignancies?]
The voice was much kinder than before, seemingly appreciative of the progress that the young woman had made since her Second Vacuous Awakening.
When she opened her apathetic eyes and shook her head, the entity before her continued.

[As we grow, we are closely interlinked with Vacuous Hyperversal Authority as our souls passively absorb and enrich our existence until we have our First Vacuous Awakening. This grants us much more power and possibilities as the Vitalis Malignancies...they only have trace amounts of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority within their bodies throughout their lifetime. Due to how much greater Vitalis Hyperversal Authority is compared to Vacuous Hyperversal Authority, they are not able to undergo any Awakening unless they have traversed far in Extremity and learn to actively refine and absorb Vitalis with greater potency.]

[Our greatest enemies...are the Vitalis Malignancies who are gradually becoming aware of the sheer strength of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority. But they are still young and rudimentary. Were they like us and capable of undergoing Awakenings as easily, this war we fight to defend ourselves would have long since been over.]
As he spoke, the Entity shrouded in Vacuous Hyperversal Authority gazed into the distance with unknown emotions before he continued.

[Others do not admit of the supremacy of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority over Vacuous Hyperversal Authority like I do...but we all inherently know it. Otherwise, how could the Seven Vitalis Havens be so powerful to even deny entry to us? How could its foul tendrils of authority continue to invade our homes? What we need to do to win this war is accept our limitations...and focus on our strengths. We need to win this war before any more of them understand the authority around them. We need more entities like you who can survive within the Seven Vitalis Havens and systematically break them down from within before they learn what they truly have all around them. Do you understand...Svetlana?]
His eyes were deep and filled with immeasurable light.
He seemed to be carrying the weight of countless things on his shoulders as terrifying Vacuous Hyperversal Authority of stupendous power shone in his eyes!
"I understand." And the emotionless reply from Svetlana was simple.

[Mmm. The appearance of the Vitalis Malignancies is a danger as well as an chance for us. Their bodies are like tonics as assimilating then spurs and stimulates the Vacuous Hyperversal Authority within us to be refined at an even greater pace, our power slowly approaching a level where we could even begin to contemplate rising up against...them. The Ones Above Extremity!]
WAA!
An utterly heavy term escaped from his lips as Svetlana gazed at him with her cold eyes after that.
They held hesitation within as she spoke slowly.

"Master...if we assimilate the Seven Vitalis Havens and obtain their power. If we rise against The Ones Above Extremity and obtain their power...will we finally be done, Master? Will all the fighting and death stop?"
Svetlana's words caused the enormous dark entity to turn silent as he continued to stare out into nothingness.
He didn't seem to have an answer for her when it came to this question as he remained silent.
Would it ever stop?
When they reached a certain height, would everything attain a state of peace and prosperity as they spent the remainder of their life in serenity?
The dark entity actually had an answer.
But after all the horrors he had put this girl before him through, he just couldn't bring himself to give her the answer.
As this...would simply be too cruel.
The change was not instant.
The change was also not normal.
The First Vacuous Awakening. The First Vitalis Awakening!
All of it was entirely foreign to Noah as out of the many transformations he had, this one did not finish within seconds, minutes, or even hours.

His Main Body had been floating at the very peak of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven that was contained in a Recorded History, the reality around him distorted as the Infinite Hyperversal Haven itself built a circular Minor Haven around him pulsing with life.

His will was also affected in his other bodies as they all continued his soul, with the changes that were occurring around him almost making him want to enter hibernation and entirely close off his Soul!
So he limited how much he was expressing himself in his other bodies.
The visage of Alexander King returned to the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as this part of Noah's soul faced the same transformation.

His will only remained entirely active with a sliver of his concentration in the clones that were with the Adjudicator of Dissolution, the Reified Wealdian Sources of Extremity, Ayame of the Infinite Extremity in the Haven of Helios, and Erikson of the Sima Clan in the Haven of Genesis!
As the Awakening went underway, the repercussions of the actions of the Avernus Extremities were only now beginning to unfold as the conclusion to this event was utterly heartbreaking!
In the Haven of Dissolution.

Noah's clone grasped the Curagulus Mask in his hands as his eyes hid the light of the fact that a majority of his soul was in a state of hibernation, his words calm as he spoke out towards the Adjudicator who seemed lost in thought.
"The Investiture of Extremity has been talked about a great deal by you and others. And yet...it seems like it isn't worth a shred of shit after the recent actions."
...His words were straightforward as they roused the contemplative Adjudicator up to gaze at his visage!
The Investiture of Extremity that was set up by the Senatus of Extremity.
The forces of the Avernus Clan may as well have ripped it to shreds with their recent actions!

chapters.title: Chapter 2607 Sima Ascending Mountain of Extremity! I
paragraphs: 2607 Sima Ascending Mountain of Extremity! I
"Has the number come out for how many perished in the Cult of Endless Shadows?"
Noah asked with a cold look as part of the reason events had unfolded the way they did was due to the path he chose.
But he wasn't alone in choosing this as the Cult of Endless Shadows also jumped in the bed with him- neither of them expecting the enemy side to do what they just did!
At his words, Svetlana's eyes pulsed with authority as she replied with anger.
[Quintillions of existences. Hundreds of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms..and two Hyperversal Extremities.]
The number was rather alarming to hear as the losses were devastating!

During the battle, Extremity Blue, Ariana, and Chamber Master Gayacus were the focal points. But the past Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction and other Avernus Extremities were also there as they fought against the Tier 1 and Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity Shadows.

The last Extremity of Destruction was particularly trying to live up to his old name as he had unleashed all of his power to actually erase two Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities from the Cult of Endless Shadows out of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity!

Most of those surviving out of the forces of the Cult of Endless Shadows were those who had left to come to Dissolution, along with the Extremities that came with them as at this moment, rage and outcries were all that could be heard from them.

"I'm curious to see the great Senatus of Extremity deal with all this. Or at the very least, what is the Curagulus of Extremity prepared to do if the Senatus of Extremity fails to step in? Since during this whole siege in Penumbra, its Adjudicator didn't even let out a squeak."
WAA!
His words pulsed with power as he spoke.
And this time, the Adjudicator of Dissolution took a long time before she could even reply.
The hours passed with dreariness as tumultuous waves seemed to be spreading within the Seven Havens.
Within the Haven of Genesis.
On the eastern region of this Haven, the most respected Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity were clustered like stellar bodies that rotated around a single behemoth.
This behemoth...was the Sima Clan!

Countless Planes of Existence and even uniquely constructed Minor Havens were established all around the domains of the Sima Clan at the very center, with its Planes of Existence being structured in a way that made it look like a rising stellar mountain from afar.
A mountain made up of Planes of Existence and Minor Havens!
It was known as the Sima Ascending Mountain of Extremity.
Hundreds of Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity were laid out around the Sima Ascending Mountain of Extremity!

Those with strong connections to the Sima Clan could be found at the very bottom of this mountain as going higher, the pure bloodline lineage of those truly belonging to the Sima Clan could be felt as this entire location radiated power.
Towards the peak of the Sima Ascending Mountain of Extremity.
In a Minor Haven that could fit hundreds of Planes of Existence similar to the Abecedarian Sacrarium of the Learnean Lineage that Noah had arrived in when he first came.
This Minor Haven was known as the Neon Sima Haven, with a thriving civilization moving within similar to the tens of thousands of other Planes of Existence and Minor Havens around it!
It was full of life all around as different regions could be seen erecting crystalline structures light years in size as the abodes and homes of quintillions of beings.

The auras of three Hyperversal Extremities could be felt in this Haven alone as the brightest aura was located on top of a massive skyscraper that was millions of light years in length, and at the very peak of this skyscraper...
there existed a circular domain that radiated neon light all around the structures around it.
Within this neon domain of light.

The figure of Erikson could be seen sitting on a neon mat as beside him, a tan figure of striking resemblance also sat- his body pulsing with potent Hyperversal Extremity Authority as he seemed like a larger, older version of Erikson!

Before these two beings, Noah's visage draped in golden robes could be seen as he faced Erikson and a Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity Authority that he had come to know as the father of this Mutated Entity!
The Extremity of Foundation.
The Iron Fist!
It was a renowned Hyperversal Extremity of the Sima Clan who had yet to reach Zenith...but he didn't seem all that far away!
He was the reason why Erikson could speak as if he was speaking on behalf of the Sima Clan.
He was the reason why most Scions and Elders of Inheritances or Clans didn't bat any ill will towards Erikson!
At this moment, the Extremity of Foundation spoke to Noah as unlike his son's beach attire, he was adorned in a simple white robe that hid the bulging muscles within.

[You made them your enemy, so they naturally targeted you. And along the way, they obtained an Armament of Extremity. But even an Armament isn't enough for the Avernus Extremity Overlord to let loose his dog of Lunacy. For them to do this...it only confirms what the Perennial Sima Recorder has been sensing these past days.]
The eyes of this being shone with profound brilliance as he continued!

[Their actions say that they are not afraid of the consequences of their actions being implemented by the Senatus of Extremity. For this to be the case, the musings of Unrecorded Histories about an incoming change that will alter the very workings of the Seven Havens seem to be true. The Avernus Clan must be assured that in the coming chaos, them being held accountable for the destruction of an Inheritance of Extremity would be something far, far below in terms of importance.]
WAA!

[This also makes your path challenging as with my son's trust, you have gained the most up to date information that the Sima Clan has on the military of the Avernus Clan and the capabilities. But against a force that has no restraints binding them down...it will be an difficult reality for their public enemy.]
The Extremity of Foundation spoke calmly like before the protagonist who also rested on a neon mat, dense clusters of round light containing information about the Avernus Clan floated serenely!

chapters.title: Chapter 2608 Sima Ascending Mountain of Extremity! II
paragraphs: 2608 Sima Ascending Mountain of Extremity! II
A force without the shackles of the Investiture of Extremity that stated those more powerful could not attack and oppress others who were weaker!
When this reality set in, Erikson sneered before voicing out grandly.

"It had been a day since they attacked the Cult of Endless Shadows as their Overlord and remaining Extremities have appealed to the Senatus of Extremity, and yet all that has happened so far...is an Injunction of Extremity being called with the Extremities of the Avernus Clan involved to be put on the stand to answer for their actions! What does this do? If it were me, I would strip the being who massacred trillions of her power as such a defender...will do nothing in the end!"
Erikson's words were bold as he spoke of stripping the power of the Extremity of Lunacy who openly showed her nature.
Because of her actions, an Injunction of Extremity was called with the forces of the Avernus Clan summoned to be on the stand- the prime culprit being the Extremity of Lunacy- Extremity Blue!
Noah smiled and shook his head when he thought of this as his voice was calm.

"I've come across many enemies in my life, but the Avernus Clan is the only one that has so far given me setbacks. With this in mind, I don't expect them to face any negative consequences after doing what they did. But since I am their target...I'll be the one to retaliate even if the Senatus of Extremity does nothing!"
WAA!
His eyes were bright as his Vacuous and Vitalis Awakenings were still underway, and yet his Aspects of Existence were already beginning to express heart shaking changes.
Even in the face of a behemoth coming after him, he did not falter!
Erikson and the Extremity of Foundation smiled at Noah's words as the latter spoke while tapping his chin.

[The Seven Clans had long since expected a change to be coming as the last Haven began Extremity Sanctification, but we didn't know to what extent. Only now are those most in tune with the Aeonic Annals of Extremity beginning to realize the extent of the changes. But due to this, many of us prepared. My preparations...involved assuring my boorish son didn't have an early death as I collected Aeonic Treasures of Extremity and Hyperversal Extremity Treasures to raise his concepts towards the 17th Layer fairly quickly. But just such resources required my power and the utilization of the power of the Sima Clan. For a genius like you...I wish I could give you something similar. But the resources to achieve such a thing are too rare. I can at most get you to attain what was taken from you in the Cult of Endless Shadows- I could ask for you to be granted access to one of the Armaments of Extremity in the Vaults of Sima.]
[The only thing I shall ask is for you to share the values of the Sima Clan, and if in the disorder you manage to attain Extremity...use your power to stand with us in any chaos that unfolds.]
The words of the Extremity of Foundation were heavy!
Noah's potential was known as even the Curagulus of Extremity had scouted him, so how could other Extremities not see it?
Erikson's father wanted to rope him into the folds of the Sima Clan as before Noah's eyes, the possibility of accessing another Armament of Extremity was dangled!
His eyes turned into crescent smiles as in front of him, Erikson laughed boisterously.
"Haha, my father is more persuasive than I, hmm? Accept it. We already have enemies outside the Havens and enemies within. Having capable allies will not hurt."
WAA!
Tendrils of Oraculum shone on Noah's eyes as he nodded lightly.
"Then...the Infinite Hyperversal Haven shall be an comrade of the Sima Clan!"
The True Emperor of Quintessence proclaimed grandly.
An unknown power becoming allies with one of the Seven Clans.
One may scoff at this and say what exactly would the Sima Clan gain from this?!
But such beings were not looking into the future.
Such beings did not know what was coming.
At Noah's words, the Extremity of Foundation smiled and gazed out from the neon domain they were in and the vastness around them.

[To prepare for the unknown change, Major Inheritances and the Seven Clans have strengthened themselves to their utmost and collected enough resources to raise a few outstanding Scions and Elders towards Extremity. Now, the Avernus Clan is openly snatching Armaments of Extremity. With all this...

having an extra ally or two isn't bad! I'll send the request for what we talked about. Think closely on whether you wish to remain on the path of War with the Avernus Clan- their Overlord is something that even I am not confident in endure a few strikes of.]
The Hyperversal Extremity of Foundation rose up as he spoke, his figure beginning to walk away after dropping such a bomb as within moments, only Erikson and Noah remained in the Neon Domain!
Erikson had a stern look as he knew his father never spoke lightly.
He gazed towards Noah's calm figure as he spoke out.

"From the little time I've known you, you've never lost your confidence nor shown fear. What about now as you know the true extent of your enemy? Especially the Overlord of the Avernus Clan...he may likely be above even Adjudicators in power!"
Fear.
Was this something Noah ever felt against an overwhelming enemy?
The answer was clear as he held a devilish glint while gazing at the actuality around him.
His words were clear as they thundered out.
"Whether it be him or any others within the Avernus Clan...they will merely join the line of Extras to be stepped under my feet."
WAA!
"They're turning out to be Above Average Extras in this grand tale...but they're still just that. Extras that will come and go with the turning of the pages."
These grand declarations Noah made weren't meaningless or baseless.
He knew himself. And he could currently feel his current transformation.
His Awakening!
