9 different colors of overlapping pupils!
Nine-Pupiled!

When one gazed into his eyes, they would tremble and feel like an ancient resistance was gazing at them and seeing through all their secrets, the pupils constantly rotating like engines as they seemed to be absorbing the surrounding waves of authority.
[You have attained the Innate quality of Hyperversal I Assimilation.]

[Hyperversal I Assimilation]:: You can accept all kinds of essences, resources, and entities of reality into your existence and assimilate them to further strengthen yourself- their Source capable of being applied towards your Concepts of Extremity or Any Aspects of your Existence...
Hyperversal I Assimilation!

In the past, when the Adjudicator of Dissolution had been talking to Noah as he discussed devouring his enemies and making their strength his- she had uttered with distaste that he sounded very much like the Vacuous Malignancies who reveled in devouring Hyperversal Extremities as if they were tonics!
And truly...such beings were exactly that.
Their whole existence could be devoured and directed towards any part of an existence that had undergone Vacuous Awakening.

Any form of Loot Noah attained from here on out...he could assimilate it and choose where its source strengthened him- whether it was to build his Aletheian Havens of Extremity, advance his Soul, or towards his Boundary Layers!
His Boundary Layers.
Shadows had long since been placed in his Meridians as at this moment, 81 of Noah's Boundaries had been forcefully taken to the 16th Boundary Layer as well.
The 16th Boundary Layer that was attained from the Shadow Sword that Noah was cut short from!

There were two more opportunities within the Sima Clan and Infinite Extremity for Noah to grasp and see just how far he could go...and then there was the Culmination Step that was astounding even Hyperversal Extremities within Dissolution.
[More information is being quantified regarding the changes brought forth by both Vacuous and Vitalis Awakenings.]

The latest prompt told him he would have to learn for himself just how ridiculous his current body was, with his soul currently calm and without any raging storms as neither Vacuous nor Vitalis Hyperversal Authorities were clashing.

It wasn't because they had suddenly harmoniously fused in some way- but the advent of the Innate Vacuous Hyperversal Meridians made it so that his Soul was coursing with fantastical vessels that isolated and kept Vacuous Hyperversal Authority within, while the Innate Vitalis Hyperversal Meridians did the same with its respective authority!
The two opposing authorities were no longer clashing in Noah's body, but in the time that they were and after the Awakenings he had undergone...Noah was born anew as his power was utterly astounding.

From the hand he raised, Noah closed it into a fist as instantly, the liquified Vacuous Hyperversal Authority and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority swirling in the surroundings were absorbed into his body- the ancient runic tattoos on him lighting up with brilliance as they felt like ancient rivers that pristine authority flowed in!
Everything around him calmed as his Nine-Pupiled Eyes blinked, a dazzling blue-bordered stat panel appearing an instant later.
[Name]:: Noah Osmont
[Realm]:: Fourth Aletheian Haven of Extremity
[Lineage]:: Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor

[Titles]:: True Emperor of Quintessence, Wrathful Quintessential Hyperversal Demon Emperor, One Who Gazes Upon Hyperversal Authority, Aletheian, Indefatigable, Tyrannical Emperor, The Tainted, Anomaly, Home of the Weald, Awakener, Inscrutable, Hyperversal Anomaly...
[Quintessential Hyperversal Mana Value]:: Infinite
[Quintessential Hyperversal Vitality Value]:: 299,999
[Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Value]:: 299,999
[Quintessential Hyperversal Defense Value]:: 299,999
[Quintessential Hyperversal Damage Value]:: 299,999
[Hyperversal Dignity]:: 35
[Hyperversal Mastery]:: 35
[Absolute Hyperversal Authority Resistance]:: 37%
[Absolute Hyperversal Authority Penetration]:: 37%

[Dynamis of Extremity]:: Indefatigable(Quintessential Absolute), Aletheian(Quintessential Absolute), Vitalistic(Quintessential Absolute), Oraculum(Quintessential Absolute), Thanatos(Quintessential Absolute), Lotra(Quintessential Absolute)
[Boundaries of Extremity]:: Quintessence, Infinity, Shadows, Blood, Manadynamics, Loot, Reality, Dimensions, Anima, Body, Origin, Soul, Genesis, Apocalypse, Prana, Dreams, Avalon...
The statistical values of his main body.
Not his Reified Source of Quintessence that had a multiplier of 9.
Not his Reified Wealdian Sources of Extremity that also had a similar multiplier.
His Main Body!
In comparison, three days ago when the Apex War of Annihilation occurred, Ahpuch had his Soul Values approximately 20,000- with Noah's being slightly lower!
And here he was three days later.
His Nine-Pupiled Eyes blinked like ancient sins as he uttered out gloriously while raising his head.
"Acceptable..."
WAA!
The True Emperor of Quintessence looked at his progress and claimed it was acceptable!
His gaze went out far as it crossed the Infinite Hyperversal Haven and the Recorded History it was in.

It traversed the Aeonic Annals of Extremity and came to focus on the eyes of the clone beside the Adjudicator of Dissolution who was watching as one Scion after another was thrown on in defeat from the Vein Rifts stretched out across Dissolution!
The eyes of this clone flickered as the single pupil within doubled and then tripled until ultimately, 9 dazzling layered pupils appeared.
The skin begins to peel and flicker away as with this clone as an anchor...the Reified Wealdian Source of Indefatigable stepped forth.

Not with its characteristic and terrifying four faces as its original appearance, but with light complexion and calmness reminiscent of Noah's main physique as at this moment...it stopped giving off any perceive of authority or aura!

One's will and authority wouldn't even be able to perceive him unless they were looking straight at him, this change causing the Adjudicator of Dissolution to physically turn around as her eyes constricted when she gazed at Noah once more.
She had to gaze at him with her eyes.
She couldn't see him any other manner as her Hyperversal Will and Soul sensed him entirely disappearing in the past second!
If she wasn't looking at him, she wouldn't know he was there!

It was such an incredulous phenomenon as Noah didn't address it in any way, his form becoming decorated in light back plants and a loose-fitting obsidian shirt that showed off his glorious physique, as well as a glimpse of ancient runic tattoos forming into an infinity symbol on his chest.

An atmosphere of profound dignity and majesty surrounded him even when nothing about his aura or authority could be felt, his form slowly floating towards the Vein Rift that held the Smilodon Leviathan Lineage along with the Tier 3 Aquatic Eon Dragonfly and Lightning Titanoboa!
The extras had tried and kept on trying to gain entry even now as none were successful.
It was time for the protagonist to step onto the stage!

chapters.title: Chapter 2618 Man of the Hour! I
paragraphs: 2618 Man of the Hour! I
The Haven Saber Smilodon gazed at the millions of The Underdwellers as his eyes could see them plotting.
He could see them scheming as the Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Dissolution allowed to read their movements and even their very thoughts!
They thought they could sneak this way out of this through some unique methodologies, but they would come to find that only pure power was the answer.
And comparing The Underdwellers before him to their Havenly Lineage that was tasked with a glorious purpose...well, the result was apparent in the currently occurring reality.
Matched against equivalent existences from the Havenly Lineages who had achieved the same highest Boundary Layer, the Underdwellers still had yet to produce even a single being that gained entry!
It showed the discrepancy in power as they sought Extremity...but they didn't truly dedicate and sacrifice their very souls to it!

An Underdweller capable of matching even one being from their Havenly Lineage had yet to step forward as if things continued like this...then he had no worries about their Havenly Lineage being the ones to bear the weight of all that was to come.

Tendrils of Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Dissolution raged around the body of the Haven Saber Smilodon as he was gazing at the light years around this Nether Haven when his sharp canines glinted while turning towards a certain direction.
[Hmm?]
His authority pulsed as he nearly missed an Underdweller.
Even now as he stared at his levitating form that was coming towards the Vein Rifts, the Haven Saber Smilodon could not feel an aura emanating from this existence!
He...could not read the power of this being.
Unlike the masses of Underdwellers who easily had their thoughts laid out in the open, even the concepts of Extremity could not be felt from this being!

The Haven Saber Smilodon's eyes released a radiant sheen as the Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Dissolution around him danced, information and possibilities blooming within the mind of the Haven Saber Smilodon as he coldly gazed forward.
'Maybe?'
Noah's figure floated out serenely.

He approached the Vein Rifts before him just like many other Scions and Elders were doing, but a few eyes had already glanced over due to the fact that the Adjudicator of Dissolution was here- their wills drawn prior due to Noah being behind her!

There were also many sets of eyes that already had the region around Noah under observation as light years away, the figure of Extremity Ariana and a dozen other Avernus Extremities could be seen floating a distance away from another Vein Rift.

Ariana had purple flames simmering in her eyes as she noted the distance and closeness that Noah showed with the Adjudicator of Dissolution, her eyes revealing many things when a voice that nearly caused her to jump rang out beside her.
[You're so focused when staring at him...do you want to kill or pounce on him?]
Beside her, the lunatic that was Extremity Blue suddenly appeared as Ariana nearly cursed at her!
She gritted her teeth while replying calmly.
[All of these changes have just bloomed as nobody is clear yet on what the full circumstances is. I don't like that he's getting a chance to fight...]
Ever since the events in the Shadow Sea Plane and the Shadow Sword that Ariana had claimed, she had grown even more careful and cautious of the entity that was Noah Osmont!
[You're focusing on the wrong things, little sister...] Beside her, Extremity Blue smiled brilliantly while her gem like eyes shone.
Extremity Ariana kept her annoyance to herself as she wanted to ask this lunatic just who the hell was her little sister?!
Yet this lunatic continued as her smile turned utterly cold.

[Your concentration should be on the fact that at this moment, we cannot feel even an ounce of Concepts or an aura from him, and we're supposedly Hyperversal Extremities while he is an Apex Aeonic Lifeform!]
Brilliance shone in her eyes as around them, the eyes of the Avernus Extremities constricted and focused!
At this time, the figure of Noah stepped foot past the transparent barrier of the Vein Rift as he gazed calmly at the Leviathan Lineages before him.
Smilodons, Dragonflies, and Titanoboas!
Each of their bodies pulsed with power and great might as his languid eyes came to land on the entity emanating the most dangerous aura.
The Haven Saber Smilodon stated back at him coldly as he didn't call out a name yet.
Instead, his regal voice rang out.
[What is the highest Boundary Layer you have achieved?]
A smile formed on Noah's lips.
Inscrutable.
This feature of his entity made it so that even this powerful existence at the same stage if not beyond the Adjudicator of Dissolution to not be capable of seeing through him!
"The 16th Boundary Layer."
He spoke simply as the eyes of the Haven Saber Smilodon flashed, his stature being able to ascertain the truth and falsehood of words as his voice boomed out soon after.
[Miguel, step forward.]
WAA!
A glorious aura blared forth.
The Legion of Smilodons in front of Noah parted ways as from them, the visage of an Earth Saber Smilodon coming through as its fur was drenched inky black.
The power of the 16th Boundary Layer of Dissolution surged on his paws explosively as above his head, an illusory obsidian flaming crown of Dissolution roared to life!
The Earth Saber Smilodon named Miguel stared at Noah, and he was met with eerie Nine-Pupiled Eyes that gave off unseen pressure.
But the might of the Smilodon wouldn't falter.
It would do what many other Havenly Lineages had done against the Underdwellers that had come forth.
It would strike and smash this being back to where he came from!
[HO!]
Flames of Dissolution freely flowed from the body of the Earth Saber Smilodon as he treated this battle with utmost seriousness since the enemy's power couldn't be properly gauged.
SAA!
A flicker of black light.
And an instant later, the pristine sharp claws of the right limb of the Earth Saber Smilodon appeared on the right side of Noah's floating figure!
Disappointment dawned on the eyes of the Smilodon.
His enemy didn't erupt with any power, nor did he even react to turn to the right to defend.
He deserved the loss that was coming if he couldn't even react to his speed!
The claw of the Smilodon thundered down as...
BZZT!
A fantastical scene unfolded.

The Smilodon didn't know when, but the hand of the entity adorned in loose fitting black pants and shirt had risen as two fingers on his hand clamped out...and the claw of the Smilodon carrying the weight of Dissolution behind it was entirely stopped!
Crackles of inky black Dissolution buzzed and erupted as if metal was grating on metal.
The Earth Saber Smilodon felt as if his claws were clamped and held down with the weight of a Haven as the being responsible slowly turned his head to the right.
And the soul of the Earth Saber Smilodon vibrated with astonishment as it stared into nine pupils that now seemed like 9 endless swirling storms of the abyss!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 2619 Man Of The Hour! II
paragraphs: 2619 Man of the Hour! II
All the battles that had occurred so far when Scions and Elders of Inheritances and Clans stepped into the Vein Rifts had ended the same way.

Complete and utter thrashing as the quality of power was on a completely different scale when the Scions and Elders battled against equivalent Leviathan Lineages that had attained the same stage of Extremity!
One of the main causes behind this was none other than the fact that the Leviathan Lineages all pulsed with the authority of Dissolution.
The authority of the very Haven they stood on and the very authority still spilling out senselessly from the Vein Rift!
Fight after fight, the result was the same as the Scions and Elders wouldn't even last a few moves.

So...when an existence facing a Leviathan pulsing with Dissolution showed off a shocking scene of dominance to the extent that he wasn't even moved back by an attack...many eyes and Wills began to draw over!
Who was he?
What was his level of power? Which Clan or Inheritance did he stem from?!
These questions buzzed as a vast number of wills across the indeterminate light years came to focus on a single Vein Rift that showed off a devilishly handsome man.
He arrived and made all others focus on him.
As if he was the man of the hour!
The sensation was indescribable.
When the Earth Saber Smilodon began moving. When flames of Dissolution erupted around its body. When its claws came towards him.
It was immeasurably fast in the eyes of others, but for him...it was so slow!
Just his spread-out will allowed him to see it all as his Foundation which had been absolutely jacked by the First Vacuous Awakening and the First Vitalis Awakening was just this frightening!

While the Smilodon was coming in the span of an instant, Noah was able to lock onto it as his Nine-Pupiled Eyes blazed with gold, even more details now being pulled out when he looked at this creature.
[Name]:: Miguel
[Realm]:: Minor Haven of Dissolution
[Lineage]:: Havenly Smilodon Lineage
[Titles]:: Havenly Beast, Saber-Toothed, Havenly Dissolution Extremity Foundation...
[Havenly Dissolution Mana Value]:: 50,000
[Havenly Dissolution Vitality Value]:: 50,000
[Havenly Dissolution Soul Value]:: 50,000
[Havenly Dissolution Defense Value]:: 50,000
[Havenly Dissolution Damage Value]:: 50,000
[Dynamis of Extremity]:: Dissolution
[Boundaries of Extremity]:: Dissolution
The reason why they outclassed Scions and Elders so much.
From their side, they were calling them Leviathan Lineages as on their end, they were known as the Havenly Lineages!

And the values of a single Entity of the Havenly Smilodon Lineage who had achieved the 16th Boundary Layer is Dissolution was two times compared to a Direct Disciple of a Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity like Ahpuch who had also only achieved the 16th Layer as his highest.
The Havenly Lineages were powerful!
If Noah had met them just three days ago before the war, maybe he would be on the same boat as other Scions and Elders like today.
But now...
"Get ready."
His voice was calm as he addressed the astounded Earth Saber Smilodon.
His fingers that were clamping down on the claw released and straightened as they all pointed towards the Earth Saber Smilodon, and an instant later...his fingers were retracted to form a fist!
A fist.
Just the formation of a fist!
The pressure of this formed fist thundered forth as in the eyes of others, a blinding cylindrical beam of multicolored light instantly barreled forth!
And yet, it was the authority of the Indefatigable Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity released from the Reified Wealdian Source of Indefatigable!
ZAA!
The multicolored beam of light disappeared just as quickly as it had erupted.

When it faded, the eyes of the Earth Saber Smilodon before Noah were dim as its long canines were shattered, cracks extending from throughout its inky black body as a number that only Noah could see rose before this beast.
He precisely controlled his output to release a damage value that would leave behind a single Vitality Value on this Entity.
He didn't go for death as there were three terrifying Tier 3 Hyperversal Havenly Beasts right behind this one!
Its body shuddered as golden blood flowed like rivers, immense silence descending in the surroundings as from its body, Noah saw a flash of light be released and flow towards him.
His hand rose to grasp it as it couldn't forcefully make its way into his body unless he allowed it, and after he affirmed there were no issues, it sank in smoothly as a prompt rose!
[You have attained 10 Units of Havenly Aurora!]
When the Maiden of Orientis lost, she had lost a significant portion of her Soul Values as they were even permanently reduced- all of this going towards the victor who had defeated her.
Now after Noah defeated a Havenly Beast, he attained 10 Units of Havenly Aurora!
This unique form of energy was collected into a corner of his soul calmly as when he tried to peer into it...
[The Usage of the Units of Havenly Aurora is currently unknown.]
The information wasn't there.
The reality around him resumed.
The Scions, Elders, and Extremities watching in front of other Vein Rifts had shining eyes as they stared at the unbelievable scene that had just occurred.
For the first time, someone from their side had actually defeated a Leviathan Beast!
In the far distance, in a region where massive vessels and the powerhouses of the Sima Clan were clustered.
The Extremity of Foundation stood behind Erikson and many other Sima Clan Scions as he spoke to his son with a calm gaze.
[You continue to be right about him.]

The words were meant to acknowledge Erikson's foresight, but his expression remained free and unbound as for today's occasion, his beach attire had changed to a shade of orange-red. As if to welcome a setting sun!
He gazed at the figure of Noah in the distance as well as the Vein Rift before the eyes of the Sima Clan.
At this moment, he already began to distort the probability of the events to come as he was ready!
On another side, the figures carrying a sense of despondency and desolation could be seen as they were wrapped in shadows.
The Primeval Shadow Elder Silas and others stood behind Laos, Flashing Shadow, and even the Shadow Extremity Overlord as they also gazed towards Noah!
Their thoughts were hard to read as gazes of maddened rage would occasionally turn towards the region clustering the forces of the Avernus Clan!

Many beings had just begun to react to the shocking first win within a battle to occur on their side as one Scion who had been watching this battle unfold since Noah stepped forward spoke with an incredulous expression as if he had just realized something.
"Wait...did he say his highest Boundary Layer was the 16th?"
Before the battle began, the Haven Saber Smilodon had asked Noah his highest Layer. It was only now that some people who held more information fully processed this as their minds began to pound!
Their eyes became stern as they looked at this being ahead of them.
He wasn't even an Apex Aeonic Lifeform until a few days ago as far as they knew, and he had already taken a Boundary to the 16th Layer?!
This was akin to a prized Scion being given the resources and nurturing of a massive Inheritance or Clan!
So what exactly had this being relied on to bring a Boundary to the 16th Layer?!
A question that held no answer.

Within the Vein Rift, the Haven Saber Smilodon looked at Noah with a dazzling obsidian light as his voice thundered out while waves of his authority wrapped around the Earth Saber Smilodon Noah had spared to pull it back.
[You have come out victorious and gained entry-]
[Like hell he did!]
BOOM!
Before the words of the Haven Saber Smilodon ended, a dazzling allure of Blue erupted out as Hyperversal Haki of Extremity thundered from all directions!
The Adjudicator of Dissolution quickly reacted as she was about to make a move, and yet her hand came to a halt an instant later as she felt no need to.
A maddening flicker of cerulean light was surprised at this, but it continued forward nonetheless as the target was the being emanating not even an ounce of an aura!
And yet before her Hyperversal Haki of Extremity or even her visage came close...
BZZT!
Astounding waves of Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Disintegration seethed as everything was wiped away.
After all, there were three Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities just at the forefront of this Vein Rift!
The figure of a woman with snow-white hair adorned in a blue battle dress became clear.
And before her, the glorious visage of a cold-faced Aquatic Eon Dragonfly could be seen- this being the existence that had effortlessly eliminated her Hyperversal Haki of Extremity!
Extremity Blue watched forward and spoke with squinting eyes
[Hey, beastie...] Her expression was calm as she stared at the Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity before her.
[Could you move aside just for a second? I just want to put to sleep that guy behind you there, and I'll leave right after...pinky promise!]
Her fair hand reached out as her smallest finger was raised.
The swirling gaze of the Aquatic Eon Dragonfly pulsed as its voice thundered out.
[You may gain passage so long as you are victorious.]
The same words.

Immeasurable grandeur overflowed as behind the Aquatic Eon Dragonfly, Noah's silhouette became bathed in a wondrous light- the Legion of Earth Saber Smilodons before that being parting as they exposed a hazy mist in the distance that hid unknown lands!

[Lineage]:: Havenly Smilodon Lineage
[Titles]:: Havenly Beast, Saber-Toothed, Havenly Dissolution Extremity Foundation...
[Havenly Dissolution Mana Value]:: 50,000
[Havenly Dissolution Vitality Value]:: 50,000
[Havenly Dissolution Soul Value]:: 50,000
[Havenly Dissolution Defense Value]:: 50,000
[Havenly Dissolution Damage Value]:: 50,000
[Dynamis of Extremity]:: Dissolution
[Boundaries of Extremity]:: Dissolution
The reason why they outclassed Scions and Elders so much.
From their side, they were calling them Leviathan Lineages as on their end, they were known as the Havenly Lineages!

And the values of a single Entity of the Havenly Smilodon Lineage who had achieved the 16th Boundary Layer is Dissolution was two times compared to a Direct Disciple of a Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity like Ahpuch who had also only achieved the 16th Layer as his highest.
The Havenly Lineages were powerful!
If Noah had met them just three days ago before the war, maybe he would be on the same boat as other Scions and Elders like today.
But now...
"Get ready."
His voice was calm as he addressed the astounded Earth Saber Smilodon.
His fingers that were clamping down on the claw released and straightened as they all pointed towards the Earth Saber Smilodon, and an instant later...his fingers were retracted to form a fist!
A fist.
Just the formation of a fist!
The pressure of this formed fist thundered forth as in the eyes of others, a blinding cylindrical beam of multicolored light instantly barreled forth!
And yet, it was the authority of the Indefatigable Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity released from the Reified Wealdian Source of Indefatigable!
ZAA!
The multicolored beam of light disappeared just as quickly as it had erupted.

When it faded, the eyes of the Earth Saber Smilodon before Noah were dim as its long canines were shattered, cracks extending from throughout its inky black body as a number that only Noah could see rose before this beast.
He precisely controlled his output to release a damage value that would leave behind a single Vitality Value on this Entity.
He didn't go for death as there were three terrifying Tier 3 Hyperversal Havenly Beasts right behind this one!
Its body shuddered as golden blood flowed like rivers, immense silence descending in the surroundings as from its body, Noah saw a flash of light be released and flow towards him.
His hand rose to grasp it as it couldn't forcefully make its way into his body unless he allowed it, and after he affirmed there were no issues, it sank in smoothly as a prompt rose!
[You have attained 10 Units of Havenly Aurora!]
When the Maiden of Orientis lost, she had lost a significant portion of her Soul Values as they were even permanently reduced- all of this going towards the victor who had defeated her.
Now after Noah defeated a Havenly Beast, he attained 10 Units of Havenly Aurora!
This unique form of energy was collected into a corner of his soul calmly as when he tried to peer into it...
[The Usage of the Units of Havenly Aurora is currently unknown.]
The information wasn't there.
The reality around him resumed.
The Scions, Elders, and Extremities watching in front of other Vein Rifts had shining eyes as they stared at the unbelievable scene that had just occurred.
For the first time, someone from their side had actually defeated a Leviathan Beast!
In the far distance, in a region where massive vessels and the powerhouses of the Sima Clan were clustered.
The Extremity of Foundation stood behind Erikson and many other Sima Clan Scions as he spoke to his son with a calm gaze.
[You continue to be right about him.]
The words were meant to acknowledge Erikson's foresight, but his expression remained free and unbound as for today's occasion, his beach attire had changed to a shade of orange-red.
As if to welcome a setting sun!
He gazed at the figure of Noah in the distance as well as the Vein Rift before the eyes of the Sima Clan.
At this moment, he already began to distort the probability of the events to come as he was ready!
On another side, the figures carrying a sense of despondency and desolation could be seen as they were wrapped in shadows.
The Primeval Shadow Elder Silas and others stood behind Laos, Flashing Shadow, and even the Shadow Extremity Overlord as they also gazed towards Noah!
Their thoughts were hard to read as gazes of maddened rage would occasionally turn towards the region clustering the forces of the Avernus Clan!

Many beings had just begun to react to the shocking first win within a battle to occur on their side as one Scion who had been watching this battle unfold since Noah stepped forward spoke with an incredulous expression as if he had just realized something.
"Wait...did he say his highest Boundary Layer was the 16th?"
Before the battle began, the Haven Saber Smilodon had asked Noah his highest Layer.
It was only now that some people who held more information fully processed this as their minds began to pound!
Their eyes became stern as they looked at this being ahead of them.
He wasn't even an Apex Aeonic Lifeform until a few days ago as far as they knew, and he had already taken a Boundary to the 16th Layer?!
This was akin to a prized Scion being given the resources and nurturing of a massive Inheritance or Clan!
So what exactly had this being relied on to bring a Boundary to the 16th Layer?!
A question that held no answer.

Within the Vein Rift, the Haven Saber Smilodon looked at Noah with a dazzling obsidian light as his voice thundered out while waves of his authority wrapped around the Earth Saber Smilodon Noah had spared to pull it back.
[You have come out victorious and gained entry-]
[Like hell he did!]
BOOM!
Before the words of the Haven Saber Smilodon ended, a dazzling allure of Blue erupted out as Hyperversal Haki of Extremity thundered from all directions!
The Adjudicator of Dissolution quickly reacted as she was about to make a move, and yet her hand came to a halt an instant later as she felt no need to.
A maddening flicker of cerulean light was surprised at this, but it continued forward nonetheless as the target was the being emanating not even an ounce of an aura!
And yet before her Hyperversal Haki of Extremity or even her visage came close...
BZZT!
Astounding waves of Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Disintegration seethed as everything was wiped away.
After all, there were three Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities just at the forefront of this Vein Rift!
The figure of a woman with snow-white hair adorned in a blue battle dress became clear.
And before her, the glorious visage of a cold-faced Aquatic Eon Dragonfly could be seen- this being the existence that had effortlessly eliminated her Hyperversal Haki of Extremity!
Extremity Blue watched forward and spoke with squinting eyes
[Hey, beastie...] Her expression was calm as she stared at the Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity before her.
[Could you move aside just for a second?
I just want to put to sleep that guy behind you there, and I'll leave right after...pinky promise!]
Her fair hand reached out as her smallest finger was raised.
The swirling gaze of the Aquatic Eon Dragonfly pulsed as its voice thundered out.
[You may gain passage so long as you are victorious.]
The same words.

Immeasurable grandeur overflowed as behind the Aquatic Eon Dragonfly, Noah's silhouette became bathed in a wondrous light- the Legion of Earth Saber Smilodons before that being parting as they exposed a hazy mist in the distance that hid unknown lands!

chapters.title: Chapter 2620 Havenly Aurora! I
paragraphs: 2620 Havenly Aurora! I
[You have come out victorious and gained entry into the Supernal Haven of Dissolution. Be mindful of your actions within as if you offend those you should not, your life is not guaranteed.]
The Haven Saber Smilodon spoke while its cold eyes stared at the figure of Extremity Blue who had interrupted him earlier in the corner of his eyes.
"Supernal Haven of Dissolution?" Noah's eyes rose as he saw the Earth Saber Smilodon Legion parting ways to reveal a hazy dark mist in the distance that shrouded what lay behind it.
Whatever lay behind was termed Supernal Haven of Dissolution as he sought to see if this horrifying Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity would reveal any more information!
And the Haven Saber Smilodon pulsed with tendrils of Dissolution as an authoritative voice thundered out coldly.

[The Haven you all are in is the Nether Haven of Dissolution. Within it, the potency and purity of Dissolution are at their lowest as most of the Underdwellers within it will not even have the right to embark on Dissolution itself.]

The Aeonic Haven of Dissolution was termed the Nether Haven of Dissolution, with the words of the Haven Saber Smilodon stating that beyond the Vein Rifts, they would appear in the Supernal Haven of Dissolution!
One was below, one was above.
One was outside of the Extremity Vein, the other could only be accessed within!
And Noah along with all those in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution were termed...
[Underdwellers? Us? Haha!] The annoying voice of the Extremity of Lunacy echoed out as her head peeked beside the Aquatic Eon Dragonfly.
Her eyes shimmered with blue light as she continued to speak once more.
[You told him he was granted access and that he should be mindful not to offend those he shouldn't in this Supernal Haven of Dissolution lying ahead...
does that mean there aren't any sort of rulings that would prevent an Extremity from giving an eternal nap to a being of lesser power that offended her?]
Noah's eyes shone dangerously at Extremity Blue's words.
Outside of the Vein Rift, the eyes of the Adjudicator of Dissolution radiated terrifying splendor at the advent of such words!
And then...the Haven Saber Smilodon gazed at Extremity Blue as if he were looking at a fool as he spoke grandly.
[Rulings? The only ruling within any of the Supernal Havens of Extremity is strength. If this being here has offended you and you want to kill, you can kill. You simply need to gain entry.]
BOOM!
Explosive words thundered out as the minds of all those watching buzzed.
Right.

The Investiture of Extremity that stated that those of higher power could not act against those less powerful than them was instituted by the Senatus of Extremity in order to maintain a semblance of order in the Seven Havens!
In the Seven Havens they knew and lived in.
There was no such thing in these lands that the Haven Saber Smilodon termed the Supernal Havens of Extremity!
Strength was king.
Strength spoke for itself as if one had power, they could do whatever they wanted!
When she heard this, Extremity Blue let out a raucous laugh that before it could finish...
[Of course...] The voice of the Haven Saber Smilodon thundered out again as this time it was focused on her.
[...you have offended me just now. So if you happen to gain access into the Supernal Haven of Dissolution, just know that if I feel like it, I may also choose to put you to sleep permanently.]
WAA!
The Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Dissolution crashed madly.
The smile and laugh on Extremity Blue's face were wiped away as a horrifying atmosphere bloomed.
In front of her, a radiant obsidian Temporal Field of Dissolution bloomed as the cold eyes of the Haven Saber Smilodon shone while the dominant voice resonated again!
[Zaman, step forward!]
From behind the Legions of Earth Saber Smilodon.

The obsidian mist churned and roiled as an immediate later, a glorious aura of a Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity bloomed- the visage of a red-striped Haven Saber Smilodon appearing as its aura was much less threatening than the Zenith Haven Saber Smilodon that had been talking this whole time!
Extremity Blue had not achieved Zenith.
She was not matched with any of the three Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity Havenly Beasts that were already here as her match was called out from the Supernal Haven of Dissolution!

The unfolding scene was utterly breathtaking as a great deal of information was unveiled, and immense dangers also showed themselves as Extremity Blue gazed in the far distance where the troops of the Avernus Clan were clustered.

Her eyes sent out a clear message as Extremity Ariana and the others there knew exactly what she stated, the Avernus Extremities moving authoritatively as their troops began to swarm towards nearby Vein Rifts to seek access!
Since if they were powerful enough to enter the Supernal Haven of Dissolution, they would not be bound or restricted by the Investiture of Extremity that they had already begun to violate.
At such a conclusion, Extremity Blue herself smiled crazily as she turned into a streak of light that surged towards the Temporal Field before her, but not before her voice thundered out.
[Wait patiently for me, Little Osmont.]
SHAA!
With a blink of light, she disappeared.
Noah gazed at this scene with profound coldness as he also turned around and floated towards the obsidian mist in the distance!
'Wait!'
The voice of the Adjudicator of Dissolution buzzed in Noah's mind at such a moment as he didn't stop.

He knew what she was going to say. She wanted him to continue being reliant on her power and the power of others to defend against Hyperversal Extremities in these new and unexplored lands that didn't prevent them from acting out against those of lesser power!
But Noah had seen time and time again how even she could not do anything to stop the violations of the Investiture of Extremity.
He had long since decided to not rely on others as he only sent back a single message to the Adjudicator of Dissolution!
'I'm not worried about a mere Hyperversal Extremity. They had been hunting me then, and they're hunting me now. I'll deal with it as I see fit.'
The power of other beings could not be relied on.

Only his own power would give the most guarantee as without looking back, he passed the ranks of the Earth Saber Smilodon that were staring at him cautiously and with a combative battle spirit as he delved towards the obsidian mist in the distance!

chapters.title: Chapter 2621 Havenly Aurora! II
paragraphs: 2621 Havenly Aurora! II

The unfolding reality and exchanged words that revealed a great deal of information caused a buzz to rise in the surroundings, the wills and eyes of many beings observing as the first of their kind delved into the obsidian mist past the Veil Rift as he was the first to be granted entry into whatever this Culmination Step of Dissolution was!
His entry was akin to a rousing fire that began to burn endlessly. Like the match that set off endless suns!

More and more Inheritances and Clans sent their forces forth into the myriad of Vein Rifts stretched out across the Nether Haven of Dissolution, no longer sending their weakest as some of the truly powerful Scions and Elders began to make a move!

In the Vein Rift holding the grand visage of the Haven Saber Smilodon, Aquatic Eon Dragonfly, and Lightning Titanoboa, the Temporal Field of Dissolution that Extremity Blue had gone in pulsed with a bright light as when the Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity called Zaman was about to delve in...
[Wait.]
The Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity Haven Saber Smilodon spoke out once more as Zaman instantly halted and nodded respectfully.
[Yes, Lord Commander.]
Lord Commander.

This was what the Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity was referred to as his voice echoed out with a sneering light when he watched the Temporal Field of Dissolution that Extremity Blue had disappeared into!
[Let her simmer in there a bit longer.]

The words of the Lord Commander Smilodon were astonishing as they showed these Havenly Beasts guarding the Vein Rift were bound by some process, and yet there was some leeway in how they acted in all this!
The actions of Extremity Blue were disliked by the Lord Commander as at this moment, her combatant did not yet enter the Temporal Field of Dissolution.
This scene was observed by many as next, yet another event that caused many wills to buzz occurred.
A veiled figure who actually emanated waves of Dissolution from the Underdwellers came forward and stepped past the transparent barrier of the Vein Rift.
It was the Adjudicator of Dissolution herself as the Lord Commander Smilodon gazed at her calmly, his voice the same as ever.
[You may gain passage so long as you are victorious.]
WAA!
Along with his words, a second Temporal Field of Dissolution opened up in this space as the head of the Lord Commander Smilodon turned towards the massive Lightning Titanoboa on the side!
[Batiatus, accompany her and observe her worth as a Zenith.]

Even more explosive words affirming the stature that the Adjudicator of Dissolution had achieved thundered out as obsidian lightning of Dissolution surged, the massive Lightning Titanoboa moving from the back as it disappeared into a flash of light in the next second that entered the Temporal Field.
The veiled figure of the Adjudicator of Dissolution also didn't delay as a moment later, she also flickered and disappeared!
The obsidian mist obscured one's will and vision as nothing past it could be seen unless it was crossed.

It felt similar to the thick wall of Dissolution they had faced at the end of the Initiation Step of Extremity Sanctification, with Noah crossing the Mist of Dissolution speedily as he felt the spacetime continuum distort in magnificent ways!
It meant that this mist wasn't just something like a wall that after a person crossed, they would arrive at some land opposite it.
It distorted space similar to the wormholes that formed to take existences from the Planar Palisades of Extremity and into the Seven Havens as after Noah navigated multiple spatial distortions...
SAA!
He finally saw brightness.
He finally felt something new.
Behind him, an endlessly vertical obsidian Wall of Dissolution stretched up and down as ahead of him...was a fantastical sight that caused his Nine-
Pupiled Eyes to radiate profound brilliance!

First, the surroundings were heavily concentrated with tendrils of Dissolution, but Noah could also see crimson tendrils of light that he recognized as Helios, as well as white tendrils that should represent Genesis!

4 other wondrously colored tendrils intermixed in this space as it seemed like the highest concentration was Dissolution, but the minuscule authorities of the other Supernal Havens of Extremity were also here!
And ahead of him...the astonishing scene of a massive island the size of a Major Plane of Existence could be seen.
Hazy obsidian streams of Dissolution leaked from the ends of the island like a waterfall as atop it, ancient and titanic trees and vegetation rose endlessly!

In addition to this, an overabundance of auras and Lifeforms could be felt on this island as Noah saw endless variations of the Havenly Smilodon Lineage either floating between the innumerable obsidian white trees or walking on its verdant lush grasslands.

They varied in power as most were in the Boundary Expansion Realm, with Noah being able to sense thousands in the Apex Aeonic Lifeform level just on this floating island the size of a Major Plane of Existence before him!
All of this was paired with the blazing auras of four Hyperversal Extremities burning brightly on this landmass.
What was more astonishing was that further away, to Noah's left and right...

similar floating islands such as this could be seen as on the right side, light years away, the outline of another floating island holding hundreds of thousands of the Havenly Titanoboa Lineage could be seen.
To the left, yet another floating island with numerous beasts of the Havenly Dragonfly Lineage could be seen!

Far below Noah, space stretched out endlessly until his eyes met billowing and roiling obsidian mist of Dissolution, and the skies were the same as they stretched out endlessly until billowing clouds of Dissolution obscured everything.
In between...clusters of gorgeous floating islands the size of Planes of Existence were stretched out as Noah was most astonished by a phenomenon at the very peak of these islands!
There, he could see a swirling Singularity that seemed to be collecting the pure authority of Dissolution from all around.
And in addition to this, he caught something with his eyes that others may not be able to see.
He could only see it because his body was currently filled with it as he held its Innate Vitalis Hyperversal Meridians!

He could see faint traces of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority manifesting from the surroundings and mixing with Dissolution in the singularity at the very peak of these floating islands, and then streams of fantastical light washed down onto these islands to form into...wonders.
Wonders was all he could call them.

Atop the island directly before him, dense clusters of what seemed to be Aeonic Treasures of Extremity could be seen surrounded by a halo of transparent light, along with the shocking scene of Golden, Obsidian, and even a few Crimson Extremity Panaceas here and there!

Fantastical treasures and different forms of loot were clustered beautifully across the skies of the floating island, the Havenly Smilodon Lineage moving around it nonchalantly as if it were the norm!

The pristine light floating from the Singularity of the intermixing Vitalis Hyperversal Authority and Dissolution continued to drip down as even now, Noah could see halos of circular bubbles holding half forged Aeonic Treasures of Extremity- treasures that were gradually becoming complete as others like them were littered all across this glorious floating landmass.
For light years.

The scene was mind boggling as Noah's eyes felt like there was something at play here- with the dense auras of Havenly Smilodon Beasts on this island moving about freely and not plucking the treasures before their eyes causing a sense of incongruency.
But he could figure this out slowly.
As he appeared, Noah saw the eyes of many of the Havenly Smilodons turn towards his direction, along with the oppressive wills of the four Hyperversal Extremities just on this island alone.
He began to float towards them as his body began to change, lustrous black fur with cherry-colored stripes appearing on his skin as his form turned beastial.

He went on his four limbs as his head soon transformed into the savage visage of an Earth sword Smilodon carrying shocking handsomeness, a flaming black crown that emanated the aura of Dissolution rising above as below his four paws wielding sharp claws, tendrils of authority that seemed like Dissolution buzzed feely!

His status as an Absolute Hyperversal Inscrutable presence was out to use as he took on the form of an Earth Saber Smilodon, his body giving off the aura and authority of Dissolution outwardly even though he had not grasped this Havenly Concept!

Since there were Hyperversal Extremities coming for him into these lands that only had strength as king, he would find his own ways to survive as at this moment...even if Blue arrived and saw Noah right before her eyes- she wouldn't be able to recognize him with his aura, Realm, body, or anything else as he floated to mix with the Havenly Smilodon Beasts on the massive island before him!

His speed was fast as he arrived within a nanosecond, the Earth sword Smilodons on the edge of the island looking at him with interested gazes as the moment Noah landed on the edge where luscious verdant and black grass grew, the voice of one of the Four Hyperversal Extremities within this landmass echoed out in his mind.

[The First Underdweller to arrive into our blessed Supernal Havens, and an interesting one at that to be able to mimic us so proficiently...Mmm, do you have enemies coming behind you? Well, no matter. Come, you shall have the honor of getting an introduction.]

It meant that this mist wasn't just something like a wall that after a person crossed, they would arrive at some land opposite it.
It distorted space similar to the wormholes that formed to take existences from the Planar Palisades of Extremity and into the Seven Havens as after Noah navigated multiple spatial distortions...
SAA!
He finally saw brightness.
He finally felt something new.
Behind him, an endlessly vertical obsidian Wall of Dissolution stretched up and down as ahead of him...was a fantastical sight that caused his Nine-
Pupiled Eyes to radiate profound brilliance!

First, the surroundings were heavily concentrated with tendrils of Dissolution, but Noah could also see crimson tendrils of light that he recognized as Helios, as well as white tendrils that should represent Genesis!

4 other wondrously colored tendrils intermixed in this space as it seemed like the highest concentration was Dissolution, but the minuscule authorities of the other Supernal Havens of Extremity were also here!
And ahead of him...the astonishing scene of a massive island the size of a Major Plane of Existence could be seen.
Hazy obsidian streams of Dissolution leaked from the ends of the island like a waterfall as atop it, ancient and titanic trees and vegetation rose endlessly!

In addition to this, an overabundance of auras and Lifeforms could be felt on this island as Noah saw endless variations of the Havenly Smilodon Lineage either floating between the innumerable obsidian white trees or walking on its verdant lush grasslands.

They varied in power as most were in the Boundary Expansion Realm, with Noah being able to sense thousands in the Apex Aeonic Lifeform level just on this floating island the size of a Major Plane of Existence before him!
All of this was paired with the blazing auras of four Hyperversal Extremities burning brightly on this landmass.
What was more astonishing was that further away, to Noah's left and right...

similar floating islands such as this could be seen as on the right side, light years away, the outline of another floating island holding hundreds of thousands of the Havenly Titanoboa Lineage could be seen.
To the left, yet another floating island with numerous beasts of the Havenly Dragonfly Lineage could be seen!

Far below Noah, space stretched out endlessly until his eyes met billowing and roiling obsidian mist of Dissolution, and the skies were the same as they stretched out endlessly until billowing clouds of Dissolution obscured everything.
In between...clusters of gorgeous floating islands the size of Planes of Existence were stretched out as Noah was most astonished by a phenomenon at the very peak of these islands!
There, he could see a swirling Singularity that seemed to be collecting the pure authority of Dissolution from all around.
And in addition to this, he caught something with his eyes that others may not be able to see.
He could only see it because his body was currently filled with it as he held its Innate Vitalis Hyperversal Meridians!

He could see faint traces of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority manifesting from the surroundings and mixing with Dissolution in the singularity at the very peak of these floating islands, and then streams of fantastical light washed down onto these islands to form into...wonders.
Wonders was all he could call them.

Atop the island directly before him, dense clusters of what seemed to be Aeonic Treasures of Extremity could be seen surrounded by a halo of transparent light, along with the shocking scene of Golden, Obsidian, and even a few Crimson Extremity Panaceas here and there!

Fantastical treasures and different forms of loot were clustered beautifully across the skies of the floating island, the Havenly Smilodon Lineage moving around it nonchalantly as if it were the norm!

The pristine light floating from the Singularity of the intermixing Vitalis Hyperversal Authority and Dissolution continued to drip down as even now, Noah could see halos of circular bubbles holding half forged Aeonic Treasures of Extremity- treasures that were gradually becoming complete as others like them were littered all across this glorious floating landmass.
For light years.

The scene was mind boggling as Noah's eyes felt like there was something at play here- with the dense auras of Havenly Smilodon Beasts on this island moving about freely and not plucking the treasures before their eyes causing a sense of incongruency.
But he could figure this out slowly.
As he appeared, Noah saw the eyes of many of the Havenly Smilodons turn towards his direction, along with the oppressive wills of the four Hyperversal Extremities just on this island alone.
He began to float towards them as his body began to change, lustrous black fur with cherry-colored stripes appearing on his skin as his form turned beastial.

He went on his four limbs as his head soon transformed into the savage visage of an Earth sword Smilodon carrying shocking handsomeness, a flaming black crown that emanated the aura of Dissolution rising above as below his four paws wielding sharp claws, tendrils of authority that seemed like Dissolution buzzed feely!

His status as an Absolute Hyperversal Inscrutable presence was out to use as he took on the form of an Earth Saber Smilodon, his body giving off the aura and authority of Dissolution outwardly even though he had not grasped this Havenly Concept!

Since there were Hyperversal Extremities coming for him into these lands that only had strength as king, he would find his own ways to survive as at this moment...even if Blue arrived and saw Noah right before her eyes- she wouldn't be able to recognize him with his aura, Realm, body, or anything else as he floated to mix with the Havenly Smilodon Beasts on the massive island before him!

His speed was fast as he arrived within a nanosecond, the Earth sword Smilodons on the edge of the island looking at him with interested gazes as the moment Noah landed on the edge where luscious verdant and black grass grew, the voice of one of the Four Hyperversal Extremities within this landmass echoed out in his mind.
[The First Underdweller to arrive into our blessed Supernal Havens, and an interesting one at that to be able to mimic us so proficiently...Mmm, do you have enemies coming behind you?
Well, no matter.
Come, you shall have the honor of getting an introduction.]

chapters.title: Chapter 2622 Havenly Aurora! III
paragraphs: 2622 Havenly Aurora! III
The first Underdweller to arrive in the Supernal Haven of Dissolution!

Noah claimed this title as when he landed atop the floating landmass of pristine fantastical grandeur, the voice of a Hyperversal Extremity echoed out as he saw the verdant and obsidian grass around him make way and form a path towards the depths of the island.

The Smilodons around this area only gazed at him briefly before they went back to their prior actions- many of them lying down with their eyes closed as the aura of Dissolution formed into tendrils of light around them.

With his body as a black and cherry-colored Smilodon, Noah went deeper into the island as he began to come across more Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, passing through the groves of thick and ancient trees pulsing with Dissolution until a clearing began to open up ahead of him.

A small mountain rose within this clearing as a stream of stellar obsidian water could be seen circling around it- the small mountain divided into floors as the bodies of Apex Smilodons were sprawled all around it, with the aura of a Hyperversal Extremity Smilodon at the very peak of this small mountain!

It was the only thing in this clearing as the mountain was surrounded by heavy concentrations of Dissolution, and Noah could see that far above this region, the halos of circular bubbles holding profound Aeonic Treasures of Extremity floated majestically!
[My, I really can't tell you apart from other Smilodons...just what did you use to even fool the senses of a Hyperversal Extremity?]
The feminine voice of a Haven Saber Smilodon thundered out as it stemmed from the regal red-furred existence at the top of the small mountain.
Watching it was akin to a habitat of a pride of lions, with the eyes of the Haven Saber Smilodon locked onto Noah as a smile formed on her head!
Noah's visage was calm as he responded.
[Just a trick I came across not too long ago. You mentioned an introduction?]
An introduction. If one didn't want to stumble in these new lands, this was invaluable!

The Hyperversal Extremity before Noah did not release an aura anywhere as powerful as the three managing the Vein Rift as she seemed to be Tier 1 at most, with her serene utterance continuing to echo out at this moment.

[Mmm...you've just arrived in the Supernal Haven of Dissolution and stepped on one of its Havenly Archipelagos. One of the more common Golden Havenly Archipelagos that holds the most basic Havenly Treasures.]
Havenly Treasures!

As she spoke, she pointed her paw upwards and tapped as from the glorious glimmers of light above, one of the halos of circular light surrounding a treasure floated down until it came just below the mountain in front of Noah.

[Reality may be entirely different in your Nether Haven of Dissolution, but the reality in the Supernal Havens of Extremity is one where above the Havenly Archipelagos, Havenly Authority gathers and mixes with the Authority of the Supernal Haven to produce a myriad of Havenly Treasures. And to attain them...well, why don't you take a look and try to take the one before your eyes? It is something that an Underdweller like you would need the most right now.]
WAA!
An entirely different reality.

The Havenly Saber Smilodon talked of the Havenly Authority gathering above the Havenly Archipelagos as she referred to Vitalis Hyperversal Authority, with Noah's mind putting all the information together as he floated up to the halo of light that when coming closer, one could see a dazzling black and white scroll contained within!
Noah's paws went towards the halo of light containing this black and white scroll as...
BZZT!
His hand was rebuffed.
And thereafter, streams of information surged out that for him- they transformed into gorgeous prompts.
[Insufficient Units of Havenly Aurora to acquire the Golden Aurora Accumulation Modus Operandi. 100 Units of Havenly Aurora are required.]
The usage of the Units of Havenly Aurora!

Noah had attained 10 from defeating the Earth Saber Smilodons as it seemed all the Havenly Treasures atop the Archipelagos of the Supernal Haven of Dissolution required such a form of authority in order to be obtained!
[Unique, isn't it?] The voice of the Haven Saber Smilodon continued as Noah stared at the black and white scroll before him with blazing eyes.

[Reality revolves around the Units of Havenly Aurora one has as with a sufficient amount, one can even acquire Havenly Treasures that can take them to Extremity on Obsidian or Crimson Havenly Archipelagos. The bodies of the Havenly Lineages across the Supernal Havens of Extremity have slowly collected Havenly Aurora since they were born, with the Challengers that you Underdwellers are facing having been prepared as they already utilized most of their Havenly Aurora to redeem Treasures before stepping out- just in the case they lost against any of you, they wouldn't lose much of their accumulated Havenly Aurora!]
Even more dazzling words came out as a few truths became clear.
One was that it was possible to slowly build up the Havenly Aurora over time while in the Supernal Havens of Extremity.
Another was that a method to attain Havenly Aurora was to overpower and defeat another being- this in turn transferring their Units of Havenly Aurora to the victor!
And of course, there was the Golden Aurora Accumulation Modus Operandi floating in front of Noah and unattainable by him at this moment.
His eyes were fiery as he gazed at it, the voice of the Haven Saber Smilodon continuing with its smile becoming even wider.

[Ah yes, the faster way to build up Havenly Aurora. Even though it's the lowest tier of the Aurora Accumulation Modus Operandi, the Golden Aurora Accumulation Modus Operandi grants you the wisdom on how to pull Units of Havenly Aurora into your existence faster- this being the major way existences accumulate Aurora apart from Challenges!]

[Challenges...you can participate in these on any Havenly Archipelago you land on as if you step on the Challenger Arena, you can battle others. So long as you win, their Havenly Aurora is yours. And the biggest introductory lesson I can give to an Underdweller like you is if you start battles anywhere else apart from Challenger Arenas and commence massacring Havenly Beasts to acquire their Aurora...you would not live long as just like you massacre others, someone more powerful will arise to do the same to you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 2623 Havenly Aurora! IV
paragraphs: 2623 Havenly Aurora! IV
Strength was king in the Supernal Havens of Extremity as they didn't have something like the Investiture of Extremity!
But this didn't mean their lands were filled with chaos as due to the Havenly Lineages spread throughout, there was actually a sense of profound harmony across the Supernal Havens of Extremity.
Those more powerful of the Havenly Lineages supported and defended their Lineages.
If a powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeform who enjoyed killing came to be as they went wild in such a venture, they would quickly be put down by a slap from a Hyperversal Extremity.

If a Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity wanted to quickly accumulate Havenly Aurora and began massacring the lives within entire Archipelagos for it, they would soon be surrounded by Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities and be erased out of existence!
Strength was king.
And you truly had to be strong to move fearlessly across these fantastical lands.

So when more and more beings from the Nether Haven of Dissolution arrived here and understood the means of Havenly Aurora...any chaos that might arise from it was bound to be an astounding future to look forward to.
For wild beings like Extremity Blue...how long would they be able to survive in these lands if they continued to act the way they did?

[But, that's the serious stuff out of the way. I was going to be nice and obtain this Golden Aurora Accumulation Modus Operandi for you, but your nature has made me curious as I want to see more of a display of your abilities. If you wish to keep your head start against other Underdwellers, you'll need to begin accumulating Havenly Aurora as soon as possible as why don't you...enter the Challenger Arena of this Archipelago? If you can win against other Challengers, you can obtain more Units of Havenly Aurora and gain the capability to springboard your power as you...haven't seen anything yet.]
Her words were valiant as the Apex Aeonic Earth Saber Smilodons around this area pulsed with power.

The feline visage of the Haven Saber Smilodon rose with a yawn and a stretch as a heavy Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Dissolution erupted around her, covering the Smilodons here in addition to Noah as with a devilish glint in her eyes, she echoed out.
[Let's go.]
WAA!

With a glimmer of light, the Smilodons here turned into obsidian shadows that were taken deeper into this extensive Havenly Archipelago- towards a Challenger Arena that was on all such floating landmasses to designate a place for battle!
The Vein Rift that held the Havenly Smilodon Lineage was a rowdy one as two Temporal Fields of Dissolution pulsed with radiance at this moment!
The Challenger for the Temporal Field with Extremity Blue had entered after the purposeful delay, with time passing as nobody came out from any Temporal Field.
That is until...
SAA!
Flickers of light erupted from a certain Temporal Field as two auras were spat out!
The Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity Smilodon known as Zaman innumerable wounds stretching across his body, and the visage of Extremity Blue...was utterly gory as half of her body was missing!

Flesh, brain matter, and skeletal structure were wiggling and trying to reform, the scene being utterly shocking for a Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity who held something as unique as Hyperversal Haki of Extremity.
And yet...
[Haha!]
She laughed gloriously.
[8,699 Units of Havenly Aurora? What is this? How do I use it? Hmm?]

She spoke shocking words as Zaman turned his head towards the cold and apathetic Lord Commander Smilodon and bowed down respectfully before he turned into a flicker of light back into the obsidian mist!
But the words of Extremity Blue showed she had actually won as how exactly had she pulled it off?
As her musculature wriggled and tried to reform, the Lord Commander Smilodon gazed at her coldly while voicing out.
[You have come out victorious and gained entry into the Supernal Haven of Dissolution. Be mindful of your actions within as if you offend those you should not, your life is not guaranteed.]
The same words that were said to Noah.
The same words applied to even powerful Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities!

Extremity Blue's laugh faded at such words as it seemed like clarity returned to her, with her body beginning to float towards the obsidian mist in the distance as outside the Vein Rift, many beings began to clamor.
The first Hyperversal Extremity to gain entry into the unknown lands.
And she seemed to be on a hunt as many wondered what would become of the destiny of the First Underdweller to have entered the unknown lands within the Extremity Vein!
Nobody stopped her anymore as with a flicker of light, Extremity Blue disappeared into the obsidian mist.
What many didn't know was just how precious of a gain she had gotten from defeating a Tier 3 Hyperscopic Extremity Havenly Beasts.
8,699 Units of Havenly Aurora!
Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity Celestial Creatures were immeasurably more powerful than one at the Apex Aeonic Lifeform level that Noah had defeated.
Their means of obtaining Units of Heavenly Radiance were many as the number Extremity Blue had attained was that much greater!
Within moments, space warped around her as she very soon found herself in a grand space filled with the dense authority of Dissolution.
Streams of authority of other Havens also flowed serenely as massive floating islands with their edges flowing with authority in the form of waterfalls could be seen!
The moment Extremity Blue arrived, many wills focused on her.
Her eyes were sour as she sensed over a dozen Hyperversal Extremities locking onto her, with her eyes being drawn over to the floating island directly ahead of her that held Smilodons.
She gazed at its peak with the phenomenon of a spinning singularity washing down a treasured light, as well as the auras of circular bubbles holding treasures of Extremity!
She began to float towards it with interest as her aura spread out, her voice echoing out to the Smilodons on the island before.

[You all wouldn't have happened to see a cute young man pass through here before me, would you? Dark hair, fair skin like a newborn's, and confident eyes bordering on arrogance and superiority over all others. He's my weak little hubby that needs to be protected...]

She spoke with a smile towards the Earth Saber Smilodons cultivating below, their eyes opening to gaze at her vibrant aura of a Tier 3 Hyperscopic Extremity as they only blinked calmly before they went back to their business!

chapters.title: Chapter 2624 Havenly Aurora! V
paragraphs: 2624 Havenly Aurora! V
They...actually ignored a Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity.
Extremity Blue was astonished at this, but she nodded soon after as she continued to feel the gazes of multiple Hyperversal Extremities on her!
Strength was king.
And the Smilodons down below knew it.
If she went on a rampage here...it was hard to say what the result would be as for now, she continued forward.

She warped to instantly appear near the dense bubbles of halos of light on the skies of the floating landmass, her authority overtaken by the abundant Aeonic Treasures of Extremity floating calmly without anyone taking them as when she reached out towards own of the more radiant halos of light...
[You have sufficient Units of Havenly Aurora to obtain the Entry Albatross of the Authority of Dissolution. Would you like to obtain it in exchange for 1,000 Units of Havenly Aurora?]
Her eyes flickered with brilliance.
Entry Albatross of the Authority of Dissolution!
Something that would actually allow her to truly embark on the Concept of Dissolution that relates to the very Haven itself!
Something that made the Haven Saber Smilodon she fought nearly injure her gravely.

Her eyes flickered as her will instantly went forth, feeling the streams of authority within her reduce by 1,000 Units as the bubble of light around an entirely obsidian pulsing singularity faded as it was quickly absorbed into her body!
She closed her eyes as within a few nanoseconds...
BZZT!
A weak but profound Authority of Dissolution erupted around her body.
[Haha...]
Her eyes curved into a devilish smile as their blue radiance hungrily went on all the dazzling Halos of light next to her.
This was supposed to be the Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification that Apex Aeonic Lifeforms reigned in under the eyes of the Underdwellers of the Seven Aeonic Havens.
And yet....
There seemed to be boundless opportunities for Hyperversal Extremities!
Extremity Blue gazed at the wonders around her as more information flowed into her mind.
[You have sufficient Units of Havenly Aurora to obtain the Golden Extremity Panacea of Dissolution. Would you like to obtain it in exchange for 100 Units of Havenly Aurora?]
[You have sufficient Units of Havenly Aurora to obtain the Golden Aurora Accumulation Modus Operandi. Would you like to obtain it in exchange for 100 Units of Havenly Aurora?]
[You have sufficient Units of Havenly Aurora to obtain the Fragment of an Armament of Extremity. Would you like to obtain it in exchange for 1,000 Units of Havenly Aurora?]
Many possibilities rose before her eyes as they were things to aid one in traversing the Layers of Dissolution and even Fragments of Armaments of Extremity!

Her bright eyes shone with destiny as she instantly spent another 100 Units of Havenly Aurora to obtain the Golden Aurora Accumulation Modus Operandi, her actions revealing a shocking truth in the future to come.
Those with more power- existences who had already achieved Extremity...
would only have a larger starting point as their power would be getting a major boost once they started going through the Havenly Archipelagos and accumulated Units of Havenly Aurora!
They would further reform their power as the heights they couldn't scale before would become possible for them now.

Extremity Blue felt the fantastical Modus Operandi flow into her mind as she learned a great deal about Havenly Aurora, her smile becoming even wider as before she could do anything else, she felt rousing movements below her.
Towards the center of the floating island, she could see massive stellar black trees surrounding a circular platform meant for battle.

The auras of Smilodons could be seen all around the branches of the thick trees as they bellowed out loudly, seemingly cheering on a finished battle as an obsidian cherry-colored Smilodon with a flaming black crown overpowered another Earth Saber Smilodon!
The phenomenon drew her attention as she instantly warped over to this location, her blazing aura drawing some eyes as the voice of a Hyperversal Extremity thundered out from above the tallest tree.

[And another victory for the Challenger! Truly marvelous...any others to accept his Challenge? He should have reached over a hundred Units of Havenly Aurora now as it's enough to buy a Havenly Treasure helpful in even crossing the Boundary Layers of Dissolution!]
The focus was egging others on as it favored battles, the figure of Extremity Blue arriving here with a smile and observing everything as even more truths of these new lands unveiled themselves.
She wanted to quickly begin searching for the one known as Osmont, this being likely already having run far away from this entry location as searching for him would be a great pain!

So she thought of familiarizing herself with these new lands first as after she arrived in the massive clearing showing a grand arena below her built from obsidian crystalline material pulsing with Dissolution, she voiced out.
[Over a hundred Units of Havenly Aurora? I just spent some as I can refill them now.]
She spoke brilliantly while gazing at the Earth Saber Smilodon with a flaming crown who had just won the battle.
And the Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity Smilodon who had just been speaking...
sneered towards her as she let out a sharp reply.
[Fuck off to another Challenger Arena that has Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities waiting. Why would you want to bully an Apex Smilodon just for a hundred points, Underdweller?]
A Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity spoke towards a Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity like so.
It was enough to cause Extremity Blue to flash with a deadly light as her smile became even more gorgeous and deadly.
[My oh my...the natives of this land don't seem to have an ounce of respect towards those more powerful!]
The Earth Saber Smilodons that hadn't even reached Extremity paid her no heed.
And now, this Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity even told her to fuck off!
In front of thousands of Apex Smilodons and while the auras of other Hyperversal Extremitied watching the surroundings too.
In response to her words, the Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity Smilodon yawned her reply while stretching her body.

[Respect goes both ways. If you act like a dumb bitch, I'll treat you like a dumb bitch. You just won against Brother Zaman to gain entry as you're seriously injured, and he is recuperating in his domain on this very same Havenly Smilodon Archipelago. Sister Seppia with the same power as you is also on this Archipelago, with other Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity Havenly Beasts occupying the Titanoboa Archipelagos and the Dragonfly Archipelagos nearby. If Underdwellers like you want to begin acting rowdy as soon as you arrive...well, I can only tell you to fuck around and find out.]
WAA!
The words were of utmost disrespect.
It was such a shocking reality that Extremity Blue had never faced before as when ascertaining its truth...she could only laugh!
[These new lands...are so very interesting. Alright, then can I take this Challenger Arena and see if any of the Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities you mentioned would want to battle?]
Her eyes still radiated wonder.
She could see the shocking importance of Havenly Aurora as she wanted more of it as quickly as possible!

She needed to ascertain how much she could acquire with the Golden Aurora Accumulation Modus Operandi, but it seemed like the path to obtaining Havenly Aurora quickly lay on fighting and obtaining it from others!
And yet towards her words...the paws of the Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity Smilodon waved dismissively.

[This Arena is currently taking battles for Apex Aeonic Lifeforms. Go to the Titanoboa Archipelagos or Dragonfly Archipelagos, maybe they will want to entertain you. Or just proceed deeper into this Supernal Haven of Dissolution and you'll come across Obsidian and Crimson Archipelagos where Hyperversal Extremities fighting is a norm.]
Extremity Blue was once again rebuffed.
She smiled dangerously as she locked her eyes with the speaking Haven Saber Smilodon, not saying anything else before she moved away from this location!
She thought of many things as she also thought about how the current situation would soon change when more beings like her entered these lands.
If someone like the Adjudicator of Dissolution were to enter and there was nothing stopping her from acting against her...

With this thought and many more in mind, Extremity Blue passed over the skies of the Havenly Smilodon Archipelago and obtained a few more radiant halos of light before she turned into a streak of blue light that shot into the distance- heading even deeper into the Supernal Haven of Dissolution!
Back in the Havenly Smilodon Archipelago she just left, the Haven Saber Smilodon gazed towards Noah's figure on the Challenger Arena below as she sent a mental message.
[What did you do to have such a spiteful woman chasing after you, hmm?]

Noah had only shown good will as wondrously, Extremity Blue appeared right before him without knowing it was him standing before her eyes- and the Haven Saber Smilodon nor any other Smilodons paid heed to Extremity Blue!

Noah got off the Challenger Arena after battling multiple Apex Smilodons who rose to take his challenge, shaking his head towards the Haven Saber Smilodon in reply as his eyes were gazing at the halos of treasured light above.
He had attained enough Units of Havenly Aurora to acquire some things!
