chapters.title: Chapter 2625 Shocking the Havenly Smilodon Archipelago! I
paragraphs: 2625 Shocking the Havenly Smilodon Archipelago! I

Through his quality as an Absolute Hyperversal Inscrutable Existence, he expressed tendrils of Dissolution outwardly as his visage of Smilodon moved across space to float towards the Halos of blinding light!

Below him, the visage of the female Havenly Smilodon who had given him an introduction and even sent away Extremity Blue watched silently as a moment later, the aura of another Haven Saber Smilodon appeared beside her.
[Little Sister Laeta, why are you busying yourself with this Underdweller's business?]
The voice stemmed from a Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity stronger than Laeta, and yet she harrumphed towards him while replying.

[I'm not boring like you, Senior Brother Kyle. And anyone who can veil themselves from my eyes like he is...there has to be something special! If I hadn't seen him change right before me, I wouldn't be able to tell him apart from any other Smilodon. Imagine if such a being reached Zenith Tier 3 or even crossed the threshold beyond it...just how much fun and chaos could such a being cause? I just wanted to observe him to see if I can peel his layers of uniqueness as him utilizing the Golden Aurora Accumulation Modus Operandi for the first time will reveal a bit about his Soul and Foundation.]
Laeta's pulsing could already see Noah's figure appear in front of another Golden Aurora Accumulation Modus Operandi surrounded by a halo of Havenly Authority.

Beside her, her Senior Brother shook his head indifferently as he gazed at tens of thousands of Smilodons across the Havenly Smilodon Archipelago who were currently practicing the same Golden Aurora Accumulation Modus Operandi and attracting thin streams of the Havenly Authority intermixed with the Authority of the Supernal Havens themselves as they would slowly become Units of Havenly Aurora!
He spoke dismissively when he thought about the newcomer Underdweller.

[Havenly Beasts that were born within the Supernal Havens themselves and baptized by the Havenly Authority can barely accumulate 5-10 Units of Havenly Aurora daily when they first begin. The Underdwellers who have the most minuscule traces of Havenly Authority within their existence will maybe be able to accumulate half of that if not less. Asking for any surprises from a being such as this may be expecting too much...]
He stated the harsh truth and reality as all incoming Underdwellers would come to find how harsh the conditions were in these lands unless they already had sufficient power!
The First Underdweller to arrive may as well discover first as they watched Noah perceptively.
In the skies, Noah reached the blinding halo of light holding another black and white scroll as a different message appeared before his eyes!
[You have sufficient Units of Havenly Aurora to obtain the Golden Aurora Accumulation Modus Operandi. Would you like to obtain it in exchange for 100 Units of Havenly Aurora?]
121 Units of Havenly Aurora.
This was how much he was able to obtain after taking down three Apex Aeonic Smilodons in the Challenger Arena!
All three held the 16th Boundary Layer of Dissolution as their highest, with their power being something the current Noah could easily overcome as he didn't go wild in battle...yet.
He would see how many Units of Havenly Aurora could be accumulated with the Modus Operandi before him as if his ongoing theories proved to be true...

A blinding light shone in front of him as he felt the halo of light disappear, and 100 thin streams of authority left his soul at the same time as the moment the exchange was completed- the scroll turned into a glimmer of light that vanished into Noah's head!
And this glimmer of light turned into waves of information.

[Golden Aurora Accumulation Modus Operandi]:: A unique tool granted to any being within the Supernal Havens of Extremity as it isn't just a method of operation, but a key that allows the birth and growth of a Havenly Organ that is capable of isolating and drawing in minuscule concentrations of Havenly Hyperversal Authority while also mixing it with the Authority of the Supernal Havens of Extremity the being is currently in. The circulation method of operating the Havenly Organ and growing it to be capable of accumulating even more Units of Havenly Aurora faster is as follows...
A grand method of circulation showed itself as the moment that the Golden Aurora Accumulation Modus Operandi entered Noah's soul- a small minuscule Singularity was born near his heart!
The beginnings of a Havenly Organ.

As Noah read its description, he couldn't help but speculate one more as the so called Havenly Hyperversal Authority he could see above the Havenly Smilodon Archipelago and the other Archipelagos truly seemed like a form of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!

And the mixing of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority along with the Authority of the Supernal Havens of Extremity seemed to give birth to the astounding treasures floating serenely atop these floating islands as...what would happen if Noah tried to utilize a method of accumulating Units of Havenly Aurora with his body?
With his existence that held Innate Vitalis Hyperversal Meridians that had genuine Vitalis Hyperversal Authority flowing within?!
'Let's find out...'
His soul was calm as while floating in the skies, he began to follow the Golden Aurora Accumulation Modus Operandi.
The barely formed Havenly Organ near his heart that was only a minuscule Singularity...began to spin.

Around him, barely discernible thin streams of Havenly Authority authority began to materialize and draw towards him, becoming mixed with the Authority of the Supernal Haven around before it was drawn towards the Havenly Organ within Noah's body!
And before his eyes...
[.01 Units of Havenly Aurora have been accumulated.]
A small number rose.
In the distance, the figure of the Havenly Smilodon Laeta and Hyperversal Extremity Kyle observed as the former tilted her head while the latter nodded as if it was to be expected!
[You at times expect too many things from others, Laeta-]
Hyperversal Extremity Kyle had only just begun to speak when his words stopped.
The barely visible streams of Havenly Authority and Authority of Dissolution being drawn above Noah stopped at this moment.
And Noah's body throbbed as the action of drawing in Units of Havenly Aurora through the Havenly Organ for the first time caused this organ to be formed as a part of Noah truly at this time.

And the moment this occurred, the calm and lustrous Meridians within his body came to life. His Aspects of Existence that were filled with pure and extremely powerful Vitalis Hyperversal Authority came to life!

chapters.title: Chapter 2626 Shocking the Havenly Smilodon Archipelago! II
paragraphs: 2626 Shocking the Havenly Smilodon Archipelago! II
His body! His soul! His Origin! His Innate Vitalis Hyperversal Meridians!

He couldn't actively control this authority even though he had undergone the First Vitalis Awakening, but at this moment, a natural reaction occurred as the Havenly Organ that was drawing in lesser forms of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority and mixing it with the Authority of Dissolution to create Units of Havenly Aurora...it felt the shockingly Pure Vitalis Hyperversal Authority spread across Noah's body as a quintessential change occurred!

Since the Havenly Organ was drawing in minuscule streams of Havenly Authority, the Vitalis Hyperversal Authority within Noah's Aspects of Existence and Innate Vitalis Hyperversal Meridians surged and instantly flowed towards the Havenly Organ.
But the organ also needed to draw the Authority of Dissolution to ultimately form Havenly Aurora.

And at this moment, it had begun to receive extremely pure Havenly Authority from the body it was in. It needed extremely pure Authority of Dissolution to balance this out and begin forming Units of Havenly Aurora as if it could not obtain such pure authority...it would have to at the very least replace this with enough volume.
And so...
The skies above the Havenly Smilodon Archipelago buzzed.
As if his body was a conduit, tendrils of the Authority of Dissolution began to draw from nearby reality en masse as within a nanosecond- a swirling storm of Dissolution had already gathered above.
It was Dissolution, along with ant streams of authority of the other Supernal Havens of Extremity that were naturally in the surroundings!

It gathered at a shockingly high speed as even more of it continued to come from the surroundings, creating an inverted obsidian mountain of authority that had its sharpest point sinking into the visage of a single being!
BOOM!

An eruption of authority erupted as large volumes of the Authority of Dissolution entered Noah's body and went straight into the Havenly Organ that had shockingly Pure Vitalis Hyperversal Authority flowing in, the organ rotating like a strained engine to very quickly fuse these authorities together!
And the product of all this was a glorious one as prompts rapidly began to flash before Noah's eyes.
[+100 Units of Havenly Aurora have been accumulated!]
[+100 Units of Havenly Aurora have been accumulated!]
[+100 Units of Havenly Aurora have been accumulated!]
Prompt after prompt.
Wave after wave!

Streams of Havenly Aurora began to form en masse as the small Havenly Organ within Noah's body began to expand- and it had to do this, otherwise it would be destroyed from the sheer volumes and purity of authority it had to fuse together!

And at this point as Noah's body released pure Vitalis Hyperversal Authority automatically into the Havenly Organ, they began to feel the natural dwindling and usage of this authority as his Innate Vitalis Hyperversal Meridians pulsed.

They bellowed out with tyranny and majesty as an instant later, what the Havenly Beasts considered Havenly Authority- the authority that was gathering above the Archipelagos...pure, transparent streams of it mixed with a gorgeous white began to be drawn towards Noah until a rising transparent white storm formed below his body.
An inverted obsidian mountain of the authority of Dissolution and other Supernal Havens of Extremity above, and a transparent white mountain storm of Havenly Authority below.

They all rushed into one being's body in a phenomenon of utter incredulity- the eyes of Hyperversal Extremities Laeta and Kyle opening their eyes wide in shock as on the massive Havenly Smilodon Archipelago- the few more powerful Hyperversal Extremities began to rouse...along with the wills of Extremities from the far away Titanoboa and Dragonfly Archipelagos!
All of these eyes and Wills were directed to a single existence.
An existence that continued to experience rows of prompts thundering over his eyes amidst this glorious show of Quintessence!
[+200 Units of Havenly Aurora have been accumulated!]
[+500 Units of Havenly Aurora have been accumulated!]
[+1,000 Units of Havenly Aurora have been accumulated!]

[The Golden Havenly Organ is being put under a great strain!]
[To prevent its apocalypse, the rate of Accumulation is being reduced.]
[+800 Units of Havenly Aurora have been accumulated!]
[+500 Units of Havenly Aurora have been...]
[+100 Units of Havenly Aurora have been...]
The rapid churning and spinning of the Havenly Organ slowly and reduced.
The overactive Vitalis Hyperversal Authority within Noah's Aspects of Existence began to calm down as the mountains of authority outside of his body slowly became less intense!

In his body, the Havenly Organ had fractures extending all over it due to the immense level of purity of the authority it had to mix together, its spinning becoming ever so minuscule as a few final prompts flashed before Noah.
[A total of 10,000 Units of Havenly Aurora have been accumulated as the threshold of Accumulation for the Golden Havenly Organ has been reached.]
[Once the Golden Havenly Organ has been repaired and returned to its prime state within 24 Hours, a similar or higher quantity of Units of Havenly Aurora can be collected again.]
[An Obsidian or Crimson Havenly Organ will be capable of bearing the load of authority at much greater levels.]

But in the surroundings...things were not as calm as they were before as heavy and powerful auras now filled the surroundings.
The visage of Extremity Laeta and Kyle floated right before Noah along with two other Haven Saber Smilodon- one of them being the one who had faced Extremity Blue in the Temporal Field!

On the right side, four massive Titanoboas floated majestically as they pulsed with Hyperversal Extremity Authority, while on the left side- four Extremity Dragonflies looked at Noah as their eyes shone with a profound light!
Stark silence descended in the surroundings as in such an environment...the visage of Laeta responded quickly as her voice thundered out.
[The Havenly Smilodon Lineage will take him into our folds.]

chapters.title: Chapter 2627 Grasping Dissolution!
paragraphs: 2627 Grasping Dissolution!
Noah's soul radiated brightness as around him, a Haven Saber Smilodon proclaimed that he would be taken into the gold of their lineage.
And not a moment later, a Titanoboa pulsing with back flames snorted while booming out.
[Take him on? Why don't you give that option to him? Have him choose which Lineage to join after knowing all the facts.]
On the left, yet another voice followed out thereafter as an austere Tier 3 Hyperversal Dragonfly reiterated calmly.
[And which facts will he receive that won't contain a bias towards one side or against another?]
Hyperversal Extremities spoke out one after another as Noah was gazed at as something they had to enter into their folds.
And of course, they had to after witnessing what just occurred with Havenly Authority and the Authority of the Supernal Havens of Extremity!
As Hyperversal Extremities, they knew how critical Havenly Authority was.

For it to be drawn towards this existence before them at a rate that only powerful Hyperversal Extremities who were lucky enough to find an Obsidian or Crimson Aurora Accumulation Modus Operandi would be able to compare to...it meant this being had a shocking inclination to Havenly Authority!
To the extent they even wanted to ask him some questions about it.
Extremity Laeta was one of the weakest Hyperversal Extremities here being at Tier 1, and yet she harrumphed and spoke freely.
[Hmph, just look at him. Which part of him looks like a Titanoboa or Dragonfly? From where I stand, he is already a Smilodon you all are trying to poach from this Archipelago!]
WAA!
Dazzling words that caused the Hyperversal Extremities to look at each other ironically were uttered out.
They couldn't deny her words even though they knew this being before them was an Underdweller!
But before the environment became even more hectic...

[You all know what it was like when you first gained trenches of Havenly Aurora. Why don't we discuss amongst ourselves and let this young friend here explore the Havenly Treasures atop this Archipelago and the Titanoboa and Dragonfly Archipelagos as well? Decisions can be made after he is more familiar with everything.]
A deep voice of authority announced from an utterly massive Titanoboa that seemed to be at the very precipice of Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity...Zenith just barely out of his grasp.
When others heard it, they remained silent with affirmation as they acknowledged Noah and dispersed.
Laeta was the only one that remained as she stared at Noah with beastial eyes before she stretched and floated back into the depths of the Havenly Smilodon Archipelago.
[Just remember who was the one showing you the ropes when you first arrived...]
Her words penetrated Noah's ears as his eyes emanated brightness.
They calculated the many possibilities for the future as they ultimately landed on the Halos of light floating above this Archipelago.
There were some that were absolutely crucial to obtain as his Will spread out to learn of all the Havenly Treasures here!
And every time his will passed over them, he received a message right after.
[You have sufficient Units of Havenly Aurora to obtain the Flaming Dissolution Circulation Modus Operandi. Would you like to obtain it in exchange for 1,000 Units of Havenly Aurora?]
[You have sufficient Units of Havenly Aurora to obtain the Lightning Dissolution Circulation Modus Operandi. Would you like to obtain it in exchange for 1,000 Units of Havenly Aurora?]

Methodologies on how to circulate authority in one's Aspects of Existence that caused the fantastical effects of flames of Dissolution or obsidian lightning of Dissolution pulsing around the bodies of the Havenly Beasts.
But with his Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi, Noah didn't need any of these as he could at most purchase them as reference materials!
His eyes and will continued to wave outwards.
[You have sufficient Units of Havenly Aurora to obtain the Fragment of an Armament of Extremity. Would you like to obtain it in exchange for 1,000 Units of Havenly Aurora?]
[You have sufficient Units of Havenly Aurora to obtain the Entry Albatross of Armament of Extremity. Would you like to obtain it in exchange for 1,000 Units of Havenly Aurora?]
[You have sufficient Units of Havenly Aurora to obtain the Entry Albatross of the Authority of Dissolution. Would you like to obtain it in exchange for 1,000 Units of Havenly Aurora?]
[You have sufficient Units of Havenly Aurora to obtain the Golden Extremity Panacea of Dissolution. Would you like to obtain it in exchange for 100 Units of Havenly Aurora?]
The things his soul sought for showed themselves.
Something as fantastical as a Fragment of an Armament of Extremity...and an Entry Albatross that gave him access to truly step on Dissolution!
There was even a Golden Extremity Panacea of Dissolution to aid one across the Boundary Layers of Dissolution!
His will was sent out.

And soon after, two Halos popped and faded away as a blinding singularity shot into Noah's head from the distance, while an obsidian flower decorated with stellar black gems that seemed to contain whole realities within it landed on his hands.
The first one was an Entry Albatross of the Authority of Dissolution as the unfinished runic ecriture of [DISSOLUTION] in his soul lit up gorgeous while the rest of the letters began to be completed!
And when the [N] in Dissolution fully materialized...
The heavy concentration of Dissolution in the surroundings seethed again.
Noah sucked the potent Authority of Dissolution nearby as if he was a black hole, a glorious prompt unfolding before him soon after.
[The 1st Havenly Boundary Layer of Dissolution has been attained.]
[An authority connecting to the very Vitalis Havens of Extremity!]
[The Authority of Dissolution has been subtly altered by Quintessence.]

[The Authority of Dissolution is termed a Havenly Boundary due to its nature as elevating it is of utmost difficulty, but attaining Hyperversal Extremity of Dissolution or any Havenly Boundary will allow one to move unhindered within said Haven.]
Waves of information thundered down as yet another glorious concept was anchored to his soul.
The more unique thing in all of this...was the fact that he held Quintessence.
Quintessence had ever so subtly changed Dissolution as in addition to this...
Quintessence deemed that all of Noah's Boundaries would be taken to the 9th Boundary Layer automatically the moment they were expanded towards Extremity!
And so, even though it was stated that proceeding across the Layers of Dissolution was so very difficult...
[The 2nd Havenly Boundary Layer of Dissolution has been attained.]
[The 3rd Havenly Boundary Layer of Dissolution has been attained.]

chapters.title: Chapter 2628 A Weapon Against Hyperversal Extremities!
paragraphs: 2628 A Weapon Against Hyperversal Extremities!

[The First Havenly Boundary Layer of Dissolution]:: While moving under any Vitalis Havens of Extremity, all of your statistical values are increased by 25%. When moving outside the scope of all Vitalis Havens of Extremity, all of your statistical values are increased by 50%.
The Boundary Layers of Dissolution were unique ones as they reveal some truly critical information on these types of Boundaries.

Noah received its information and continued forward as he put his standing as an Absolute Hyperversal Inscrutable Existence to use and reduced any ridiculous flashiness around him- with him steadily controlling the waves of Dissolution coming inside his existence as all it was spread out across his soul, all the way back to his Main Body!
His Main Body.

It remained in the constantly changing and expanding Infinite Hyperversal Haven that had just swallowed up the Noblesse Planes of Existence that were brought to heel under Henry, Aurelia, Orion, and his other Vassals.
While his Reified Wealdian Source of Indefatigable had entered the Supernal Haven of Dissolution, his Main Body was moving in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven to do something just as critical!

Pulses of Dissolution went on on the fair hands of his Main Body in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, his body being warped across great distances to arrive in the ever-expanding Prana Aletheian Haven at this moment.
Many changes were being quantified in regards to him, as well as all the wonders that the 15th and 16th Boundary Layers of his most important Boundaries brought forth.
Manadynamics was particularly domineering as its 16th Boundary Layer caused his resource regeneration rate to become utterly obscene!

[The Sixteenth Boundary Layer of Manadynamics]:: As you approach Extremity, understanding the workings of Mana becomes utterly crucial as your Reality Passages, Quintessential Breath of Extremity, Heart, Foundation, and All Aspects of Your Existence now flow in harmony to grant you the most pristine flow of energy. You can now regenerate 100% of all Quintessential Hyperversal Values in 60 Seconds, with any abilities requiring the usage of Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Values having 98% of their cost initially paid for by your Quintessential Hyperversal Mana Values. Be prepared, for you know what the endgame is...
A glorious description that quantified part of his wonders.
And the last sentence of this description was addressed to Noah by the very concept of Manadynamics itself!
For him to be prepared as he knew what the endgame was.
'The endgame...' Noah smiled as he felt his endless reserves of Mana and what this description would be alluding to.

He then gazed around as he arrived at his target location, his eyes feasting at the sight of Seven Quintessential Undead Thanatos Vassals who seemed to have at their base- the Seven Chthonian Sinners of Thanatos!
Currently, two existences were bickering while floating on a verdant crystalline landmass full of life- so absorbed that they barely noticed Noah approaching with his closed off aura.
One had golden hair flowing freely, his fair face showing annoyance at this time as his lab coat fluttered in the wind.

"The balance towards death has already been tilted too much by you. I say the next phase is to fuse parts of or all of an Ender of Extremity into these 7 Champions of Thanatos. That may complete them to an even greater state..."

Dr. Hall spoke fearlessly as the one standing beside him was a dazzling Haven Lich Ra'Zan who currently adorned an obsidian black lab coat, his skull radiating deadly green flames as he also spoke with annoyance!

[I've kept a delicate balance of life and death so far with the inclusion of a Prana Aletheian Vessel in their Souls, completing them would require a deathly counterpart...maybe the corpse of a Hyperversal Extremity, or-]
In the midst of his words, the Haven Lich stopped and turned around as his flaming sockets came to land on Noah.
[Ah...Master. I apologize for not noticing your arrival sooner. How may this humble skeleton be of assistance?]
The Haven Lich Ra'Zan bowed down as beside him, Dr. Hall did the same while calling out towards Noah!

"At ease," Noah held a smile as he appreciated the massive Champions of Thanatos these two beings before him had been working on, having the Quintessential Absolute Thanatos Dynamis of Extremity at their core as with his rising strength, they had evolved to become even grander as well.

"I'm here for another project today. You'll be working with the Wealdian Council of Extremity to come up with...a virus, a plaque, a disease...any form of something that will be capable of infecting a Hyperversal Extremity along with their Recorded Histories in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity that will ultimately lead to their demise."
WAA!

Shocking words emanated from him from behind, the Wealdian Sources of Vitalistic, Thanatos, Aletheian, and Lotra appeared grandly- the only ones not joining being Indefatigable and Oraculum as they went about their own business!
Four of the 6 Council Members of the Wealdian Council of Extremity.
They arrived here as Noah was looking for a way to combat Hyperversal Extremities that were hunting him down!
The barrier between those who had attained Extremity and those who hadn't was absolute.
Billions of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms could group up against a single Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity, and they still wouldn't be able to kill such a being!
The line of demarcation between Extremity was just that vast.

Noah would also not be able to threaten an Extremity for the next few days or even possibly weeks as when he gazed at the possible Unrecorded Histories to come through Oraculum, he saw no signs of Extremity in the short term!
Yet he was being chased now.
But even if he could not fight against Extremities in a straightforward manner, he saw a possibility of fighting them in an underhanded manner!
At the core of this possible plan was something he couldn't readily manipulate yet.

Yet a change that had occurred in the last few minutes had triggered the opportunities for Noah as he gathered the different parts of his Soul as well as entities like Dr. Hall and the Haven Lich to design a virus!
He would bring any other worthy Vassals into this project if need be, but he already gave this project of enacting a virus capable of infecting Hyperversal Extremities a time limit of a day!
The key to this 'virus' he was imagining lay in Vitalis Hyperversal Authority.
Something Hyperversal Authorities desperately sought for. Something utilized in the formation of Units of Havenly Aurora!

He already theorized that due to its abundance and more open entry in the Supernal Havens of Extremity, there were likely Hyperversal Extremities that had undergone the First Vitalis Awakening if not even grander opportunities within the Supernal Havens of Extremity.
But among the Underdwellers, this number should be extremely few in ratio to the vast numbers of Hyperversal Extremities out there.
His enemies- beings like Extremity Blue, had not yet undergone any sort of Awakening.
Such a being would be extremely perceptive to a virus or poison carried by Vitalis Hyperversal Authority as their very souls sought for this authority.
And when using the Golden Aurora Accumulation Modus Operandi...this authority would be attracted into one's soul along with the authority of the Supernal Haven they were in!
Herein lay Noah's access.
Herein lay the possibilities!

Hall spoke fearlessly as the one standing beside him was a dazzling Haven Lich Ra'Zan who currently adorned an obsidian black lab coat, his skull radiating deadly green flames as he also spoke with annoyance!

[I've kept a delicate balance of life and death so far with the inclusion of a Prana Aletheian Vessel in their Souls, completing them would require a deathly counterpart...maybe the corpse of a Hyperversal Extremity, or-]
In the midst of his words, the Haven Lich stopped and turned around as his flaming sockets came to land on Noah.
[Ah...Master.
I apologize for not noticing your arrival sooner.
How may this humble skeleton be of assistance?]
The Haven Lich Ra'Zan bowed down as beside him, Dr.
Hall did the same while calling out towards Noah!

"At ease," Noah held a smile as he appreciated the massive Champions of Thanatos these two beings before him had been working on, having the Quintessential Absolute Thanatos Dynamis of Extremity at their core as with his rising strength, they had evolved to become even grander as well.
"I'm here for another project today.

You'll be working with the Wealdian Council of Extremity to come up with...a virus, a plaque, a disease...any form of something that will be capable of infecting a Hyperversal Extremity along with their Recorded Histories in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity that will ultimately lead to their demise."
WAA!

Shocking words emanated from him from behind, the Wealdian Sources of Vitalistic, Thanatos, Aletheian, and Lotra appeared grandly- the only ones not joining being Indefatigable and Oraculum as they went about their own business!
Four of the 6 Council Members of the Wealdian Council of Extremity.
They arrived here as Noah was looking for a way to combat Hyperversal Extremities that were hunting him down!
The barrier between those who had attained Extremity and those who hadn't was absolute.
Billions of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms could group up against a single Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity, and they still wouldn't be able to kill such a being!
The line of demarcation between Extremity was just that vast.

Noah would also not be able to threaten an Extremity for the next few days or even possibly weeks as when he gazed at the possible Unrecorded Histories to come through Oraculum, he saw no signs of Extremity in the short term!
Yet he was being chased now.
But even if he could not fight against Extremities in a straightforward manner, he saw a possibility of fighting them in an underhanded manner!
At the core of this possible plan was something he couldn't readily manipulate yet.
Yet a change that had occurred in the last few minutes had triggered the opportunities for Noah as he gathered the different parts of his Soul as well as entities like Dr.
Hall and the Haven Lich to design a virus!
He would bring any other worthy Vassals into this project if need be, but he already gave this project of enacting a virus capable of infecting Hyperversal Extremities a time limit of a day!
The key to this 'virus' he was imagining lay in Vitalis Hyperversal Authority.
Something Hyperversal Authorities desperately sought for.
Something utilized in the formation of Units of Havenly Aurora!

He already theorized that due to its abundance and more open entry in the Supernal Havens of Extremity, there were likely Hyperversal Extremities that had undergone the First Vitalis Awakening if not even grander opportunities within the Supernal Havens of Extremity.
But among the Underdwellers, this number should be extremely few in ratio to the vast numbers of Hyperversal Extremities out there.
His enemies- beings like Extremity Blue, had not yet undergone any sort of Awakening.
Such a being would be extremely perceptive to a virus or poison carried by Vitalis Hyperversal Authority as their very souls sought for this authority.
And when using the Golden Aurora Accumulation Modus Operandi...this authority would be attracted into one's soul along with the authority of the Supernal Haven they were in!
Herein lay Noah's access.
Herein lay the possibilities!

chapters.title: Chapter 2629 Eons of Change! I
paragraphs: 2629 Eons of Change! I
The goal was clear.
The Wealdian Council of Extremity was convened!
The Haven Lich Ra'Zan adopted an expression of extreme happiness as the Thanatos Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity buzzed around with glory.
[We can already alter the very Records of those who have perished through Thanatos...we just have to apply this to living when creating whatever Master is envisioning! Thereafter...Ka Ka Ka!]
Heavy cackling reverberated out as a flood of authority bloomed.
Noah smiled while waving his hands and causing the concentration of authority in the surroundings to rise to alarming levels, his voice ringing out...
"The crucial thing to grasp in all this is Vitalis Hyperversal Authority, and how it can be weaponized..."

The project was led by his main body as along with the Wealdian Council of Extremity, Dr. Hall, and the Haven Lich Ra'Zan...Noah sought a weapon against Extremities before he grasped any concept even close to it!
Within the Nether Haven of Dissolution.
The number of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms and Hyperversal Extremities had grown exponentially since the appearance of the Vein Rifts and the shocking changes all throughout the Seven Aeonic Havens.
But the center point remained as countless beings converged here!
Those of the Seven Clans.
Those of the Major Inheritances.
They all made their way over as they could feel...that the Culmination Step of the Last Extremity Sanctification was going to be one that made them experience the changing of eons.
The changing of the very nature and structure of the Seven Havens as after this, it would not be the same!
And at this moment...
HOONG!
A blaring horn reverberated out as if it were announcing the arrival of grand existences, with space twisting a violet light permeated across innumerable light years!

And soon after, a massive vessel the size of a Major Plane of Existence appeared as it looked like an inverted pyramid, its sharp end pulsing with tendrils of violet light as its structure seemed to be forged from the hardest Aeonic Metal.
It was a vessel known as the Courier of Senatus.
It was rarely utilized, but when it was...it represented the power of the Senatus of Extremity making a move!
The Senatus of Extremity that held existences standing above allegiances, Clans, or Inheritances!
The governing body of the Seven Aeonic Havens of Extremity.

At the top of the Courier of Senatus, the presence of a few billion existences could be felt as at the very forefront, the auras of at least one hundred thousand Hyperversal Extremities could be felt.
One hundred thousand!

The vast majority were of the Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremity level as only a few thousand were of Tier 3, but the sheer numbers were enough to give one a glimpse of the power accumulated within the Senatus of Extremity over the eons.
The Millions of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms who had survived since the First Extremity Sanctification to now.

Many had died over the years as they defended their borders against Vacuous Malignancies, but many more lived as the power expressed on the Courier of Senatus...was not every single Apex Aeonic Lifeform and Hyperversal Extremities under their banner.

This number was what the Senatus deemed sufficient to explore and take the reins of the occurring changes they had known were coming, but it was hard to say whether they knew just how drastic the changes were!

If groups like the Curagulus of Extremity could learn the words [As above, so below], what about the Senatus of Extremity? Just to what extent did they know or have any control over what was currently unfolding?
Atop the Courier of Senatus.

The few billion Apex Aeonic Lifeforms and One hundred thousand Hyperversal Extremities were all adorned in radiant violet robes inlaid with golden lines- the symbol of the inverted pyramid present on the left side of all robes.
For the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, the inverted pyramid on the robes held an ecriture of [0].
Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities adorned robes with an ecriture of [I], with Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities holding an ecriture of [II] on their violet robes and so forth!

At the very forefront of the Courier of Senatus, past the lines of tens of thousands of Hyperversal Extremities, there were a few that stood at the very forefront and stared at the far away Vein Rifts.
Their bodies gave off a stifling pressure of immensity as these beings...had exceeded the Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity stage.
They had to at the very least be Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities!
And yet the violet robes they adorned...did not have any markings on their etched pyramids.
There were 9 of such beings as a golden-haired man in the middle gazed out into the Vein Rifts while speaking calmly.
[What has been learnt so far?]
His question was laid out in the open, but the voice of a Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity behind him emanated out serenely.

[The contribution goes to the Avernus Clan for this information as one of theirs has already entered. But the theory of entirely separate Havens within the Extremity Vein has been confirmed, with the first things that one can come across being things like Entry Albatross of the Authority of Dissolution- capable of being obtained for a cost.]
[Oh?]
The words of the serene voice raised a few brows as a tan woman on the right side of the 9 existences exceeding Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity spoke out sharply!
[The Treasures of Extremity that have been appearing in the Extremity Step of the previous Havens are freely available at the Culmination Step here?]
Things like the Entry Albatross of the Authority of different Havens were obtained by them before in the previous processes of Extremity Sanctification.

Otherwise, how would beings like the Adjudicator of Dissolution wield the Authority of Dissolution? Or the other 6 Adjudicators of their own Havens wield the authority of the Land they were supposed to oversee?

The words of these existences revealed many things the Courier of Senatus approached closer and closer, some clustered Inheritances moving away as many stared towards them with a combination of calm and fear.
This was how prominent and assertive they were across the Seven Aeonic Havens!
